domains.name: student
domains.description: Single source of truth for all student identity, demographics, academic standing, enrollment status, degree progress, academic history, and FERPA-protected records. Manages the student lifecycle from prospect through alumnus, supporting GPA calculations, SAP status, IPEDS reporting, Title IV compliance, and SIS integration with Ellucian Banner.
domains.references: FERPA, IPEDS, Title IV, Ellucian Banner SIS

products.name: profile
products.description: Authoritative master record for every individual who has ever interacted with the institution as a student — from prospect through alumnus. Stores legal name, preferred name, date of birth, gender identity, pronouns, citizenship, national origin, race/ethnicity (IPEDS categories), primary language, disability status (ADA), veteran status, Social Security Number (encrypted), institutional ID (Banner PIDM), contact information, emergency contacts, FERPA consent flags, directory information opt-out, and record-source system. This is the single source of truth (SSOT) for student identity across all downstream domains.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student profile record. Primary key for the student profile entity.

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_applicant. Business justification: Admissions audit, re-admission processing, and IPEDS person-level reporting require tracing an enrolled student's profile back to their original applicant record. attributes.name: academic_standing
attributes.description: Current academic standing status of the student based on GPA and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) evaluation. Determines eligibility for continued enrollment, financial aid, and academic support interventions.
attributes.references: Institutional Academic Policy, Title IV SAP Standards

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Student's citizenship or immigration status. Critical for Title IV financial aid eligibility, visa compliance (SEVIS reporting), and state residency determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_citizen|permanent_resident|refugee|asylee|temporary_visa|undocumented|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid, SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System)

attributes.name: country_of_citizenship
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of citizenship. Used for international student tracking, SEVIS reporting, and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Student's date of birth. Used for age verification, eligibility determination, IPEDS reporting, and identity verification. Protected under FERPA.
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99, IPEDS Data Collection

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has disclosed a disability and is registered with disability services for ADA accommodations. Used for accessibility planning and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Student's primary institutional or personal email address for official communications, course notifications, and account recovery. Protected under FERPA as directory information unless opt-out is elected.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the student's primary emergency contact person. Used for critical notifications in case of medical emergency, safety incident, or urgent situation.
attributes.references: Campus Safety Policy, FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the student's emergency contact. Used for urgent notifications.
attributes.references: Campus Safety Policy, FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the student (e.g., parent, spouse, sibling, guardian, friend).

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the student's relationship with the institution. Determines access to systems, services, and reporting inclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|withdrawn|graduated|dismissed|leave_of_absence|deceased — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Student Status Codes

attributes.name: ethnicity_hispanic_latino
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Hispanic or Latino ethnicity per IPEDS two-part race/ethnicity reporting standard. Used for federal reporting, diversity analytics, and compliance.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: ferpa_consent_third_party
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has provided written consent for the institution to share education records with specified third parties (e.g., parents, sponsors, employers). Consent must be documented separately.

attributes.name: ferpa_directory_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has elected to opt out of directory information disclosure under FERPA. When true, the institution may not release directory information (name, email, phone, enrollment status, degrees, honors) without explicit consent.

attributes.name: first_time_in_any_college
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a first-time-in-any-college student (FTIAC) with no prior postsecondary enrollment. Critical for IPEDS cohort tracking, retention reporting, and graduation rate calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Enrollment and Graduation Rate Surveys

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Student's self-identified gender identity. Used for inclusive campus services, housing assignments, and optional demographic reporting. Distinct from legal sex assigned at birth.
attributes.references: Campus Inclusive Practices Policy, Title IX

attributes.name: institutional_number
attributes.description: Institution-assigned unique identifier for the student, typically the Banner PIDM (Person Identification Master) or equivalent SIS identifier. This is the operational student ID used across all campus systems.

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Student's legal first name as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for official transcripts, diplomas, and Title IV reporting.

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Student's legal last name (surname/family name) as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for official transcripts, diplomas, and Title IV reporting.

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Student's legal middle name or initial as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Nullable if no middle name exists.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the student's current mailing address (street number and name, apartment/unit number). Used for official correspondence, billing statements, and emergency contact.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the student's current mailing address (additional address details, building name, etc.). Nullable if not needed.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City of the student's current mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the student's current mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the student's current mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the student's current mailing address. Use standard postal abbreviations (e.g., CA, NY, ON).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Student's primary contact phone number (mobile or landline). Used for emergency notifications, enrollment communications, and administrative contact. Protected under FERPA as directory information unless opt-out is elected.

attributes.name: preferred_first_name
attributes.description: Student's preferred first name for daily use in classroom rosters, email communications, and non-official documents. May differ from legal name to respect gender identity or cultural preferences.

attributes.name: preferred_last_name
attributes.description: Student's preferred last name for daily use in classroom rosters, email communications, and non-official documents. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code representing the student's primary or native language. Used for ESL program placement, accessibility services, and communication preferences.

attributes.name: pronouns
attributes.description: Student's preferred pronouns for use in communications and classroom settings (e.g., she/her, he/him, they/them, ze/zir). Supports inclusive campus environment.

attributes.name: race_american_indian_alaska_native
attributes.business_glossary_term: Race: American Indian or Alaska Native
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as American Indian or Alaska Native per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_asian
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Asian per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_black_african_american
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Black or African American per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_native_hawaiian_pacific_islander

attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_white
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as White per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profile record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this profile record originated (e.g., Ellucian Banner, Slate CRM, manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profile record was last updated in the data warehouse. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: U.S. Social Security Number for the student. Must be encrypted at rest. Required for Title IV financial aid processing and IPEDS reporting. Nullable for international students.
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99, Title IV Federal Student Aid

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a U.S. military veteran. Used for veteran services, GI Bill benefits administration, and federal reporting.

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Type of visa held by international students (e.g., F-1, J-1, M-1). Required for SEVIS compliance and international student services. Nullable for domestic students.
attributes.references: SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System)

products.name: academic_standing
products.description: Tracks a students current and historical academic standing and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) evaluation per term. Captures institutional standing (good standing, probation, suspension, dismissal, deans list, honor roll), GPA components (cumulative, term, transfer), credit hours (attempted, earned, in progress), SAP evaluation results (GPA threshold, pace/completion rate, maximum timeframe), overall SAP status (satisfactory, warning, probation, suspension), Title IV financial aid impact, SAP appeal status and decision, academic plan attachment, policy version applied, and evaluating authority. One record per student per term evaluation cycle. Supports both institutional academic standing decisions and federal Title IV SAP compliance.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the academic standing evaluation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member, office, or automated system that performed or certified the academic standing evaluation. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_academic_term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term for which this standing evaluation was performed. Links to the term reference table.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student being evaluated for academic standing. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.student_term_record. Business justification: Academic standing evaluation is driven by the term-level GPA and credit hours in student_term_record. Reconciliation reports and SAP audits require joining the authoritative standing determination (st

attributes.name: academic_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is required to follow an academic plan as a condition of continued enrollment or financial aid eligibility. Typically required for students on probation or whose appeal was conditionally approved.

attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the student's SAP appeal. Approved appeals may reinstate Title IV eligibility with or without an academic plan. Denied appeals result in loss of federal financial aid eligibility.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Appeal Decision Date
attributes.description: The date on which the SAP appeal committee rendered a decision on the student's appeal.

attributes.name: appeal_submitted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Appeal Submitted Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student submitted a formal appeal for SAP suspension or probation status. Appeals typically cite extenuating circumstances such as medical issues, family emergencies, or other documented hardships.

attributes.name: completion_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of attempted credit hours that the student has successfully completed (earned credits / attempted credits * 100). Federal SAP requires a minimum 67% completion rate (pace) for Title IV eligibility.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Pace Requirement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this academic standing evaluation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credits_in_progress
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student is currently enrolled in for the upcoming or current term. Used for enrollment status verification.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_attempted
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has attempted across all terms at the institution, including courses in progress, completed, withdrawn, and failed. Used in SAP pace calculation.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed with a passing grade across all terms at the institution. Used in SAP pace calculation and degree progress tracking.

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: The student's cumulative grade point average across all terms at the institution, calculated on a 4.0 scale. Includes all graded coursework attempted at the institution, excluding transfer credits.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the academic standing evaluation was performed. Typically occurs at the end of each term after final grades are posted.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the evaluator regarding special circumstances, policy exceptions, or additional context for the standing determination. Confidential institutional record.

attributes.name: gpa_threshold_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Grade Point Average (GPA) Threshold Met Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student met the minimum cumulative GPA threshold required for satisfactory academic progress. Threshold varies by academic level and institutional policy.

attributes.name: institutional_standing
attributes.description: The official academic standing status assigned by the institution based on cumulative and term GPA performance. Determines eligibility for continued enrollment, honors recognition, and academic intervention programs.

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this academic standing record should be included in IPEDS reporting cohorts for retention, graduation rate, and academic progress metrics.

attributes.name: maximum_timeframe_exceeded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has exceeded the maximum timeframe allowed to complete their degree program. Federal SAP requires completion within 150% of the published program length.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Maximum Timeframe

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student was notified of their academic standing evaluation results. Important for compliance with institutional notification requirements and appeal deadlines.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was officially notified of their academic standing status and any associated actions required (probation, suspension, appeal rights, etc.).

attributes.name: pace_threshold_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student met the minimum completion rate (pace) threshold required for satisfactory academic progress. Federal requirement is 67% for Title IV eligibility.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Pace Requirement

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the academic standing and SAP policy that was applied during this evaluation. Ensures historical evaluations can be audited against the policy in effect at the time.

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: Federal Title IV financial aid eligibility status based on Satisfactory Academic Progress evaluation. Determines whether the student meets federal requirements for GPA, pace of completion, and maximum timeframe to continue receiving federal financial aid.

attributes.name: term_credits_attempted
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student attempted during the evaluation term, including completed, withdrawn, and failed courses.

attributes.name: term_credits_earned
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student successfully completed with a passing grade during the evaluation term.

attributes.name: term_gpa
attributes.description: The student's grade point average for the specific evaluation term, calculated on a 4.0 scale. Used to assess term-level academic performance.

attributes.name: title_iv_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Title IV Financial Aid Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible to receive federal Title IV financial aid based on the SAP evaluation results. False if SAP status is suspension or if appeal was denied.

attributes.name: transfer_gpa
attributes.description: The grade point average from transfer coursework accepted by the institution, if applicable. May be used in combined GPA calculations depending on institutional policy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this academic standing evaluation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: degree_progress
products.description: Captures a student's progress toward completion of a declared degree program at a point in time. Includes declared major(s), declared minor(s), concentration, catalog year, total credits required, credits completed, credits in progress, credits waived, credits transferred, percentage to completion, anticipated graduation term, graduation application status, and degree audit run timestamp. Supports what-if scenario tracking for program changes. Links to the curriculum domain for degree requirements.

attributes.name: degree_progress_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the degree progress record. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_AGREEMENT (degree progress represents a student's binding relationship with a declared academic program at a point in time).

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the declared academic program (degree, major, concentration). Links to the curriculum domain for degree requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: anticipated_graduation_term
attributes.description: The academic term in which the student is expected to complete all degree requirements and graduate (e.g., Spring 2025).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Graduation Planning

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the degree audit system regarding exceptions, substitutions, or special conditions affecting degree progress.

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The academic catalog year under which the student is pursuing the degree (e.g., 2023-2024). Determines the set of degree requirements applicable to the student.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Catalog

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit CIP code that classifies the instructional program according to the National Center for Education Statistics taxonomy (e.g., 11.0701 for Computer Science).

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of degree requirements completed, calculated as (credits completed + transferred + waived) / total credits required * 100.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed toward the degree program, including passed courses with grades of D or better (or institution-specific passing threshold).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic History

attributes.name: credits_in_progress
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student is currently enrolled in for the current term that count toward degree requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Registration

attributes.name: credits_remaining
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours still required to complete the degree program, calculated as total required minus completed, transferred, and waived credits.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: credits_transferred
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours accepted from other institutions or prior learning assessments that count toward the degree program.

attributes.name: credits_waived
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours waived due to exemptions, advanced placement, or other institutional policies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student officially declared this major or program.

attributes.name: degree_audit_run_timestamp

attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: degree_level

attributes.name: degree_type

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: elective_credits_completed

attributes.name: elective_credits_required

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: general_education_credits_completed

attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: general_education_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of general education or core curriculum credit hours required for the degree program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: major_code
attributes.description: The institutional code for the student's declared major within the academic program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: major_credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed in the major field of study.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: major_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours required in the major field of study.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: major_name
attributes.description: The full name of the student's declared major (e.g., Computer Science, Biology, Business Administration).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: minimum_gpa_required
attributes.description: The minimum cumulative or program GPA required for degree conferral under the applicable catalog year.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: minor_code
attributes.description: The institutional code for the student's declared minor, if applicable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: minor_name
attributes.description: The full name of the student's declared minor (e.g., Mathematics, Psychology), if applicable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: total_credits_required

attributes.name: credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: The number of credit hours the student attempted for this course. Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) calculations.

attributes.name: credit_hours_earned
attributes.description: The number of credit hours the student successfully earned for this course. May differ from attempted hours if the course was failed or withdrawn.

attributes.name: degree_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course counts toward the student's degree requirements for their declared program.

attributes.name: financial_aid_eligible_flag

attributes.name: general_education_flag

attributes.name: grade_change_date

attributes.name: grade_earned

attributes.name: grade_points
attributes.description: The total grade points earned for this course, calculated as credit hours multiplied by the grade point value (e.g., 4.0 for A, 3.0 for B). Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) calculation.

attributes.name: grade_replacement_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this grade replaces a previous grade for GPA calculation purposes under the institution's grade replacement policy.

attributes.name: grading_mode
attributes.description: The grading basis under which the student took the course (e.g., standard letter grade, pass/fail, audit, credit/no credit).

attributes.name: honors_course_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course was taken as part of an honors program or honors section.

attributes.name: major_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course fulfills a major requirement for the student's declared major program.

attributes.name: online_course_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course was delivered entirely online or through distance education.

attributes.name: quality_points
attributes.description: Alternative term for grade points used in some institutions. Represents the numeric value assigned to the grade for GPA calculation purposes.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this academic history record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this academic history record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: The current or final registration status for this course enrollment (e.g., registered, dropped, withdrawn, completed).

attributes.name: repeat_count
attributes.description: The number of times the student has attempted this specific course, including the current attempt.

attributes.name: repeat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course is a repeat of a previously taken course. True if the student has taken this course before.

attributes.name: source_institution_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier for the institution from which transfer credits were earned. Populated only for transfer credits.

attributes.name: source_institution_name
attributes.description: The name of the institution from which transfer credits were earned. Populated only for transfer credits.

attributes.name: subject_code

attributes.name: transcript_display_flag

attributes.name: transfer_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course was transferred from another institution rather than taken at the home institution.

products.name: student_test_score
products.description: Stores standardized test scores submitted by or on behalf of a student, including test type (SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, IELTS, AP, IB, CLEP, Duolingo English Test), test date, score components (e.g., SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, SAT Math), composite score, percentile rank, score report date, score source (self-reported vs. official), official verification status, and superscore eligibility flag. Supports admissions evaluation and placement decisions.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SOATEST / Slate CRM Test Score Import

attributes.name: student_test_score_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student test score record. Primary key.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application for which this test score was submitted. Links to the enrollment application record. Nullable if score was submitted outside of a specific application context.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who took the test. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Test score reporting for admissions transparency is regulatory under state authorization and accreditation. Test score policies must comply with state disclosure requirements. Essential for state auth

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Overall composite or total score for the test. Scale varies by test type (e.g., SAT 400-1600, ACT 1-36, GRE 260-340, TOEFL 0-120, IELTS 0-9).
attributes.references: College Board, ACT Inc., ETS, British Council

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the test score record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the test score record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the test score record. May include information about score discrepancies, special circumstances, or additional context for admissions review.

attributes.name: official_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of official verification for the test score. Indicates whether an official score report has been received and validated by the institution. Pending indicates awaiting official report, verified indicates official report received and matched, rejected indicates discrepancy between self-reported and official scores, not_required indicates official verification is not needed for this use case.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: Percentile rank of the student's composite score compared to all test takers in the reference population. Value ranges from 1 to 99, indicating the percentage of test takers who scored at or below this score.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the test score record was received and entered into the Student Information System (SIS). Used for tracking processing timelines and application completeness.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the test score record. Active indicates the score is current and valid for use, superseded indicates a newer score has replaced this one, cancelled indicates the score has been invalidated, archived indicates the score is retained for historical purposes but no longer actively used.

attributes.name: score_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the official score report was issued by the testing agency. Used to track score validity periods and official reporting timelines.

attributes.name: score_send_date
attributes.description: Date when the official score report was sent to the institution by the testing agency. Used for tracking score receipt and processing timelines.

attributes.name: score_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test score was self-reported by the student or received as an official score report from the testing agency. Self-reported scores may be used for initial admissions review, while official scores are required for final admission decisions.

attributes.name: score_use_purpose
attributes.description: Primary purpose for which the test score is being used by the institution. Admission indicates use in admissions evaluation, placement indicates use for course placement decisions, scholarship indicates use for merit scholarship consideration, research indicates use for institutional research and reporting.

attributes.name: score_validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the test score is no longer considered valid for admissions purposes. Validity periods vary by test type and institutional policy (e.g., GRE scores valid for 5 years, TOEFL scores valid for 2 years).

attributes.name: section_1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first test section or component (e.g., SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, ACT English, GRE Verbal Reasoning, TOEFL Reading).

attributes.name: section_1_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the first test section. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: section_2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second test section or component (e.g., SAT Math, ACT Math, GRE Quantitative Reasoning, TOEFL Listening).

attributes.name: section_2_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the second test section. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: section_3_name
attributes.description: Name of the third test section or component (e.g., ACT Reading, GRE Analytical Writing, TOEFL Speaking). Nullable for tests with fewer sections.

attributes.name: section_3_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the third test section. Nullable for tests with fewer sections. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: section_4_name
attributes.description: Name of the fourth test section or component (e.g., ACT Science, TOEFL Writing). Nullable for tests with fewer sections.

attributes.name: section_4_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the fourth test section. Nullable for tests with fewer sections. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: superscore_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test score is eligible for superscoring. Superscoring combines the highest section scores from multiple test dates to create a new composite score. Eligibility depends on institutional policy and test type.

attributes.name: test_administration_code
attributes.description: Unique code assigned by the testing agency to identify the specific test administration session. Used for score verification and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: test_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the test center location where the student took the test. Used for tracking and verification purposes.

attributes.name: test_center_name
attributes.description: Name of the test center location where the student took the test.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student took the standardized test. Used for score validity assessment and superscore eligibility determination.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Type of standardized test taken by the student. Common types include SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test), ACT (American College Testing), GRE (Graduate Record Examination), GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), IELTS (International English Language Testing System), AP (Advanced Placement), IB (International Baccalaureate), CLEP (College Level Examination Program), and Duolingo English Test. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAT|ACT|GRE|GMAT|TOEFL|IELTS|AP|IB|CLEP|Duolingo|MCAT|LSAT|PSAT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: test_version
attributes.description: Version or form code of the test administered. Different versions may have slightly different questions but are equated to the same scoring scale.

attributes.name: writing_score
attributes.description: Optional writing or essay score component, if applicable for the test type (e.g., SAT Essay, ACT Writing, GRE Analytical Writing). Nullable for tests without writing components or when student did not take the writing section.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this residency classification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the residency classification was officially determined by the registrar or residency officer. Represents the business event timestamp for this classification decision.

attributes.name: documentation_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the residency supporting documentation was received by the registrar's office or residency review unit. Used to track processing timelines and compliance with submission deadlines.

attributes.name: documentation_type
attributes.description: Type of supporting documentation provided by the student to substantiate their residency claim. Common types include driver's license, voter registration, tax returns, lease agreements, utility bills, military orders, or visa/I-20 for international students. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drivers_license|voter_registration|tax_return|lease_agreement|utility_bill|military_orders|visa_i20|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: domicile_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the student's country of legal domicile. Primarily used for international students to distinguish country of origin for reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: domicile_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the student's legal domicile for residency determination purposes. Used to assess eligibility for in-state tuition or reciprocity agreements. NULL for international students.

attributes.name: duration_of_residency_months
attributes.description: Number of months the student has maintained continuous legal domicile in the state, as documented and verified during the residency determination process. Used to assess eligibility for in-state status, which typically requires 12 consecutive months of domicile.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this residency classification expires and must be re-evaluated. Some institutions require periodic re-verification of residency status, particularly for students claiming in-state status based on recent domicile establishment.

attributes.name: ferpa_restriction_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Restriction Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has requested FERPA directory information restrictions that limit disclosure of residency classification data. Ensures compliance with student privacy rights under FERPA.

attributes.name: financial_independence_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has been determined to be financially independent from out-of-state parents or guardians for residency purposes. Financial independence is often a prerequisite for establishing in-state residency for students whose parents reside out of state.
attributes.references: Institutional Residency Policy; State Residency Statute

attributes.name: ipeds_residency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Residency Code
attributes.description: Residency classification code mapped to IPEDS reporting categories for federal compliance reporting. IPEDS requires institutions to report enrollment by residency status (in-state, out-of-state, foreign) for fall enrollment surveys.
attributes.references: IPEDS Data Collection System; NCES IPEDS Glossary

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this residency classification record is currently active and in effect for the student. Only one residency classification per student should be active at any given time. Historical records are retained with is_active set to false.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this residency classification record was most recently updated. Tracks the most recent modification to any field in the record for audit and data quality monitoring purposes.

attributes.name: military_affiliation_type
attributes.description: Type of military affiliation that may qualify the student for special residency consideration or in-state tuition rates under federal or state veteran education benefits policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active_duty|veteran|reserve|national_guard|dependent|spouse|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Veterans Access, Choice, and Accountability Act; State Veteran Tuition Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the residency reviewer regarding special circumstances, documentation issues, or other relevant context for the classification decision. Supports case-by-case decision transparency.

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the institutional residency policy that was applied to make this classification determination. Ensures traceability and consistency when policies are updated over time.

attributes.name: prior_residency_status
attributes.description: The student's residency classification in the immediately preceding term. Used to track residency status changes over time and to support audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: reciprocity_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the interstate reciprocity agreement under which the student qualifies for reduced tuition (e.g., Midwest Student Exchange Program, Academic Common Market, Western Undergraduate Exchange). NULL if no reciprocity agreement applies.

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Official residency classification for tuition assessment purposes. Determines whether the student qualifies for in-state, out-of-state, or other special tuition rates. Directly impacts tuition billing and IPEDS residency reporting.
attributes.references: State Higher Education Policy; IPEDS Residency Definitions

attributes.name: tuition_rate_category
attributes.description: Tuition rate category assigned based on the residency classification. Directly drives the tuition rate applied in the student billing system. May differ slightly from residency_status to accommodate special rate programs.

products.name: visa_immigration
products.description: Tracks immigration and visa status for international students, including visa type (F-1, J-1, M-1, H-1B, OPT, CPT), visa issue date, visa expiration date, I-20 or DS-2019 issue date, SEVIS ID, SEVIS status, authorized stay end date, OPT/CPT authorization period, employment authorization document number, country of citizenship, country of birth, passport number (encrypted), and SEVIS reporting compliance flags. Supports SEVP (Student and Exchange Visitor Program) compliance and DHS reporting.
products.reference: SEVIS / DHS SEVP / Ellucian Banner GOAINTL

attributes.name: visa_immigration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the visa and immigration record. Primary key for the visa_immigration product.

attributes.name: dso_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: SEVIS compliance and DHS reporting require tracking which Designated School Official (DSO) is responsible for each international student's immigration record. dso_name and dso_email are denormalized;

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Institutional international student policies (CPT/OPT authorization policy, reduced course load policy, full course of study policy) govern DSO decisions recorded in visa_immigration. visa_immigration

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the international student associated with this visa and immigration record. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: SEVIS reporting is a federal regulatory requirement under SEVP. Immigration status tracking directly supports compliance with F-1/J-1 visa regulations. Essential for SEVIS batch reporting and complian

attributes.name: authorized_stay_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which the student is authorized to remain in the United States. For F-1 and J-1 students, this is typically D/S (Duration of Status) which extends through the program end date plus any grace period.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Form I-94

attributes.name: country_of_birth
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of birth. Required for SEVIS reporting and visa applications.

attributes.name: country_of_citizenship
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of citizenship. This is the country that issued the student's passport.

attributes.name: cpt_authorization_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Curricular Practical Training (CPT) Authorization End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the Curricular Practical Training (CPT) period. Students must cease CPT employment by this date unless a new authorization is granted.

attributes.name: cpt_authorization_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Curricular Practical Training (CPT) Authorization Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the Curricular Practical Training (CPT) period for F-1 students. CPT allows students to engage in internships or employment that is an integral part of their curriculum while enrolled.

attributes.name: cpt_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CPT authorization is for part-time employment (20 hours or less per week) or full-time employment (more than 20 hours per week). Full-time CPT for 12 months or more makes students ineligible for post-completion OPT.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this visa and immigration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ds2019_expiration_date
attributes.description: The program end date listed on the Form DS-2019, indicating when the exchange visitor is expected to complete their program. J-1 visitors must complete their program by this date or request an extension.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of State, Form DS-2019

attributes.name: ds2019_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status (Form DS-2019) was issued to the J-1 exchange visitor by the institution's Responsible Officer (RO). Required for J-1 visa holders.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of State, Form DS-2019

attributes.name: ead_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Employment Authorization Document (EAD) expires. Students must cease employment or renew their EAD before this date.

attributes.name: ead_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Employment Authorization Document (EAD) was issued by USCIS.

attributes.name: ead_number
attributes.description: The unique number on the Employment Authorization Document (EAD card, Form I-766) issued by USCIS. This card authorizes the student to work in the United States during OPT or other authorized employment periods.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student most recently entered the United States. This date is recorded on the Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record and is critical for calculating authorized stay periods.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Form I-94

attributes.name: full_course_of_study_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Full Course of Study Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is currently enrolled in a full course of study as required by their visa status. F-1 students must be enrolled full-time (typically 12 credit hours for undergraduates, 9 for graduates) to maintain status.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's grace period ends. F-1 students receive a 60-day grace period after program completion or OPT end date. J-1 students receive a 30-day grace period. Students must depart the U.S. or change status by this date.

attributes.name: i20_expiration_date
attributes.description: The program end date listed on the Form I-20, indicating when the student is expected to complete their academic program. Students must complete their program by this date or request an extension.

attributes.name: i20_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status (Form I-20) was issued to the F or M student by the institution's Designated School Official (DSO). Required for F-1 and M-1 visa holders.

attributes.name: i94_number
attributes.description: The unique 11-digit admission number from the Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record issued by U.S. Customs and Border Protection upon entry to the United States. This number is used to verify lawful admission and authorized stay.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Form I-94

attributes.name: last_sevis_update_date
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the student's SEVIS record. SEVIS records must be updated within 21 days of any change in student status, program, or personal information.

attributes.name: next_sevis_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next mandatory SEVIS report is due. Schools must report certain events (enrollment verification, program completion, status changes) within specific timeframes to maintain SEVP certification.

attributes.name: off_campus_employment_authorized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is authorized to work off campus through CPT, OPT, severe economic hardship authorization, or other special circumstances.

attributes.name: on_campus_employment_authorized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is authorized to work on campus. F-1 students are generally authorized to work on campus up to 20 hours per week while school is in session and full-time during breaks.

attributes.name: opt_authorization_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) Authorization End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) period. Students must cease employment and depart the U.S. or change status by this date unless they have applied for a STEM extension or other status change.

attributes.name: opt_authorization_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) Authorization Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) period for F-1 students. OPT allows students to work in their field of study for up to 12 months (or 24 months for STEM extension) after completing their academic program.

attributes.name: opt_type
attributes.description: The type of OPT authorization. Pre-completion OPT allows students to work part-time while enrolled. Post-completion OPT allows full-time work after graduation. STEM extension provides an additional 24 months for STEM degree holders.

attributes.name: passport_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the student's passport. Students must maintain a valid passport (typically valid for at least 6 months into the future) to maintain legal status in the United States.

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The passport number from the student's valid passport. This field should be encrypted at rest to protect sensitive personal information. Required for SEVIS reporting and visa tracking.

attributes.name: port_of_entry
attributes.description: The U.S. port of entry (airport, seaport, or land border crossing) through which the student most recently entered the United States. Examples include JFK (New York), LAX (Los Angeles), or ATL (Atlanta).

attributes.name: reduced_course_load_authorized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student has been authorized by the Designated School Official (DSO) to take a reduced course load due to academic difficulties, medical reasons, or initial difficulty with English language or reading requirements.

attributes.name: sevis_fee_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the SEVIS I-901 fee paid by the student in U.S. dollars. The fee amount varies by visa type (F/M students pay $350, J exchange visitors pay $220 as of recent rates).

attributes.name: sevis_fee_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student paid the SEVIS I-901 fee. This fee must be paid before applying for an F, J, or M visa and is required for SEVIS activation.

attributes.name: sevis_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Student and Exchange Visitor Information System (SEVIS) ID
attributes.description: The unique SEVIS identification number assigned by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security to track F and M nonimmigrant students and J nonimmigrant exchange visitors. Required for SEVP compliance and DHS reporting.
attributes.references: SEVP (Student and Exchange Visitor Program), U.S. Department of Homeland Security

attributes.name: sevis_status
attributes.description: The current status of the student in the SEVIS system. Initial indicates the student has been issued an I-20 or DS-2019 but has not yet entered the U.S. Active indicates the student is enrolled and maintaining status. Completed indicates the student has finished their program.

attributes.name: transfer_pending
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student has a pending SEVIS transfer to another institution. During a transfer, the student's SEVIS record is released from the current school to the new school.

attributes.name: transfer_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's SEVIS record was released to another institution for transfer. The student must report to the new school within 15 days of the program start date or the transfer release date, whichever is later.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this visa and immigration record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking to ensure data quality and compliance.

attributes.name: visa_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the visa expires. Note that for F-1 and J-1 visas, students may remain in the U.S. beyond this date as long as they maintain valid status (D/S - Duration of Status).

attributes.name: visa_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the visa was issued by the U.S. consulate or embassy. This is the date stamped on the visa in the student's passport.

attributes.name: visa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the visa record. Active indicates the visa is valid and the student is in compliance. Expired indicates the visa has passed its expiration date. Terminated indicates the visa was ended due to program completion or violation.

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: The type of visa held by the international student. F-1 is for academic students, J-1 for exchange visitors, M-1 for vocational students, H-1B for specialty occupation workers, and other categories for dependents and special cases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F-1|F-2|J-1|J-2|M-1|M-2|H-1B|H-4|O-1|TN|L-1|B-1|B-2 — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of State Visa Categories, SEVP

Drives the degree conferral workflow and IPEDS Completions Survey submissions.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SHAGAPP / IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: graduation_application_id

Business justification: Graduation clearance requires verifying the student completed requirements for a specific academic program. The registrar and degree audit staff link each graduation application to the governing progr

Graduation data feeds IPEDS Completions survey and state authorization reports. Essential for regulatory filing preparation.

attributes.name: application_approved_date
attributes.description: Date the graduation application was approved by the registrar or academic dean. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: application_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the graduation application fee charged to the student. Null if no fee is charged by the institution.

attributes.name: application_fee_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the graduation application fee has been paid. True if paid, False if outstanding. Some institutions charge a fee for graduation application processing.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the graduation application, typically displayed on student portals and official communications.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the graduation application. Pending indicates under review, Approved means cleared for degree conferral, Denied indicates requirements not met, Deferred means postponed to future term.

attributes.name: application_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date the student submitted the graduation application. Used to track application deadlines and processing timelines.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code classifying the field of study for federal IPEDS reporting. Format: XX.XXXX (e.g., 52.0201 for Business Administration).
attributes.references: National Center for Education Statistics CIP 2020

attributes.name: commencement_ceremony_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific commencement ceremony the student will attend (e.g., College of Engineering ceremony, Graduate School ceremony). Null if not participating.

attributes.name: commencement_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student intends to participate in the commencement ceremony. True if participating, False if not attending.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the graduation application record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: degree_audit_date
attributes.description: Date the final degree audit was completed to verify all graduation requirements were met. Typically performed by the registrar's office.

attributes.name: degree_code
attributes.description: Institutional code representing the specific degree or credential being conferred (e.g., BA, BS, MBA, PhD, AA). Links to the degree catalog.

attributes.name: degree_conferral_date
attributes.description: Official date the degree was conferred by the institution. This is the graduation date that appears on transcripts and is reported to IPEDS. Null until degree is officially awarded.

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: Level of degree or credential for which the student is applying (Associate, Bachelor, Master, Doctoral, Certificate, Diploma). Used for IPEDS Completions Survey reporting.

attributes.name: degree_requirements_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all degree requirements have been satisfied (credit hours, GPA, major requirements, general education, residency). True if all requirements met, False if deficiencies exist.

attributes.name: diploma_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is a hold preventing diploma release (e.g., outstanding financial obligations, unreturned library materials, conduct sanctions). True if hold exists, False if clear.

attributes.name: diploma_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the diploma hold (e.g., Outstanding tuition balance, Library fines, Conduct sanction). Null if no hold exists.

attributes.name: diploma_mailed_date
attributes.description: Date the diploma was mailed to the student. Used for tracking diploma fulfillment and student inquiries. Null until diploma is mailed.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the mailing address where the diploma should be sent. Protected under FERPA as student directory information.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the mailing address (apartment, suite, building number). Optional field. Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_city
attributes.description: City for diploma mailing address. Protected under FERPA as student directory information.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for diploma mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for diploma mailing address. Protected under FERPA as student directory information.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for diploma mailing address (e.g., CA, TX, ON). Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_name
attributes.description: Full legal name as it should appear on the printed diploma. May differ from current student name due to name changes or preferred formatting. Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_print_date
attributes.description: Date the physical diploma was printed. Used for tracking diploma production and fulfillment workflows. Null until diploma is printed.

attributes.name: graduation_gpa
attributes.description: Final cumulative GPA at the time of graduation. This is the official GPA that appears on the final transcript and diploma.

attributes.name: honors_gpa
attributes.description: Cumulative GPA used to determine Latin honors eligibility. May differ from overall GPA if institution uses specific calculation rules (e.g., excluding transfer credits).

attributes.name: institutional_credits_earned
attributes.description: Number of credit hours earned at the degree-granting institution (excluding transfer credits). Used for residency requirement verification.

attributes.name: ipeds_reported_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Reported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this degree completion has been reported to IPEDS for the annual Completions Survey. True if reported, False if not yet reported.

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Reporting Year
attributes.description: Academic year for which this completion was reported to IPEDS (e.g., 2024 for 2023-2024 academic year). Null if not yet reported.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the graduation application record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: latin_honors_designation
attributes.description: Latin honors awarded based on cumulative GPA thresholds (Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Summa Cum Laude). Null if student does not qualify for honors. Appears on diploma and transcript.
attributes.value_regex: Cum Laude|Magna Cum Laude|Summa Cum Laude

attributes.name: special_recognition
attributes.description: Additional honors, awards, or recognitions to be noted on the diploma or transcript (e.g., Honors Program Graduate, Phi Beta Kappa, Dean's List). Free-text field for institutional flexibility.

attributes.name: total_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours earned by the student at the time of graduation, including transfer credits if applicable. Used to verify degree completion requirements.

attributes.name: transfer_credits_accepted
attributes.description: Number of transfer credit hours accepted toward the degree from other institutions. Used for degree audit and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: disability_accommodation_status

attributes.name: disability_category

attributes.name: disability_description

attributes.name: documentation_expiration_date

attributes.name: documentation_received_date

attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; HIPAA

attributes.name: documentation_status
attributes.description: Status of the supporting medical or psychological documentation required to substantiate the disability and accommodation request. attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the accommodation becomes active and available for use by the student in academic settings.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: eligibility_determination_date

attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: extended_time_multiplier

attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: faculty_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the faculty member acknowledged receipt and understanding of the accommodation notification. Used to track compliance with accommodation implementation requirements.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: faculty_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which faculty members were notified of the students approved accommodations. Faculty notification is typically sent by the disability services office at the start of each term or when accommodations are approved.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; FERPA

attributes.name: ferpa_sensitive_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Sensitive Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accommodation record contains information that requires heightened FERPA protection due to its sensitive nature. True if the record contains sensitive health or disability information requiring restricted access; false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accommodation record is currently active in the system. True if active; false if logically deleted or archived. Used for soft delete functionality and historical record retention.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renewal or re-evaluation of the accommodation. Used to track renewal history and determine when the next renewal is due.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this accommodation record was last modified or updated in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next renewal or re-evaluation of the accommodation must be completed. Calculated based on renewal frequency and last renewal date.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the accommodation, including implementation details, special considerations, student preferences, or coordination requirements. May contain sensitive health information.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; FERPA; HIPAA

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required renewals for accommodations that require periodic re-evaluation. Common values include 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), or 36 (triennial). Null if renewal is not required.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accommodation requires periodic renewal or re-evaluation. True if renewal is required; false for permanent or indefinite accommodations.
attributes.references: ADA Title II; Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: section_504_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has been determined eligible for accommodations under Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973. True if eligible; false otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this accommodation record originated. Typically the disability services module within the Student Information System (SIS) such as Ellucian Banner or a specialized accommodation management system.

products.name: degree_conferral
products.description: Official record of a degree, certificate, or credential lifecycle from application through conferral. Captures graduation application fields (application term, application status, commencement participation intent, commencement ceremony selection, diploma mailing address), degree details (degree type, degree title, CIP code, degree level), conferral fields (conferral date, conferral term, Latin honors awarded, institutional unit), diploma management (diploma number, diploma status, diploma hold flag, print date), and IPEDS Completions Survey submission status. This is the permanent, immutable record of academic credential award once conferred, and the authoritative source for transcript degree notation and commencement processing.

Supports program accreditation (AACSB, ABET), articulation agreements, and academic quality assurance.

Serves as the authoritative catalog of institutional academic offerings and the parent entity for degree requirements, concentrations, PLOs, and curriculum maps.

attributes.description: Expected number of semesters (or equivalent terms) for a full-time student to complete the program. Used in enrollment planning, financial aid cost of attendance (COA) calculations, and student advising.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education; IPEDS; Ellucian Banner Student Information System

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the academic program record. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: va_approved
attributes.business_glossary_term: Veterans Affairs (VA) Education Benefits Approved Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program has been approved by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) for GI Bill and other veterans education benefits. Required for enrollment certification of veteran students.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs; 38 U.S.C. Chapter 30 (Montgomery GI Bill); Chapter 33 (Post-9/11 GI Bill)

products.name: course
products.description: Authoritative catalog record for every course offered by the institution, independent of any specific term or section. Captures course prefix, number, title, long description, credit hours (CR), contact hours, course level (100–900), delivery modality, grading basis (letter, pass/fail, audit), repeatability rules, OER designation, writing-intensive flag, lab/lecture/seminar type, and Banner course master attributes. This is the SSOT for course identity and definition, distinct from section-level scheduling data owned by the enrollment domain.

attributes.name: course_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the course master record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. This is the primary key for the course catalog entity, distinct from any term-specific section or offering.

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.description: FK to curriculum.cip_code

attributes.name: coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: In higher-ed, each course has a designated faculty coordinator responsible for syllabus approval, curriculum review, and assessment coordination. This role is distinct from section instructors and is

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Course-level instructional cost tracking: departments allocate faculty salary, lab, and technology costs to courses against a cost center. Standard Banner/PeopleSoft operational reporting and per-cour

attributes.name: course_college_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the college or school within the institution that houses the department offering this course (e.g., College of Engineering, College of Business). Used for accreditation unit reporting (AACSB, ABET) and institutional analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_COLL_CODE; AACSB Accreditation Standards; ABET Criteria

attributes.name: course_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic department or unit that owns and administers the course. Used for faculty assignment, budget allocation, and accreditation unit mapping. Links to the organizational unit hierarchy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_DEPT_CODE; Workday HCM Org Unit

attributes.name: default_room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: Courses with specialized facility needs (labs, studios, performance spaces) require default room assignments for scheduling systems. Supports room utilization analysis, equipment planning, and ensures

attributes.name: primary_building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Courses are typically scheduled in specific buildings based on department location and facility requirements. Supports student schedule planning, classroom utilization reporting, and ensures courses a

attributes.name: primary_cross_list_course_id
attributes.description: For cross-listed courses, the course_id of the primary (canonical) course record. Null if this course is the primary listing or is not cross-listed. Used to resolve cross-listing relationships and prevent duplicate catalog entries.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Licensure-track courses (nursing, education, pharmacy) must comply with state licensing board and professional accreditor requirements. Course approval workflows and catalog management require trackin

attributes.name: revenue_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Course-specific fee revenue (lab fees, studio fees, technology fees) must post to a designated revenue ledger account. IPEDS and institutional fee revenue reporting require this link. Role-prefixed 'r

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the course was formally approved by the institutional curriculum committee or faculty governance body. Used for accreditation documentation and curriculum change audit trails.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Curriculum Governance; Institutional Faculty Senate Policy

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current status of the course within the institutional curriculum approval workflow. New courses and course modifications must pass through faculty governance review before becoming active in the catalog. Used for curriculum management and accreditation audit trails.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Curriculum Governance Standards; Institutional Faculty Senate Policy

attributes.name: banner_course_key
