attributes.description: The natural business identifier for the course as stored in Ellucian Banner, typically the concatenation of subject code, course number, and effective term (e.g., MATH101-202310). Serves as the externally-known unique course identifier for system integration and data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE Primary Key (SUBJ_CODE + CRSE_NUMB + EFF_TERM)

attributes.name: canvas_course_code
attributes.description: The course code or SIS ID used to identify this course in the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS). Used for LMS integration, content mapping, and learning analytics alignment between the SIS and LMS.
attributes.references: Canvas LMS SIS Integration; Instructure Canvas API

attributes.name: catalog_year_end
attributes.description: The four-digit academic year in which this course definition was last valid in the published academic catalog. Null for currently active course definitions. Used for degree audit and historical catalog archiving.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; HLC Curriculum Change Policy

attributes.name: catalog_year_start
attributes.description: The four-digit academic year in which this course definition first appeared in the published academic catalog (e.g., 2023 for the 2023-2024 catalog). Used for degree audit grandfathering and curriculum change tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM; HLC Curriculum Change Policy

attributes.name: contact_hours
attributes.description: The total number of scheduled instructional contact hours per week (or per term) for the course. Used for faculty workload calculations, accreditation compliance, and Carnegie Unit verification. Distinct from credit hours.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Carnegie Unit; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; ABET Criteria

attributes.name: corequisite_text
attributes.description: The human-readable narrative description of corequisite requirements — courses that must be taken concurrently with this course. Published in the academic catalog and enforced during registration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCRPREQ; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: The full narrative course description as published in the academic catalog. Describes course content, objectives, and scope. Used by students for course selection, by advisors for degree planning, and by accreditors for curriculum review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: course_level
attributes.description: The numeric level of the course indicating its academic complexity tier (e.g., 100=introductory undergraduate, 200=sophomore, 300=junior, 400=senior, 500=graduate, 600=advanced graduate, 700=doctoral, 800=professional, 900=post-doctoral). Used for degree audit, prerequisite enforcement, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_LEVL_CODE; IPEDS Instructional Level

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: The numeric or alphanumeric course designator within a subject area (e.g., 101, 301, 4820). Combined with subject_code to form the full course identifier (e.g., MATH 101). Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CRSE_NUMB.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the course master record in the catalog. Active courses are available for scheduling and registration. Inactive or discontinued courses are retained for historical transcript purposes but cannot be scheduled. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CSTA_CODE.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CSTA_CODE; HLC Curriculum Approval Standards

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: The primary instructional format or delivery type of the course. Distinguishes lecture-based, laboratory, seminar, studio, clinical, independent study, internship, thesis, dissertation, and hybrid formats. Used for scheduling, accreditation, and faculty workload reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lecture|lab|seminar|studio|clinical|independent_study|internship|thesis|dissertation|hybrid|online|practicum — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_SCHD_CODE; IPEDS Instructional Activity; AACSB Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the course master record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver Layer. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and curriculum change history tracking.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Stewardship; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of academic credit hours (CR) awarded upon successful completion of the course. Used for degree requirement tracking, financial aid eligibility (SAP), full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations, and IPEDS reporting. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_HIGH or SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_LOW for variable-credit courses.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Credit Hour Definition (34 CFR 600.2); IPEDS; Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_HIGH

attributes.name: credit_hours_min
attributes.description: The minimum number of credit hours that may be awarded for variable-credit courses (e.g., independent study, thesis, internship). Null for fixed-credit courses. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_LOW.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_LOW; U.S. Department of Education 34 CFR 600.2

attributes.name: cross_listed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is cross-listed under multiple subject codes or departments. Cross-listed courses share the same instructional content but appear under different prefixes (e.g., WMST 301 / SOC 301). Used for enrollment reporting and catalog management.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE Cross-Listing; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: delivery_modality
attributes.description: The instructional delivery modality for the course as defined in the catalog. Indicates whether the course is delivered in-person, fully online, hybrid (blended), HyFlex, synchronous online, or asynchronous online. Used for enrollment reporting, accreditation, and IPEDS distance education reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Distance Education Definition; U.S. Department of Education; HLC Distance Education Guidelines

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the course was officially discontinued and removed from the active catalog. Null for active courses. Used for historical reporting, degree audit grandfathering, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; HLC Substantive Change Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this version of the course definition is effective in the academic catalog. Used for catalog year tracking, curriculum change management, and degree audit. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM converted to date.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM; HLC Curriculum Change Policy

attributes.name: gen_ed_category
attributes.description: The general education (gen ed) distribution category or core curriculum area fulfilled by this course (e.g., Quantitative Reasoning, Written Communication, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, Diversity). Used for degree audit and accreditation reporting. Values are institution-specific. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: written_communication|quantitative_reasoning|natural_sciences|social_sciences|humanities|diversity|global_awareness|arts — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC Core Curriculum Requirements; Institutional General Education Policy

attributes.name: grading_basis
attributes.description: The grading method applied to the course. Determines how student performance is recorded on the transcript and factored into GPA calculations. Letter-graded courses affect GPA; pass/fail and audit courses typically do not. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_GMOD_CODE.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_GMOD_CODE; FERPA; NACUBO Academic Records Standards

attributes.name: honors_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course is eligible for honors designation or is part of the institution's honors program curriculum. Used for honors program tracking, degree audit, and academic distinction reporting.
attributes.references: Institutional Honors Program Policy; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: lab_hours
attributes.description: The number of weekly laboratory contact hours for the course. Relevant for STEM courses, nursing, and other lab-intensive disciplines. Used in accreditation reporting (ABET) and facility scheduling.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_LAB_HR_HIGH; ABET Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: lecture_hours
attributes.description: The number of weekly lecture contact hours for the course. Used to distinguish instructional modality components and calculate faculty FTE workload. Part of the contact hours breakdown alongside lab and seminar hours.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_LEC_HR_HIGH; IPEDS Instructional Activity

attributes.name: long_title
attributes.description: The full descriptive title of the course used in catalog publications, accreditation reports, and articulation agreements where the abbreviated transcript title may be insufficient.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Standards

attributes.name: max_enrollment
attributes.description: The default maximum number of students permitted to enroll in a single section of this course, as defined at the catalog level. May be overridden at the section level for specific terms. Used for capacity planning and accreditation student-to-faculty ratio reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_MAX_EXT_ENRL; SACSCOC Faculty-Student Ratio Standards

attributes.name: max_repeat_hours
attributes.description: The maximum total credit hours that may be earned by repeating this course. Null if the course is not repeatable or has no cap. Used in degree audit to prevent over-crediting. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_MAX_RPT_UNITS.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_MAX_RPT_UNITS; U.S. Department of Education SAP

attributes.name: oer_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course has been officially designated as using Open Educational Resources (OER) as the primary course materials, eliminating or significantly reducing textbook costs for students. Supports affordability reporting and student financial aid cost-of-attendance (COA) calculations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education OER Initiative; NACUBO Student Affordability Standards

attributes.name: prerequisite_text
attributes.description: The human-readable narrative description of prerequisite requirements for enrollment in this course, as published in the academic catalog. May include course prerequisites, minimum GPA requirements, class standing, or instructor consent. The structured prerequisite chain is managed separately in the curriculum domain.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCRPREQ; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: repeatable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course may be repeated for additional credit (True) or may only be taken once for credit (False). Common for topics courses, independent study, thesis, and performance courses. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_REPEAT_IND.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_REPEAT_IND; FERPA Academic Records

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course is classified as a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) course per the DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List. Relevant for international student visa compliance (OPT extension eligibility) and federal STEM grant reporting.
attributes.references: DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List; NSF STEM Education Reporting; IPEDS

attributes.name: subject_code
attributes.description: The academic subject or department prefix that identifies the discipline area of the course (e.g., MATH, ENGL, BIOL, CS). Corresponds to the Banner SCBCRSE_SUBJ_CODE field and is used in the human-readable course identifier alongside the course number.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_SUBJ_CODE; IPEDS CIP Code Framework

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The official short title of the course as it appears in the academic catalog and on student transcripts. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_TITLE. Used in registration systems, LMS, and official academic records.

attributes.name: transfer_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course participates in formal transfer equivalency or articulation agreements with other institutions. Used by the registrar and transfer credit evaluation process to identify courses with established equivalencies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Transfer Articulation; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the course master record was most recently modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Stewardship; Institutional Data Governance Policy; ETL Change Data Capture

attributes.name: writing_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course has been designated as writing intensive, requiring substantial written work as a core component of instruction and assessment. Used to track fulfillment of general education writing requirements and for accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; Institutional General Education Requirements

products.name: degree_requirement
products.description: Defines the structured set of requirements a student must satisfy to earn a specific academic program's degree or certificate. Captures requirement group type (core, elective, concentration, general education, capstone), minimum credit hours, minimum GPA threshold, course substitution rules, residency requirements, and the Banner SMRPRLE/SMRALIB rule structures. Supports degree audit processing and academic advising. Each record represents one requirement block within a program's degree plan.

attributes.name: degree_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each degree requirement block within a program's degree plan. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree or certificate) to which this requirement block belongs. Links to the curriculum program master.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: Degree requirements are often mandated by accreditation standards (ABET mandates math/science hours, AACSB mandates business core). Linking degree_requirement to accreditation_standard enables accredi

attributes.name: approving_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Degree requirements are governed and approved by specific academic departments for catalog management, curriculum committee workflows, and accreditation self-study documentation. A domain expert expec

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.description: FK to curriculum.cip_code

attributes.name: concentration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.concentration. Business justification: degree_requirement currently has concentration_code (STRING) to identify which concentration a requirement applies to. This should be normalized to a FK relationship to the concentration master table.

attributes.name: plo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary Program Learning Outcome (PLO) that this requirement block is mapped to in the curriculum assessment framework. Supports assurance of learning and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning; ABET Student Outcomes

attributes.name: prerequisite_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to another degree requirement block that must be completed before this block can be satisfied. Supports prerequisite chain modeling within the degree plan structure.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE prerequisite rule; institutional degree sequencing policy

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Specific degree requirements are mandated by regulatory bodies (state nursing boards mandate clinical hours, state education boards mandate pedagogy credits, bar associations mandate law curriculum).

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The accreditation body whose standards this requirement block is designed to satisfy (e.g., AACSB for business programs, ABET for engineering). Supports accreditation self-study documentation and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AACSB|ABET|ABA|LCME|SACSCOC|HLC|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC|NCAA|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 5; SACSCOC Standard 10; HLC Criteria 4

attributes.name: allow_concurrent_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether courses taken concurrently (simultaneously enrolled in two courses that satisfy the same block) may both count toward this requirement block (True). Prevents double-counting when False.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional concurrent enrollment policy

attributes.name: allow_substitution
attributes.description: Indicates whether course substitutions are permitted within this requirement block (True). When True, an academic advisor may substitute an equivalent course via a formal substitution/waiver process tracked in Banner SMRALIB.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRALIB substitution rule; institutional academic policy

attributes.name: allow_test_credit
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit earned through standardized examinations (AP, CLEP, IB, DSST) may be applied toward this requirement block (True). Supports prior learning assessment (PLA) policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; College Board AP/CLEP policy; institutional PLA policy

attributes.name: allow_transfer_credit
attributes.description: Indicates whether transfer credit may be applied toward this requirement block (True). Governs articulation agreement enforcement and transfer credit evaluation workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; SACSCOC transfer credit policy; institutional articulation agreement standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of this requirement block within the institutional curriculum approval workflow (e.g., curriculum committee review, faculty senate approval). Tracks the governance lifecycle from draft through final approval.
attributes.references: Institutional curriculum governance policy; SACSCOC Standard 6.2; HLC Criteria 5A

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this requirement block received final institutional approval from the curriculum committee or faculty governance body. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: Institutional curriculum governance policy; SACSCOC; HLC

attributes.name: approving_body
attributes.description: Name of the institutional governance body that approved this requirement block (e.g., 'Undergraduate Curriculum Committee', 'Graduate Council', 'Faculty Senate'). Supports audit trail for accreditation and compliance reviews.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 6.2; HLC Criteria 5A; institutional shared governance policy

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The academic catalog year (e.g., 2024) under which this requirement block is effective. Students are typically held to the catalog year in effect at the time of their enrollment or program declaration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; SACSCOC; HLC accreditation standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this degree requirement record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Institutional data governance policy; FERPA audit requirements

attributes.name: degree_type
attributes.description: The type of academic credential (degree or certificate) to which this requirement block belongs (e.g., BA, BS, MBA, PhD, certificate). Drives degree audit differentiation across credential types within the same program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BA|BS|BFA|BBA|MA|MS|MBA|MFA|PhD|EdD|JD|MD|certificate|associate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS completions survey; Ellucian Banner degree type codes; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: diversity_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block fulfills an institutional diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) general education or program requirement. Supports diversity curriculum reporting and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Institutional DEI curriculum policy; HLC Criteria 1C; SACSCOC Standard 7.3

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this requirement block is effective and enforceable in degree audit processing. Students entering the program on or after this date are subject to this requirement block.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE effective term; institutional catalog policy

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date after which this requirement block is no longer enforced for new students. Null for currently active blocks. Supports catalog year versioning and sunset of deprecated requirement structures.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE expiration term; institutional catalog policy

attributes.name: is_repeatable
attributes.description: Indicates whether courses within this requirement block may be repeated for additional credit toward the requirement (True) or whether repeat attempts are excluded from credit hour totals (False).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional repeat course policy

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block is mandatory (True) or optional/advisory (False) for degree completion. Mandatory blocks must be satisfied before degree clearance is granted.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional degree audit policy

attributes.name: level_code
attributes.description: Academic level at which this requirement block applies: UG (Undergraduate), GR (Graduate), PF (Professional), DC (Doctoral). Ensures degree audit rules are applied only to students at the appropriate academic level.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner academic level codes; IPEDS level-of-study definitions

attributes.name: max_credit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of credit hours (CR) that may be applied toward this requirement block. Caps the number of credits counted from elective or free-elective pools in degree audit processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional degree audit policy

attributes.name: max_transfer_credit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of transfer credit hours that may be applied toward this specific requirement block. Enforces institutional transfer credit caps at the block level, complementing the program-level residency requirement.
attributes.references: SACSCOC transfer credit policy; Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE transfer limit; institutional articulation agreement

attributes.name: min_course_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of distinct courses a student must complete within this requirement block, independent of credit hour totals. Used when a block requires completion of a specific number of courses (e.g., 'complete at least 3 courses from the following list').
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional degree audit policy

attributes.name: min_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours (CR) a student must complete within this requirement block to satisfy the degree requirement. Expressed in semester credit hours per federal definition (34 CFR 600.2).
attributes.references: 34 CFR 600.2 (Credit Hour definition); Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; SACSCOC; HLC

attributes.name: min_gpa
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative or block-level Grade Point Average (GPA) a student must achieve within this requirement group to satisfy the requirement. Supports Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) enforcement and degree clearance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; FERPA; U.S. Department of Education SAP regulations (34 CFR 668.34)

attributes.name: min_grade
attributes.description: Minimum letter grade a student must earn in individual courses within this requirement block for those courses to count toward the requirement (e.g., 'C', 'C-', 'B'). Enforced during degree audit course-level evaluation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional grading policy; AACSB; ABET program standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text advisory notes or special instructions associated with this requirement block, as displayed to academic advisors and students in degree audit reports and advising worksheets. May include waiver conditions, special circumstances, or catalog footnotes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE notes field; institutional advising policy

attributes.name: oer_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether courses satisfying this requirement block are designated as using Open Educational Resources (OER), reducing or eliminating textbook costs for students. Supports affordability reporting and OER initiative tracking.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education OER initiative; institutional affordability policy; IPEDS student cost reporting

attributes.name: requirement_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this requirement block within the Banner SMRPRLE/SMRALIB rule structure (e.g., CORE-ENG-2024, ELEC-BUS-CONC). Used in degree audit processing and advising reports.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE rule code; NACUBO curriculum standards

attributes.name: requirement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the requirement block as it appears in the academic catalog and degree audit (e.g., 'Core Curriculum', 'Business Concentration Electives', 'Capstone Experience').
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional catalog standards

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the requirement block. 'active' blocks are enforced in degree audits; 'superseded' blocks are replaced by a newer version; 'pending_approval' blocks are in curriculum committee review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional curriculum governance policy

attributes.name: requirement_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the requirement block indicating its role in the degree plan. Drives degree audit logic and advising workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|elective|concentration|general_education|capstone|residency|free_elective|cognate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE rule type; SACSCOC; HLC; AACSB; ABET curriculum standards

attributes.name: residency_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours within this requirement block that must be earned in residence at the awarding institution (not via transfer, AP, CLEP, or prior learning assessment). Supports accreditation residency standards.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 10.7; HLC Criteria 4B; Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE residency rule

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this requirement block within the program's degree plan. Controls the display order in degree audit reports, academic advising worksheets, and catalog publications.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE sequence; institutional catalog standards

attributes.name: slo_alignment
attributes.description: Free-text or structured reference to the Student Learning Outcomes (SLOs) or Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs) that this requirement block is designed to develop or assess. Supports curriculum mapping and accreditation quality assurance reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 8.2; HLC Criteria 4A; AACSB Assurance of Learning standards; ABET Student Outcomes

attributes.name: smralib_rule_code
attributes.description: The native area/list rule code from Ellucian Banner's SMRALIB (Student Module Requirements Area List) table associated with this requirement block. Identifies the specific course list or area rule used in degree audit processing.

attributes.name: smrprle_rule_code
attributes.description: The native rule code from Ellucian Banner's SMRPRLE (Student Module Requirements Program Rule) table that corresponds to this requirement block. Used for direct traceability to the system of record and degree audit engine.

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block is classified as part of a Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) designated program area. Relevant for OPT STEM extension eligibility reporting and federal STEM program tracking.
attributes.references: DHS STEM OPT extension regulations; U.S. Department of Education STEM designation; IPEDS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this degree requirement record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Institutional data governance policy; FERPA audit requirements

attributes.name: writing_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block includes or requires writing-intensive courses as part of the institution's writing across the curriculum (WAC) or writing in the disciplines (WID) program.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 9.1; HLC Criteria 4A; institutional general education writing requirement

products.name: prerequisite_rule
products.description: Defines prerequisite, corequisite, and anti-requisite relationships for courses, enforcing enrollment eligibility rules during registration. Captures the controlling course (the course requiring the prerequisite), the required course(s) or standardized test scores (SAT, ACT, AP, placement exam), minimum grade threshold (e.g., C or better), concurrent enrollment allowance for corequisites, override permission levels (instructor, department chair, registrar), and complex Boolean logic (AND/OR groupings, nested conditions). Supports real-time registration enforcement in SIS (Banner SFAREGS), academic advising, and degree planning tools.

attributes.name: prerequisite_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the prerequisite rule record. Primary key for the prerequisite_rule data product in the curriculum domain.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic program (major, minor, or certificate) in which a student must be enrolled to satisfy this prerequisite rule. Applicable only when program_enrollment_required is True.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: approving_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Prerequisite rules require faculty or administrator approval for curriculum governance audit trails and accreditation documentation. The existing approved_by is a denormalized text field; a proper FK

attributes.name: articulation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the articulation agreement under which this prerequisite rule may be satisfied by a course completed at a partner institution. Links to the curriculum domain articulation agreement product for transfer pathway validation.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SHATAEQ

attributes.name: effective_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Prerequisite rules activate at specific term boundaries for registration enforcement. SIS prerequisite checking requires term-specific rule activation for accurate student registration validation. Rep

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic department that owns and administers this prerequisite rule. Determines which department chair has override authority and which curriculum committee reviews rule changes.

attributes.name: parent_rule_prerequisite_rule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent prerequisite rule record in a nested Boolean condition hierarchy. Null for top-level rules. Enables recursive evaluation of complex prerequisite trees.

attributes.name: primary_prerequisite_controlling_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the course that owns this prerequisite rule — the course a student is attempting to register for. This is the 'gating' course whose enrollment eligibility is governed by this rule.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: advisory_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that this rule is displayed as an academic advising recommendation in degree planning tools but does not generate a hard registration block in the SIS. Distinct from sis_enforcement_flag: a rule may be SIS-enforced as a soft warning but still be advisory.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFAREGS; NACADA Academic Advising Standards

attributes.name: ap_credit_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Advanced Placement (AP) exam credit awarded by the institution can satisfy this prerequisite rule. When True, qualifying AP scores on file in the SIS are evaluated during registration.
attributes.references: College Board AP Program; Ellucian Banner SOATEST

attributes.name: applicable_term_end
attributes.description: Banner-format term code (YYYYTT) representing the last academic term in which this prerequisite rule is enforced. Null for rules with no planned end term. Used to sunset rules aligned with curriculum revision cycles.

attributes.name: boolean_operator
attributes.description: Logical operator used to combine this rule with sibling rules within the same rule group. 'AND' requires all conditions in the group to be met; 'OR' requires at least one; 'NOT' excludes students who have completed the referenced course (anti-requisite logic).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The academic catalog year (e.g., '2024-2025') in which this prerequisite rule was first published. Students are typically held to the prerequisite rules of their catalog year for degree planning and articulation agreement purposes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC

attributes.name: class_standing_required
attributes.description: Minimum academic class standing a student must have achieved to enroll in the controlling course. Derived from cumulative credit hours earned per institutional policy (e.g., 'junior' requires 60+ credit hours).

attributes.name: concurrent_enrollment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a student may be simultaneously enrolled in the required course and the controlling course within the same term to satisfy a corequisite rule. True for corequisites; typically False for standard prerequisites.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFAREGS; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prerequisite rule record was first created in the system of record (Ellucian Banner or the curriculum management system). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: curriculum_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the institutional curriculum committee formally approved this prerequisite rule. Required for accreditation documentation (AACSB, ABET, HLC) and academic quality assurance records.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 5; SACSCOC

attributes.name: dfw_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prerequisite rule was established or modified in response to analysis of the DFW (D-grade, F-grade, Withdrawal) rate for the controlling course. Supports institutional research and academic quality assurance reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; NACADA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this prerequisite rule becomes enforceable in the SIS registration system. Rules are applied to all registration attempts on or after this date for the applicable term.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this prerequisite rule is no longer enforced. Null for rules with no planned end date. Used when a curriculum revision sunsets an existing prerequisite requirement.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this prerequisite rule was most recently reviewed by the curriculum committee or department, regardless of whether any changes were made. Supports periodic review cycles required by accreditation bodies (HLC, SACSCOC, AACSB).
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC; AACSB Standard 4

attributes.name: minimum_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours (CR) a student must have earned overall or in a specific subject area prior to enrolling in the controlling course. Used for class-standing prerequisites (e.g., 'Junior standing: 60+ credit hours').
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; IPEDS Credit Hour Definition

attributes.name: minimum_gpa
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative GPA (Grade Point Average) a student must maintain to satisfy this prerequisite rule. Commonly used for upper-division or honors course prerequisites (e.g., 3.000 GPA required).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGASTDN; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: minimum_grade
attributes.description: The minimum letter grade a student must have earned in the required course to satisfy this prerequisite. For example, 'C' means a grade of C or better is required. Null when the rule type is 'test_score' or when any passing grade is acceptable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHAGRDE; AACRAO Academic Record and Transcript Guide

attributes.name: minimum_grade_points
attributes.description: Numeric GPA (Grade Point Average) equivalent of the minimum grade threshold (e.g., 2.00 for a C grade on a 4.0 scale). Supports automated SIS enforcement when letter-grade comparison is insufficient for transfer or non-standard grading schemes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHAGRDE; AACRAO Academic Record and Transcript Guide

attributes.name: minimum_test_score
attributes.description: The minimum score a student must achieve on the specified standardized test (test_type / test_subject_code) to satisfy this prerequisite rule. Scale varies by test (e.g., 550 for SAT Math, 22 for ACT, 3 for AP exam).
attributes.references: College Board; ACT Inc.; ETS; Ellucian Banner SOATEST

attributes.name: nesting_level
attributes.description: Depth of this rule within a nested Boolean condition tree (0 = top-level, 1 = first nested group, 2 = second nested group, etc.). Supports complex prerequisite structures such as '(A AND B) OR (C AND D)'.

attributes.name: override_permission_level
attributes.description: Highest authority level permitted to grant a prerequisite override for a student who does not meet this rule. 'none' means no override is allowed; 'instructor' allows the course instructor to waive; 'department_chair' requires chair approval; 'registrar' requires Registrar office action; 'dean' requires dean-level approval.

attributes.name: override_requires_documentation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a prerequisite override request must be accompanied by supporting documentation (e.g., transfer transcript, test score report, instructor approval form) before the SIS will permit enrollment.

attributes.name: program_enrollment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student must be actively enrolled in a specific academic program or major to satisfy this prerequisite rule. When True, the program_id field identifies the required program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGASTDN; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Academic justification for why this prerequisite rule exists, as documented during the curriculum approval process. Used in accreditation self-studies (AACSB, ABET, HLC) to demonstrate alignment between course prerequisites and Student Learning Outcomes (SLOs).
attributes.references: AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 5; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Institution-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this prerequisite rule within the SIS (e.g., PREREQ-CALC1-001). Used for cross-system reference in Banner SFAREGS and academic advising tools.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Human-readable narrative description of the prerequisite rule as it appears in the course catalog and student-facing degree planning tools (e.g., 'Students must complete MATH 1510 with a grade of C or better, or achieve a score of 550 or higher on the SAT Math section').
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; IPEDS Course Catalog Standards

attributes.name: rule_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this rule within its rule group, controlling the evaluation sequence for nested Boolean logic. Lower sequence numbers are evaluated first.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the prerequisite rule. 'active' rules are enforced in real-time SIS registration; 'pending_approval' rules are awaiting curriculum committee sign-off; 'retired' rules are preserved for historical audit.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the enrollment eligibility rule. 'prerequisite' requires prior completion; 'corequisite' requires concurrent enrollment; 'anti_requisite' prohibits enrollment if the course was already taken; 'pre_or_corequisite' allows either; 'test_score' requires a qualifying standardized test score.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: sis_enforcement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prerequisite rule is actively enforced in real-time by the Student Information System (SIS) during the Banner SFAREGS registration process. When False, the rule is advisory only and does not block enrollment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFAREGS; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: test_subject_code
attributes.description: Subject area code for the standardized test component that must meet the minimum score threshold (e.g., 'MATH' for SAT Math, 'ENG' for ACT English, 'CALC' for AP Calculus AB). Used in conjunction with test_type and minimum_test_score.
attributes.references: College Board; ACT Inc.; Ellucian Banner SOATEST

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Type of standardized test whose score may satisfy this prerequisite rule when rule_type is 'test_score'. Includes SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test), ACT (American College Testing), AP (Advanced Placement), CLEP, TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), IELTS (International English Language Testing System), GRE (Graduate Record Examination), GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), or institutional PLACEMENT exam. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAT|ACT|AP|CLEP|TOEFL|IELTS|GRE|GMAT|PLACEMENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: College Board; ACT Inc.; ETS; Ellucian Banner SOATEST

attributes.name: transfer_credit_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether an equivalent course completed at another institution and accepted as transfer credit can satisfy this prerequisite rule. When True, the SIS evaluates transfer equivalency records during registration validation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHATAEQ; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this prerequisite rule record. Used for incremental ETL (Extract Transform Load) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and for audit trail compliance.

products.name: slo
products.description: Student Learning Outcome (SLO) master record defining the measurable competencies students are expected to demonstrate upon completing a course. Captures outcome statement, Bloom's taxonomy level, assessment method, alignment to accreditation standards (AACSB, ABET, HLC), active status, and the owning course or program. Serves as the foundational unit for course-level assessment and curriculum mapping. Distinct from PLO (Program Learning Outcome) which is program-scoped.
products.reference: SLO (Student Learning Outcome) — HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: slo_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Student Learning Outcome (SLO) record in the curriculum domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Curriculum Module; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Optional reference to the academic program to which this SLO contributes, enabling curriculum mapping from course-level SLOs up to Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs). Nullable when the SLO is course-scoped only.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Program Catalog; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3

attributes.name: accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: SLOs are mapped to accreditation standards (AACSB, ABET, HLC, SACSCOC) as required evidence in accreditation self-studies. A structured FK replaces the plain-text aacsb_standard_ref/abet_outcome_ref/h

attributes.name: course_id
attributes.description: Reference to the course with which this Student Learning Outcome (SLO) is associated. Each SLO is scoped to a specific course in the curriculum catalog.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Course Catalog; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: faculty_lead_instructor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to faculty.instructor. Business justification: Accreditation bodies (HLC, SACSCOC) require identifying the qualified faculty member responsible for each SLO's assessment cycle. The current faculty_lead is a denormalized text field; a proper FK ena

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: SLOs are owned by academic departments for SACSCOC assessment reporting, program review cycles, and accreditation self-studies. The existing owner_department is a denormalized text field; replacing it

attributes.name: plo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.plo. Business justification: Student Learning Outcomes (SLOs) are directly aligned to Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs) — this is a foundational curriculum design relationship. slo.plo_alignment is a denormalized STRING field capt

attributes.name: superseded_by_slo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLO record that replaces this one when a substantive revision creates a new SLO version. Nullable for current active SLOs. Enables curriculum lineage tracing and ensures historical assessment data can be linked to the correct outcome version.
attributes.references: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: aacsb_standard_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standard Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific AACSB International Assurance of Learning (AoL) standard or learning goal to which this SLO is aligned (e.g., 'LG1-LO2: Written Communication'). Required for business school accreditation self-studies and continuous improvement reporting submitted to AACSB.
attributes.references: AACSB International Assurance of Learning Standards (2020 Business Accreditation Standards)

attributes.name: abet_outcome_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ABET Criterion 3 student outcome to which this SLO is aligned (e.g., 'Outcome 1: Apply knowledge of mathematics, science, and engineering'). Required for engineering and computing program accreditation self-studies submitted to ABET.
attributes.references: ABET Criteria for Accrediting Engineering Programs, Criterion 3 Student Outcomes

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLO was formally approved by the curriculum committee or academic governance body. Required for accreditation self-study documentation to demonstrate systematic curriculum review processes.
attributes.references: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 5.A

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of this SLO within the institutional curriculum approval workflow. Pending means submitted for review; approved means formally ratified by the curriculum committee; rejected means not approved; revision_required means returned to the originator for changes. Supports governance and QA processes.
attributes.references: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 5.A; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the curriculum committee, faculty governance body, or academic officer who formally approved this SLO. Provides an audit trail for accreditation documentation and institutional governance records.
attributes.references: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 5.A

attributes.name: assessment_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently this SLO is formally assessed and reported. Every_term means assessed each time the course is offered; annual means once per academic year; biennial means every two years; rotating means assessed on a departmentally defined rotation schedule. Drives assessment planning calendars.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; Institutional Assessment Plan

attributes.name: assessment_level
attributes.description: Scope at which this SLO is assessed: course-level (within a single course section), program-level (aggregated across multiple course sections within a program), or institutional-level (contributing to institution-wide general education or core competency assessment).
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to assess student attainment of this SLO (e.g., written exam, rubric-scored essay, lab report, oral presentation, portfolio, standardized test, capstone project). Informs Canvas LMS gradebook configuration and accreditation assessment plans. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: written_exam|rubric_essay|lab_report|oral_presentation|portfolio|standardized_test|capstone_project|simulation|case_study|performance_task — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B; Canvas LMS Assessment Module

attributes.name: assessment_tool
attributes.description: Specific instrument or tool used to measure student performance on this SLO (e.g., AAC&U VALUE Rubric, ETS Major Field Test, departmental rubric name, standardized exam code). Provides traceability between the SLO and its measurement instrument for accreditation evidence.
attributes.references: AAC&U VALUE Rubrics; ETS Major Field Tests; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: banner_outcome_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this SLO as stored in Ellucian Banner's academic history and curriculum modules. Used for ETL reconciliation between Banner (system of record) and the Databricks Silver Layer data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System — Academic History Module

attributes.name: blooms_domain
attributes.description: Domain of learning as classified by Bloom's Taxonomy: cognitive (knowledge and intellectual skills), affective (attitudes, values, and feelings), or psychomotor (physical and procedural skills). Supports comprehensive curriculum design and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: Bloom's Taxonomy (Bloom et al., 1956; Krathwohl et al., 1964; Simpson, 1972); ABET Criterion 3; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

attributes.name: blooms_taxonomy_level
attributes.description: Cognitive level of the learning outcome as classified by Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001). Drives assessment design and curriculum rigor analysis. Values: remember, understand, apply, analyze, evaluate, create — ordered from lower-order to higher-order thinking.
attributes.references: Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001); AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code associated with the discipline of this SLO, following the NCES taxonomy (e.g., 52.0301 for Accounting). Used for IPEDS reporting, program benchmarking, and cross-institutional curriculum comparisons.
attributes.references: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) 2020; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLO record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail entry point for data governance, lineage tracking, and accreditation evidence of when outcomes were formally documented.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Institutional Data Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: credit_hour_type
attributes.description: Type of instructional activity associated with the course section in which this SLO is assessed. Relevant for determining appropriate assessment methods and Carnegie Unit compliance. Values align with federal credit hour definitions under 34 CFR 600.2.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 600.2 (Federal Credit Hour Definition); U.S. Department of Education; SACSCOC Credit Hour Policy

attributes.name: curriculum_map_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level at which this SLO is addressed in the curriculum map for the associated program: introduced (first exposure), developed (reinforced and practiced), or mastered (demonstrated at capstone level). Standard taxonomy used in AACSB and ABET curriculum mapping documentation.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; Curriculum Mapping Best Practices (Harden, 2001)

attributes.name: delivery_modality
attributes.description: Instructional delivery modality for which this SLO is applicable. Some SLOs may be modality-specific (e.g., lab-based outcomes only apply to face-to-face sections). Supports modality-disaggregated assessment reporting required by accreditors for distance education programs.
attributes.references: HLC Distance Education Criteria; SACSCOC Distance and Correspondence Education Policy; U.S. Department of Education Distance Education Regulations (34 CFR 600.2)

attributes.name: effective_term
attributes.description: The academic term in which this SLO first became effective, expressed as a four-digit year followed by a term code (e.g., 2024FA for Fall 2024, 2025SP for Spring 2025). Supports term-over-term curriculum change tracking and accreditation cycle reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Term Table; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: hlc_criterion_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the specific HLC (Higher Learning Commission) Criterion for Accreditation to which this SLO contributes evidence (e.g., 'Criterion 4.B: The institution demonstrates a commitment to educational achievement and improvement through ongoing assessment of student learning'). Supports regional accreditation self-study documentation.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation, Criterion 4: Teaching and Learning — Evaluation and Improvement

attributes.name: is_core_outcome
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLO is designated as a core or primary outcome for the course (True) versus a supplementary or supporting outcome (False). Core outcomes are typically required to be assessed every term; supplementary outcomes may be assessed on a rotating schedule.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; Institutional Assessment Policy

attributes.name: is_general_education
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLO is designated as a General Education (Gen Ed) outcome (True), meaning it contributes to the institution's general education assessment framework and may be reported to regional accreditors as evidence of broad learning competencies.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation 3.B; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Standard 9.1; AAC&U LEAP Essential Learning Outcomes

attributes.name: is_stem_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLO is associated with a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) designated course or program. Relevant for NSF grant reporting, IPEDS STEM program classification, and OPT extension eligibility tracking for international students.
attributes.references: NSF (National Science Foundation) STEM Education Reporting; IPEDS STEM CIP Code List; U.S. Department of Homeland Security STEM OPT Extension

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLO was most recently reviewed for currency, rigor, and alignment with program goals. Accreditors require evidence of systematic, ongoing review of learning outcomes. Supports identification of SLOs overdue for review.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: lms_outcome_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this SLO as recorded in the Canvas LMS Outcomes module. Enables bidirectional traceability between the authoritative curriculum data product and the LMS gradebook alignment, supporting automated assessment data collection from Canvas.
attributes.references: Canvas LMS Outcomes and Mastery Connect; IMS Global Learning Consortium Outcomes Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this SLO as part of the institution's continuous improvement and assessment cycle. Enables proactive curriculum governance and ensures compliance with accreditor-mandated review frequencies.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; Institutional Assessment Calendar

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, clarifications, or implementation guidance related to this SLO. May include notes from curriculum committee reviews, faculty feedback, or accreditor recommendations. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: oer_aligned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary instructional materials used to achieve this SLO are designated as OER (Open Educational Resources), meaning freely available and openly licensed. Supports institutional OER adoption tracking, affordability reporting, and grant compliance for OER initiatives.
attributes.references: Creative Commons Licensing Standards; U.S. Department of Education OER Initiatives; SPARC Open Education

attributes.name: outcome_statement
attributes.description: Full narrative statement describing the measurable competency students are expected to demonstrate upon completing the course. Written in observable, measurable terms aligned with Bloom's Taxonomy (e.g., 'Students will be able to analyze financial statements using ratio analysis'). This is the authoritative text used in syllabi, accreditation self-studies, and curriculum maps.
attributes.references: Bloom's Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001); SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

attributes.name: outcome_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SLO record. Active SLOs are in use for the current or upcoming academic term. Draft SLOs are under development. Under_review SLOs are in the curriculum approval workflow. Retired SLOs are no longer assessed but retained for historical reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Curriculum Workflow; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: performance_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of assessed students expected to meet or exceed the proficiency benchmark for this SLO, as defined in the assessment plan (e.g., 70.00 means 70% of students must demonstrate proficiency). Used to determine whether the SLO has been 'met' in annual assessment reporting and accreditation self-studies.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: proficiency_benchmark
attributes.description: Qualitative or quantitative description of the minimum acceptable performance standard for this SLO (e.g., 'Score of 3 or higher on a 4-point rubric', 'Correctly answers 75% of exam items mapped to this outcome'). Complements performance_threshold_pct with narrative context for accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; AAC&U VALUE Rubrics

attributes.name: retirement_term
attributes.description: The academic term in which this SLO was retired or superseded. Nullable for active SLOs. Enables historical curriculum mapping and ensures retired outcomes are excluded from current assessment cycles while remaining available for longitudinal analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Curriculum Workflow; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: sacscoc_standard_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SACSCOC (Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges) Principles of Accreditation standard to which this SLO is aligned (e.g., 'Standard 8.2: Student Outcomes: Educational Programs'). Applicable for institutions in the SACSCOC region.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation: Foundations for Quality Enhancement, Standard 8.2

attributes.name: scorm_objective_code
attributes.description: Identifier mapping this SLO to a SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) learning objective within a packaged e-learning module deployed in the LMS. Enables automated tracking of objective completion data from SCORM-compliant content packages.
attributes.references: SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) 2004 4th Edition; ADL Initiative; IMS Global

attributes.name: slo_code
attributes.description: Institutionally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this SLO within the course or program context. Used in accreditation reports, curriculum maps, and assessment tracking systems. Example: ACCT301-SLO-001.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLO record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trails, and curriculum change management processes.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Institutional Data Governance Policy; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Integer version number of this SLO record, incremented each time the outcome statement, assessment method, or benchmark is substantively revised through the curriculum approval workflow. Enables longitudinal tracking of outcome evolution across accreditation cycles.
attributes.references: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

products.name: plo
products.description: Program Learning Outcome (PLO) master record defining the measurable competencies graduates of an academic program are expected to demonstrate. Captures outcome statement, associated accreditation standard (AACSB, ABET, SACSCOC), assessment cycle, target performance benchmark, and alignment to institutional mission. PLOs are mapped to SLOs through the slo_plo_mapping association. Supports program-level assessment reporting and accreditation self-studies.
products.reference: PLO (Program Learning Outcome) — Regional Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: plo_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Program Learning Outcome (PLO) record in the curriculum data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Curriculum Module; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree or certificate program) to which this PLO belongs. Links PLO to its parent program record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Program Catalog; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: PLOs must align to accreditation standards as required by SACSCOC, HLC, AACSB, and ABET. The plain-text accreditation_standard_code is a denormalization of compliance.accreditation_standard. A FK enab

attributes.name: assessment_lead_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty member or staff person designated as the primary lead responsible for coordinating assessment of this PLO within the program.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Workday HCM Employee Record

attributes.name: prior_version_plo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous version of this PLO record if it was revised and a new record created. Enables curriculum change lineage tracking and accreditation historical documentation.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Curriculum Catalog

attributes.name: accrediting_body
attributes.description: Name of the accrediting body whose standards this PLO is designed to satisfy. Supports multi-accreditor programs (e.g., a business school may be subject to both AACSB and HLC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AACSB|ABET|SACSCOC|HLC|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC|ABA|LCME|none|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AACSB International; ABET; SACSCOC; HLC; MSCHE; NWCCU; NECHE; WSCUC; ABA; LCME

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PLO was formally approved through the institution's curriculum governance process (e.g., curriculum committee, faculty senate, academic affairs). Required for accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.A; Ellucian Banner Curriculum Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or title of the governance body or individual who formally approved this PLO (e.g., 'Undergraduate Curriculum Committee', 'Dean of Academic Affairs'). Provides audit trail for accreditation self-studies.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.A

attributes.name: assessment_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which this PLO is formally assessed and reported: annual, biennial (every two years), triennial (every three years), continuous, or other. Drives the assessment calendar and accreditation reporting schedule.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B; AACSB Standard 4

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to assess student achievement of this PLO (e.g., capstone project, standardized exam, portfolio review, rubric-scored assignment, licensure exam, employer survey). Documented for accreditation assessment plans.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: assessment_tool_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary instrument or tool used to assess this PLO (e.g., 'Capstone Project Rubric', 'ETS Major Field Test', 'NCLEX-RN', 'CPA Exam', 'Portfolio Assessment Rubric'). Supports assessment plan documentation.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: bloom_taxonomy_level
attributes.description: Cognitive level of the learning outcome as classified by Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001): remember, understand, apply, analyze, evaluate, or create. Used in curriculum design quality assurance and SLO alignment.
attributes.references: Bloom's Revised Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001); SACSCOC QEP Guidelines

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: Academic catalog year in which this PLO was first published (e.g., '2023-2024'). Ties the PLO to the official program catalog for a given academic year, supporting student rights under catalog year policies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Catalog; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; FERPA

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code (XX.XXXX format) assigned by the U.S. Department of Education classifying the instructional program discipline to which this PLO belongs. Required for IPEDS reporting and federal program approval.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education CIP 2020 Taxonomy; IPEDS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: course_count
attributes.description: Number of courses in the program curriculum that are mapped to this PLO. Provides a quick indicator of instructional coverage breadth. Note: authoritative count is derived from course-PLO mapping associations.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PLO record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for curriculum governance and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: FERPA; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Audit Trail

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: Academic credential level of the program to which this PLO applies: certificate, associate, bachelor, master, doctoral, or professional. Determines the rigor and complexity expectations for the outcome. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: certificate|associate|bachelor|master|doctoral|professional|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Degree Level Classifications; IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: direct_indirect_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary assessment method for this PLO is direct (measures student performance on the outcome directly, e.g., exam, project), indirect (measures student perception or satisfaction, e.g., survey, alumni feedback), or both. Accreditors typically require at least one direct measure per PLO.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: domain_area
attributes.description: Disciplinary or thematic domain area to which this PLO belongs within the program (e.g., 'Quantitative Reasoning', 'Ethical Leadership', 'Technical Communication', 'Research Methods'). Supports curriculum mapping and outcome clustering for assessment reporting.
attributes.references: AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 3; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PLO became or becomes officially effective for the program. Marks the start of the assessment obligation for this outcome.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Curriculum Catalog

attributes.name: improvement_action_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting 'closing the loop' actions taken based on assessment results for this PLO (e.g., curriculum changes, pedagogical adjustments, resource additions). Required by accreditors to demonstrate use of assessment data for improvement.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: institutional_mission_alignment
attributes.description: Narrative description of how this PLO aligns to the institution's stated mission, strategic plan, or core values. Required for regional accreditation self-studies demonstrating mission-driven curriculum design.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 7.1; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 1.A; NECHE Standard 1

attributes.name: is_accreditation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PLO is mandated by a specific accrediting body's standards (True) or is an institutionally defined outcome beyond accreditor minimums (False). Supports gap analysis during accreditation self-study preparation.
attributes.references: AACSB Accreditation Standards; ABET General Criteria; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: is_core_outcome
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PLO is designated as a core or required outcome for all graduates of the program (True), as opposed to a concentration-specific or elective outcome (False). Core outcomes are typically required for all accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 3

attributes.name: is_general_education
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PLO is also designated as a General Education (Gen Ed) outcome applicable across multiple programs at the institution (True) or is program-specific (False). Supports institutional general education assessment reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 9.6; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 3.B

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PLO was most recently reviewed by the program faculty or curriculum committee, regardless of whether changes were made. Supports continuous improvement documentation required by accreditors.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PLO is next scheduled for formal review by the program faculty or curriculum committee. Drives the assessment calendar and ensures timely accreditation compliance.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text administrative notes or contextual information about this PLO not captured in other structured fields. May include rationale for outcome design, cross-program alignment notes, or accreditor feedback.

attributes.name: outcome_category
attributes.description: Broad category classifying the type of learning outcome: knowledge (cognitive understanding), skill (applied ability), disposition (attitude or value), competency (integrated performance), or other. Supports Bloom's Taxonomy alignment and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: Bloom's Taxonomy; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 3

attributes.name: outcome_statement
attributes.description: Full narrative statement describing the measurable competency, knowledge, skill, or disposition that graduates of the program are expected to demonstrate upon completion. Written in observable, assessable language per accreditation standards.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; ABET Criterion 3; AACSB Standard 4

attributes.name: outcome_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PLO: draft (being developed), active (in use for assessment), under_review (undergoing curriculum revision), suspended (temporarily paused), or retired (no longer assessed). Governs whether the PLO appears in active assessment plans.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Curriculum Workflow

attributes.name: plo_code
attributes.description: Institutionally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this PLO within the program (e.g., PLO-01, CS-PLO-03). Used in accreditation self-studies and curriculum mapping documents.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: proficiency_scale_max
attributes.description: Maximum possible score on the assessment instrument used to measure this PLO (e.g., 4.0 for a rubric, 100 for a percentage scale). Provides context for interpreting the proficiency threshold score.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4

attributes.name: proficiency_threshold_score
attributes.description: Minimum score or rubric rating a student must achieve on the designated assessment instrument to be counted as meeting this PLO. Expressed in the scale of the assessment tool (e.g., 3.0 on a 4-point rubric, 70 on a 100-point scale).
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: retirement_date
