attributes.description: Date on which this PLO was or will be retired and removed from active assessment plans. Null if the PLO is currently active. Supports historical curriculum audit trails.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Curriculum Catalog

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this PLO within the program's ordered list of learning outcomes (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Used for display ordering in accreditation reports, syllabi, and assessment plans.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standard 4

attributes.name: slo_count
attributes.description: Number of Student Learning Outcomes (SLOs) currently mapped to this PLO through the slo_plo_mapping association. Provides a quick indicator of curriculum coverage depth for this outcome. Note: this is a denormalized convenience field; authoritative count is derived from slo_plo_mapping.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4

attributes.name: strategic_goal_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or label of the institutional strategic plan goal or objective to which this PLO contributes (e.g., 'Strategic Goal 2: Student Success'). Supports institutional effectiveness reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 5.C

attributes.name: target_benchmark_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of assessed students expected to meet or exceed the proficiency threshold for this PLO (e.g., 70.00 means 70% of students must demonstrate proficiency). Used as the success criterion in assessment reporting and accreditation self-studies.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation Section 8.2; AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PLO record was most recently modified. Supports change detection in ETL pipelines and curriculum governance audit trails.
attributes.references: FERPA; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Audit Trail

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this PLO statement (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented when the outcome statement or assessment criteria are substantively revised. Supports curriculum change history and accreditation audit trails.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Ellucian Banner Curriculum Catalog Versioning

products.name: map
products.description: Structured mapping of courses within an academic program to the program's PLOs, showing where each outcome is introduced, reinforced, and mastered across the curriculum sequence. Captures the program, the course, the PLO, the coverage level (I/R/M), the term sequence position, and the assessment instrument used. Supports accreditation reporting (AACSB Assurance of Learning, ABET Criterion 3) and curriculum gap analysis.
products.reference: Curriculum Mapping Matrix — AACSB / ABET Accreditation

attributes.name: map_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each curriculum map record linking a course to a Program Learning Outcome (PLO) within an academic program. Serves as the primary key for this Silver Layer data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic degree or certificate program within which this curriculum map entry exists. Establishes the program-level context for PLO alignment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) — NCES

attributes.name: compliance_accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: Curriculum maps demonstrate how course sequences meet specific accreditor standards. Essential for accreditation self-studies showing standards compliance through curriculum design. Core accreditation

attributes.name: course_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific course in the course catalog that is mapped to the PLO. Identifies which course contributes to the learning outcome.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Course Catalog; Canvas LMS Course Object

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty member (typically the course coordinator or program director) responsible for maintaining this curriculum map entry and ensuring PLO assessment is conducted. Links to the HR employee record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Faculty Records; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Curriculum maps are owned and approved by academic departments (org units) for SACSCOC/AACSB accreditation reporting and curriculum committee governance. A domain expert expects each curriculum map to

attributes.name: plo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Program Learning Outcome (PLO) that this course is mapped to. PLOs define the competencies graduates are expected to demonstrate upon program completion.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year in which this curriculum map entry is effective (e.g., '2024-2025'). Supports versioning of curriculum maps across catalog years and accreditation review cycles.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Calendar; IPEDS; AACSB; ABET

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The accreditation organization whose standards govern this curriculum map entry (e.g., 'AACSB', 'ABET', 'HLC', 'SACSCOC', 'LCME', 'ABA'). Determines which assurance-of-learning or criterion-based reporting requirements apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AACSB|ABET|HLC|SACSCOC|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC|LCME|ABA|AACSB_ABET — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AACSB International; ABET; HLC; SACSCOC; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: accreditation_standard_ref
attributes.description: Specific accreditation standard or criterion that this curriculum map entry satisfies (e.g., 'AACSB Standard 8 - Assurance of Learning', 'ABET Criterion 3 - Student Outcomes'). Enables direct traceability from curriculum map to accreditation evidence.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment of the PLO in this course uses direct evidence (e.g., exams, projects, rubric-scored artifacts), indirect evidence (e.g., surveys, self-reports), or both. Accreditation bodies require a mix of direct and indirect assessment evidence.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The academic catalog year under which this curriculum map entry is published (e.g., '2024-2025'). Students follow degree requirements from their catalog year; curriculum maps must be versioned accordingly for compliance and advising.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Degree Works; FERPA; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code assigned to the academic program by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES). Used for federal reporting (IPEDS), accreditation, and program classification (e.g., '11.0701' for Computer Science).
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) — NCES; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: closing_loop_action
attributes.description: Description of the curricular or instructional improvement action taken in response to PLO assessment results for this course-PLO mapping (e.g., 'Added additional case studies to reinforce analytical reasoning PLO', 'Revised rubric criteria for written communication'). Core component of AACSB Assurance of Learning closing-the-loop documentation.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; Institutional Assessment Policy

attributes.name: college_name
attributes.description: Name of the college or school within the institution that houses the academic program (e.g., 'College of Engineering', 'School of Business'). Used for accreditation unit-level reporting (AACSB, ABET) and institutional analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Structure; AACSB; ABET; IPEDS

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: Indicates the depth at which the PLO is addressed in this course: I = Introduced (first exposure), R = Reinforced (practiced and developed), M = Mastered (demonstrated at program exit level). This I/R/M taxonomy is the standard framework used in AACSB Assurance of Learning and ABET Criterion 3 curriculum mapping.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this curriculum map record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for data governance and accreditation evidence management.
attributes.references: FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours (CR) assigned to the course in this curriculum map entry. Used to weight the course's contribution to the program's total credit hour requirements and to calculate PLO coverage intensity across the curriculum.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Credit Hour Definition (34 CFR 600.2); Ellucian Banner Course Catalog; IPEDS

attributes.name: curriculum_committee_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the curriculum committee formally approved this curriculum map entry. Establishes the official governance record for accreditation audit trails and catalog publication timelines.
attributes.references: Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: The level of the academic credential associated with this program (e.g., 'bachelor', 'master', 'doctoral'). Used to segment curriculum maps by degree tier for accreditation reporting and institutional analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) — NCES; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: delivery_modality
attributes.description: The instructional delivery format for the course in this curriculum map entry: 'in_person' = face-to-face; 'online' = fully asynchronous/synchronous online; 'hybrid' = blended in-person and online; 'hyflex' = simultaneous in-person and online; 'mooc' = Massive Open Online Course (MOOC). Relevant for accreditation distance education reviews.
attributes.references: HLC Distance Education Policy; SACSCOC Distance and Correspondence Education Policy; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic department responsible for delivering the course in this curriculum map entry (e.g., 'CS', 'MGMT', 'ENGR'). Used for departmental curriculum reporting and accreditation unit-level analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Structure; Workday HCM Org Unit; IPEDS

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this curriculum map entry ceases to be effective, typically aligned with a catalog year transition or program revision. Null indicates the entry is currently active. Supports historical curriculum map versioning.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Degree Works; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this curriculum map entry is effective and applicable to students enrolled under the corresponding catalog year. Supports temporal versioning of curriculum maps across accreditation cycles.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Degree Works; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: gap_analysis_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting identified gaps in PLO coverage, redundancies, or areas requiring curriculum revision as identified during curriculum gap analysis reviews. Supports closing-the-loop actions in Assurance of Learning (AoL) cycles.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; Institutional Curriculum Review Policy

attributes.name: is_capstone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course serves as a capstone or culminating experience for the program. Capstone courses are typically the primary site for PLO mastery-level assessment and are highlighted in accreditation self-studies.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: is_oer_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course uses Open Educational Resources (OER) as the primary instructional materials, eliminating or significantly reducing textbook costs for students. Supports institutional OER adoption tracking and affordability reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Open Licensing Policy; Institutional OER Initiative; IPEDS

attributes.name: is_writing_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is designated as writing intensive, requiring substantial written work as a primary mode of learning and assessment. Relevant for general education requirements, accreditation, and curriculum gap analysis for written communication PLOs.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; Institutional General Education Policy; AACSB Communication Competency Standards

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this curriculum map entry was most recently reviewed by the program faculty or curriculum committee. Supports accreditation requirements for regular curriculum review cycles (typically annual or per accreditation cycle).
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation 4.B

attributes.name: map_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this curriculum map entry within the curriculum approval workflow. 'draft' = under initial development; 'active' = approved and in use; 'under_review' = submitted for curriculum committee review; 'approved' = formally approved by governance body; 'retired' = no longer in use.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date by which this curriculum map entry is scheduled for its next formal review. Supports proactive curriculum quality assurance and ensures compliance with accreditation body review cycle requirements.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: performance_target_pct
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of students expected to meet or exceed the proficiency threshold on the PLO assessment in this course (e.g., 70.00 means 70% of students must achieve the target score). Used in Assurance of Learning (AoL) closing-the-loop analysis.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; Institutional Assessment Policy

attributes.name: proficiency_threshold_score
attributes.description: The minimum score or rubric rating a student must achieve on the assessment instrument to be considered proficient on the mapped PLO (e.g., 3.0 on a 4-point rubric, or 75.00 on a 100-point scale). Defines the benchmark for PLO attainment.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; Institutional Assessment Policy

attributes.name: slo_alignment
attributes.description: Description of how the course-level Student Learning Outcome (SLO) aligns with and contributes to the mapped Program Learning Outcome (PLO). Provides the narrative linkage between course-level and program-level assessment for accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation

attributes.name: term_sequence_position
attributes.description: Ordinal position of the course within the program's recommended term sequence (e.g., 1 = first term, 4 = fourth term). Used to visualize the progression of PLO coverage across the curriculum and identify gaps in the learning sequence.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; ABET Criterion 3; Ellucian Banner Degree Works

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this curriculum map record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and identification of stale curriculum map entries requiring review.
attributes.references: FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy; AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Integer version number of this curriculum map entry, incremented each time the mapping is revised through the curriculum approval workflow. Supports audit trail and historical comparison of curriculum map changes across accreditation cycles.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; Institutional Curriculum Governance Policy

products.name: articulation_agreement

Supports transfer student advising, state articulation compliance reporting (e.g., state transfer module requirements), and strategic enrollment partnership management.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Transfer agreements must comply with federal credit hour definitions, state transfer mandates, and accreditation standards for credit acceptance. attributes.name: agreement_status

products.name: transfer_equivalency
products.description: Defines the course-level equivalency mappings within an articulation agreement, specifying how a specific course at a sending institution maps to a course or requirement at the receiving institution. Captures sending institution course, receiving institution course or requirement group, equivalency type (direct, block, elective credit), credit hours awarded, effective term range, and evaluation status. Supports transfer credit evaluation workflows and degree audit processing for transfer students.

attributes.name: transfer_equivalency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transfer equivalency mapping record. Primary key for the transfer equivalency entity.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific academic program if this equivalency mapping is restricted to students in that program. Null if the mapping applies broadly across programs.

attributes.name: articulation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent articulation agreement under which this course equivalency is defined. Links this equivalency to the formal agreement between sending and receiving institutions.

attributes.name: effective_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Transfer equivalencies become effective at specific term start dates for transfer credit evaluation. Registrar operations require term-specific equivalency activation for articulation agreement implem

attributes.name: primary_transfer_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically registrar, department chair, or curriculum committee member) who approved this transfer equivalency mapping.

attributes.name: receiving_course_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific course at the receiving institution that the sending course maps to. Null if the equivalency is to elective credit or a requirement group rather than a specific course.

attributes.name: receiving_institution_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the institution receiving the transfer student. The institution that will award equivalent credit based on this mapping.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Transfer credit evaluations must comply with federal credit hour regulations, accreditation standards for credit acceptance, and state transfer policies. Required for financial aid eligibility and acc

attributes.name: sending_institution_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the institution from which the student is transferring. The originating institution whose course is being evaluated for equivalency.

attributes.name: applies_to_degree_level
attributes.description: The degree level(s) to which this equivalency mapping applies. Restricts the use of the equivalency to specific academic levels.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this transfer equivalency mapping was officially approved for use in transfer credit evaluations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this equivalency mapping. Tracks whether the mapping has been reviewed and approved by the appropriate academic authority.

attributes.name: counts_toward_residency
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit awarded through this equivalency counts toward the receiving institutions residency credit hour requirement for degree completion. False if the credit is transfer credit that does not count toward residency.

attributes.name: course_content_match_level
attributes.description: Assessment of how closely the sending course content aligns with the receiving course content. Exact: nearly identical. Substantial: 75%+ overlap. Partial: 50-74% overlap. Minimal: less than 50% overlap but still transferable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transfer equivalency record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_hours_awarded
attributes.description: The number of credit hours (CR) awarded by the receiving institution for successful completion of the sending course. May differ from the sending course credit hours based on institutional policy.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this transfer equivalency mapping expires or is no longer valid for new evaluations. Null if the mapping is open-ended. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this transfer equivalency mapping becomes active and can be applied to transfer credit evaluations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: equivalency_type
attributes.description: The type of equivalency mapping. Direct: one-to-one course match. Block: multiple courses map to a block of credit. Elective: maps to elective credit hours. General Education: satisfies a general education requirement. Major Requirement: satisfies a major-specific requirement. No Credit: course does not transfer for credit.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the rationale for the equivalency mapping, special conditions, or instructions for transfer credit evaluators. May include syllabus comparison details or accreditation considerations.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this equivalency mapping in the transfer credit evaluation workflow. Active: currently in use. Inactive: temporarily disabled. Pending Review: awaiting approval. Superseded: replaced by newer mapping. Expired: past effective end date.

attributes.name: external_equivalency_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this equivalency mapping in a third-party transfer credit system or statewide articulation database (e.g., state transfer portal, ASSIST system in California).

attributes.name: is_reciprocal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equivalency mapping is reciprocal (bidirectional). True if the receiving institution course also maps back to the sending institution course in reverse transfer scenarios.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transfer equivalency record was most recently updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this equivalency mapping was last reviewed for accuracy and currency. Used to track periodic review cycles required by accreditation or institutional policy. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: learning_outcome_alignment
attributes.description: Assessment of how well the sending course learning outcomes align with the receiving course Student Learning Outcomes (SLO). Used for accreditation and quality assurance purposes.

attributes.name: max_credit_applicable
attributes.description: The maximum number of credit hours (CR) that can be awarded through this equivalency mapping, even if the sending course carries more credit. Used to cap transfer credit in certain scenarios.

attributes.name: min_grade_required
attributes.description: The minimum grade the student must earn in the sending course for the equivalency to apply and credit to be awarded (e.g., C, C-, D). Null if no minimum grade is specified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this equivalency mapping. Ensures mappings remain current with curriculum changes. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: prerequisite_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful completion of the sending course waives prerequisite requirements for subsequent courses at the receiving institution. True if the equivalency satisfies prerequisite chains.

attributes.name: requirement_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the degree requirement group or category that this equivalency satisfies (e.g., CORE-MATH, GEN-ED-SCI, MAJOR-ELEC). Used when the equivalency maps to a requirement rather than a specific course.

attributes.name: sending_course_code
attributes.description: The course code or number at the sending institution that is being mapped for transfer credit. Example: MATH 101, ENG 1301.

attributes.name: sending_course_credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of credit hours (CR) assigned to the course at the sending institution. Used to determine how much credit should be awarded at the receiving institution.

attributes.name: sending_course_subject
attributes.description: The academic subject or discipline area of the sending course (e.g., Mathematics, English, Biology). Used for classification and mapping purposes.

attributes.name: sending_course_title
attributes.description: The official title of the course at the sending institution as it appears in their course catalog.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or module where this equivalency mapping was originally created (e.g., Banner SHATRCE, TES, custom articulation system). Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

products.name: cip_code
products.description: Reference taxonomy record for the Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) maintained by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), updated biennially. Captures CIP code (6-digit hierarchical: XX.XXXX), title, definition, two-digit series (broad field), four-digit series (narrow field), six-digit series (specific program), active/inactive status, STEM designation flag (DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List), and crosswalk mappings to prior CIP editions (2010→2020). Serves as the authoritative classification for IPEDS completions reporting, state authorization applications, OPT/STEM OPT visa eligibility determination, Title IV federal financial aid program eligibility, and institutional research analytics. Updated centrally when NCES publishes new editions; institutional programs reference but do not modify CIP definitions.

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) Code Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CIP code record. Primary key for the CIP code reference taxonomy.

attributes.name: action_code
attributes.description: The type of change applied to this CIP code in the current edition relative to the prior edition. New indicates a newly created code. Revised indicates definition or title changes. Moved indicates reclassification to a different series. Deleted indicates retirement. No change indicates the code is unchanged from the prior edition.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit hierarchical CIP code in format XX.XXXX where the first two digits represent the broad field (series), the middle two represent the narrow field (intermediate grouping), and the last two represent the specific program. This is the authoritative NCES classification code.

attributes.name: cip_definition
attributes.description: Official NCES definition and scope statement for the CIP code. Describes the instructional content, typical courses, and program characteristics that define this classification.

attributes.name: cip_edition_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) Edition Year
attributes.description: The year of the CIP taxonomy edition in which this code was published or last updated (e.g., 2010, 2020). NCES updates the CIP taxonomy biennially.

attributes.name: cip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CIP code. Active codes are valid for current use in IPEDS reporting and program classification. Inactive codes have been retired or superseded. Moved codes have been reclassified to a different CIP code. Deleted codes are no longer valid.

attributes.name: cip_title
attributes.description: Official NCES title for the CIP code. This is the authoritative program name as published by the National Center for Education Statistics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CIP code record was first created in the institutional system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_reference_cip_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related or similar CIP codes that institutions should consider when classifying programs. Used for disambiguation and classification guidance.

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CIP code was retired, superseded, or otherwise discontinued for use in program classification. Null for active codes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CIP code became valid for use in institutional program classification and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: examples
attributes.description: Illustrative examples of specific degree programs, majors, or concentrations that would be classified under this CIP code. Provided by NCES for classification guidance.

attributes.name: four_digit_series
attributes.description: The first four digits of the CIP code (XX.XX format) representing the intermediate or narrow instructional field within the broad series (e.g., 11.01 = Computer and Information Sciences, General).

attributes.name: four_digit_series_title
attributes.description: The official NCES title for the four-digit narrow field series (e.g., Computer and Information Sciences, General).

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reporting Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this CIP code is valid for use in IPEDS completions reporting. Only active CIP codes from the current edition are IPEDS-eligible.

attributes.name: is_stem_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Technology Engineering Mathematics (STEM) Designation Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this CIP code is designated as a STEM program per the Department of Homeland Security STEM Designated Degree Program List. STEM designation affects international student Optional Practical Training (OPT) eligibility and STEM OPT extension eligibility.
attributes.references: DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CIP code record was last updated in the institutional system. Used for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: nces_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) URL
attributes.description: The official NCES web URL for this CIP code definition and detailed classification guidance.

attributes.name: opt_stem_extension_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) STEM Extension Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether international students who complete a degree program in this CIP code are eligible for the 24-month STEM OPT extension beyond the standard 12-month OPT period.

attributes.name: prior_cip_code_2010
attributes.description: The equivalent CIP code from the 2010 edition, if applicable. Used for historical crosswalk mapping and longitudinal analysis of program completions data.

attributes.name: title_iv_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Title IV Federal Financial Aid Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether programs classified under this CIP code are eligible for Title IV federal financial aid. Certain CIP codes (e.g., recreational or avocational programs) may be ineligible for federal aid.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Regulations

attributes.name: two_digit_series
attributes.description: The first two digits of the CIP code representing the broad instructional field or discipline area (e.g., 11 = Computer and Information Sciences, 14 = Engineering, 51 = Health Professions).

attributes.name: two_digit_series_title
attributes.description: The official NCES title for the two-digit broad field series (e.g., Computer and Information Sciences and Support Services, Engineering, Health Professions and Related Programs).

products.name: concentration
products.description: Master record for concentrations, tracks, specializations, emphases, and minors embedded within an academic program that represent a structured sub-plan of study. Captures concentration title, parent academic program, required credit hours, elective credit hours, specific course requirements, CIP sub-code if distinct from parent program, active status, effective catalog year range, admission requirements (if restricted), whether the concentration appears on the official transcript and/or diploma, and Banner SMRPRLE area code. Supports degree audit processing (DegreeWorks/Banner), program-level IPEDS completions reporting at the concentration level, and student academic planning.

products.name: section
products.description: This association product represents the specific offering of a course taught by an instructor in a particular term. It captures the operational reality of course delivery: scheduling, enrollment capacity, delivery modality, and meeting patterns. Each record links one course definition to one instructor for one term and section, with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific teaching assignment.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, instructors teach multiple courses across different terms and sections, and courses are taught by different instructors depending on term, section, and faculty availability. The business actively manages course sections as operational entities with scheduling, enrollment capacity, delivery modality, and meeting patterns. Section is a recognized business concept in academic operations, distinct from both the course catalog definition and the instructor master record.

products.name: teaching_assignment

It captures the operational assignment of staff instructors to course sections, including workload distribution, instructional role, and section-specific teaching responsibilities. Each record links one course to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this teaching relationship.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, courses are routinely taught by multiple instructors through team-teaching arrangements, lab coordinators, teaching assistants, and co-instructors across different sections and terms. Simultaneously, instructors teach multiple courses per term as part of their workload. The registrar actively manages these teaching assignments as operational records, tracking instructor-of-record status, workload distribution, credit hour allocation, and section-specific responsibilities.

products.name: requirement_course_rule
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a degree_requirement block and a course that is approved to satisfy it. It captures the operational rule — managed by curriculum committees and executed by degree audit systems (Banner SMRPRLE/SMRALIB, Degree Works) — that governs which courses fulfill which requirement blocks, under what grade and credit conditions, and in what sequence. Each record links one degree_requirement block to one approved course with attributes that exist only in the context of this fulfillment rule, not on the requirement block or the course catalog record alone.. Existence Justification: In higher education, a degree requirement block (e.g., 'Core Science — 12 credit hours') is fulfilled by a defined set of approved courses, and each course can appear in multiple requirement blocks across multiple programs. This is an operationally managed relationship: curriculum committees actively create, update, and delete the list of courses approved to satisfy each requirement block, and degree audit systems (Banner SMRPRLE/SMRALIB, Degree Works) execute against this list at runtime. The association itself carries meaningful data — minimum grade required, credit hours awarded, sequence order, and substitution eligibility — that belongs to neither the requirement block nor the course catalog record alone.

attributes.name: requirement_course_rule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requirement Course Rule - Requirement Course Rule Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the requirement_course_rule association

attributes.name: course_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the catalog course record approved to fulfill the requirement block.

attributes.name: degree_requirement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requirement Course Rule - Degree Requirement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the degree requirement block that this course is approved to satisfy.

attributes.name: allow_substitution
attributes.description: Indicates whether an academic advisor may approve a substitute course in place of this specific course for this specific requirement block. This is a pairing-level rule that overrides or refines the block-level allow_substitution flag on degree_requirement, enabling fine-grained control per course-requirement combination.

attributes.name: credit_hours_awarded
attributes.description: The number of credit hours this course contributes toward the requirement block when completed. For variable-credit courses this may differ from the course catalog credit_hours value, and for cross-listed or co-listed courses the awarded hours may be capped by the requirement block rule. Belongs to the pairing, not to either entity alone.

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific course is mandatory within the requirement block (true) or is one of several elective options that can satisfy the block (false). This is a pairing-level flag — the same course may be required in one block and optional in another — and therefore belongs to the association, not to the course or the requirement block alone.

attributes.name: min_grade
attributes.description: The minimum letter grade a student must earn in this specific course for it to count toward this specific requirement block. This is a pairing-level rule — the same course may have different minimum grade thresholds across different requirement blocks — and therefore belongs to the association, not to the course catalog or the requirement block alone.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: The display and processing sequence of this course within the requirement block, used by degree audit systems to order the approved course list and by academic advisors to present recommended course sequences. Belongs to the pairing because the same course may appear at different sequence positions in different requirement blocks.

products.description: Core transactional record representing a formal application for admission submitted by a prospective student. Tracks application type (FTIAC, transfer, graduate, professional), program applied to, application term, submission date, application fee status, current workflow stage, and decision status. Sourced from Ellucian Banner Admissions and Slate CRM. Central entity of the admission domain.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the enrollment application record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree, certificate, or credential) to which the applicant is seeking admission.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: aid_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.aid_application. Business justification: Admissions applications trigger FAFSA/aid application workflows. Links admitted student packaging to enrollment intent. Operational for financial aid offer letters, enrollment deposit coordination, an

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Applications specify target campus for enrollment. Admissions reporting, yield analysis, and campus-specific recruitment strategies require linking applications to campus entities. Campus_code denorma

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions counselor or recruiter assigned to this applicant in Slate CRM. Used for territory management, counselor workload reporting, and yield attribution.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Counselor Assignment; Ellucian Banner SARADAP

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospective student (applicant/person) who submitted this application. Links to the student or person master record.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.fee_schedule. Business justification: Application fees are assessed according to a fee schedule. enrollment_application has fee_amount as a plain denormalized attribute. Linking to fee_schedule supports application fee assessment, fee wai

attributes.name: primary_enrollment_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic college or school within the institution to which the applicant is applying (e.g., College of Engineering, School of Business). Supports college-level admissions reporting.

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.principal_investigator. Business justification: Graduate applications for research programs require PI selection. Admissions decisions depend on faculty capacity, research fit, and available funding in PI labs. Enables PI-specific application revie

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Funded graduate position recruitment: PIs recruit PhD/MS students for specific grant-funded positions. Linking enrollment_application to research_award captures which award funds the advertised positi

attributes.name: reviewing_instructor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to faculty.instructor. Business justification: Graduate program admissions require faculty reviewers (PhD directors, program faculty) to evaluate applications. Linking enrollment_application to the reviewing faculty instructor supports graduate ad

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Application drives student account creation and tuition assessment. Residency classification, program level, and term from application determine billing rates and fee schedules. Account setup and init

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term (semester, quarter, or session) for which admission is being sought.

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Broad academic level of the program being applied to. Used for segmentation in IPEDS reporting, financial aid eligibility, and admissions workflow routing.

attributes.name: act_composite_score
attributes.description: Applicant's highest reported ACT composite score (range 1–36). Used in admissions review and merit aid evaluation. Null if test-optional or not submitted.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST; ACT Score Reporting; FERPA

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable application reference number assigned at submission. Used by applicants, admissions staff, and Slate CRM to track and communicate about the application.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; Slate CRM Application Object

attributes.name: application_source
attributes.description: Platform or channel through which the application was submitted. Informs recruitment channel effectiveness analysis and integration routing between Slate CRM and Ellucian Banner.
attributes.value_regex: Common App|Coalition App|Institution Direct|Transfer Portal|Graduate Direct|International Portal
attributes.references: Slate CRM Source Tracking; Common Application; Coalition Application

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current workflow stage of the application within the admissions processing pipeline. Drives routing, communications, and reporting in Ellucian Banner and Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; Slate CRM Application Status

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the applicant population and admission pathway. FTIAC (First-Time-In-Any-College) denotes first-year undergraduates; Transfer applies to students with prior college credit; Graduate and Professional denote post-baccalaureate applicants; Re-Admit covers returning students; Non-Degree covers non-matriculating applicants.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP SARADAP_APPL_CODE; IPEDS Admissions Survey; FTIAC definition

attributes.name: athletics_recruit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is a recruited student-athlete. Triggers NCAA compliance review, athletic scholarship eligibility assessment, and coordination with the athletics department.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; NCAA Eligibility Center; NCAA Division Compliance Rules

attributes.name: checklist_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required application materials (transcripts, recommendations, essays, test scores, etc.) have been received and verified, making the application file complete for review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SAADCRQ (Application Checklist); Slate CRM Checklist

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code identifying the academic discipline of the program applied to, per the U.S. Department of Education taxonomy. Required for IPEDS reporting and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education CIP 2020; IPEDS

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Applicant's citizenship or immigration status as declared on the application. Affects financial aid eligibility (Title IV), visa processing, and IPEDS reporting. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner GORVISA; FERPA; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; IPEDS

attributes.name: confirmation_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which an admitted applicant must confirm their intent to enroll (typically by submitting an enrollment deposit). Used to manage yield and seat planning.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; National Candidate Reply Date (NACAC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the application record was first created in the system of record (Ellucian Banner or Slate CRM). Supports audit trail, SLA measurement, and data lineage in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; FERPA Audit Requirements

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the official admissions decision was rendered and communicated to the applicant. Null if no decision has been issued.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; Common Application Standards

attributes.name: decision_status
attributes.description: Official admissions decision rendered by the institution for this application. Pending indicates no decision has been issued. Conditional Admit may require additional requirements (e.g., English proficiency, prerequisite coursework).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP SARADAP_APPL_DECISION_CODE; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: early_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application was submitted under an Early Action admissions plan (non-binding early decision cycle). Affects decision timeline and yield strategy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; NACAC Early Decision/Action Standards

attributes.name: early_decision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application was submitted under a binding Early Decision admissions plan. Early Decision applicants commit to enroll if admitted. Affects yield calculations and contract obligations.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; NACAC Early Decision Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_intent
attributes.description: Applicant's stated or confirmed intent to enroll following an admissions offer. Confirmed indicates deposit or formal acceptance received. Used for yield management and enrollment forecasting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; Slate CRM Enrollment Intent Tracking

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the application fee assessed for this application. May vary by application type (e.g., graduate vs. undergraduate) or program. Denominated in USD.

attributes.name: fee_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application fee has been received and posted. Applications with unpaid fees (and no waiver) may be held from review per institutional policy.

attributes.name: fee_waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application fee was waived for this applicant (e.g., due to financial hardship, Common App waiver, or institutional policy). Affects accounts receivable and access equity reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; Common Application Fee Waiver Policy; NACAC

attributes.name: first_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is a first-generation college student (neither parent holds a bachelor's degree). Used for targeted outreach, financial aid priority, and IPEDS equity reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education First Generation Definition; FAFSA

attributes.name: high_school_gpa
attributes.description: Self-reported or official high school cumulative GPA submitted as part of the application. Used in admissions review, merit scholarship evaluation, and predictive analytics. Applicable primarily to FTIAC applicants.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST; FERPA; Common Application Academic Record

attributes.name: ielts_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Score
attributes.description: Applicant's reported IELTS overall band score (range 0.0–9.0). Alternative to TOEFL for demonstrating English language proficiency for international applicants.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST; British Council IELTS Score Reporting; FERPA

attributes.name: materials_complete_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required application materials were received and the application file was deemed complete for admissions review. Null until checklist is fully satisfied.

attributes.name: prior_institution_code
attributes.description: Reference to the most recent prior institution attended by the applicant. Used for transfer credit evaluation, articulation agreement application, and IPEDS transfer reporting.

attributes.name: priority_deadline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application was submitted on or before the institution's priority admissions deadline. Priority applicants may receive earlier decisions, scholarship consideration, or preferred housing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; Institutional Admissions Policy

attributes.name: residency_classification
attributes.description: Applicant's tuition residency classification at the time of application. Determines tuition rate applicability and affects financial aid eligibility. May be updated after enrollment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; State Higher Education Policy

attributes.name: sat_total_score
attributes.description: Applicant's highest reported SAT composite score (Evidence-Based Reading and Writing + Math, range 400–1600). Used in admissions review and merit aid evaluation. Null if test-optional or not submitted.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST; College Board SAT Score Reporting; FERPA

attributes.name: scholarship_consideration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has been flagged for automatic merit scholarship review based on academic credentials. Drives routing to the financial aid merit award workflow.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner RRAAREQ; Institutional Scholarship Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this application record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and conflict resolution between Ellucian Banner and Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner; Slate CRM; Databricks Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: special_population_code
attributes.description: Code identifying applicant membership in a special admissions population requiring distinct processing or support (e.g., Veterans, Honors Program, Dual Enrollment, International, TRIO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Veteran|Honors|Dual Enrollment|International|TRIO|Disability Services|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; U.S. Department of Education TRIO Programs; Veterans Benefits Administration

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the applicant formally submitted the application. Used for deadline compliance, priority processing windows, and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: test_optional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant applied under the institution's test-optional admissions policy, meaning standardized test scores were not submitted or considered. Relevant for policy analysis and equity reporting.

attributes.name: toefl_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) Score
attributes.description: Applicant's reported TOEFL iBT total score (range 0–120). Required for international applicants whose native language is not English. Used to assess English language proficiency for admission and conditional admit decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST; ETS TOEFL Score Reporting; FERPA

attributes.name: transfer_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of transferable credit hours (CR) evaluated and accepted from prior institutions at the time of application review. Applicable to transfer applicants. Affects degree plan mapping and time-to-degree projections.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHATRNS; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the application record in the source system. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP; FERPA Audit Requirements; ETL Change Data Capture

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Type of U.S. visa held by the applicant, if applicable (e.g., F-1, J-1, H-4). Required for international student admissions processing, SEVIS compliance, and enrollment reporting. Null for domestic applicants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F-1|J-1|H-1B|H-4|OPT|CPT|B-1/B-2|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner GORVISA; SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System); DHS

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code recorded when an applicant withdraws or cancels their application. Used for yield analysis, competitive intelligence, and process improvement. Null if application is not withdrawn.
attributes.value_regex: Enrolled Elsewhere|Financial Reasons|Personal Reasons|Program Not Available|No Response|Other
attributes.references: Slate CRM Withdrawal Reason Codes; Ellucian Banner SARADAP

products.name: enrollment_applicant
products.description: Master identity record for an individual who has submitted at least one application. Captures personal demographics, citizenship status, residency classification (in-state, out-of-state, international), first-generation indicator, veteran status, and FERPA consent flags. Bridges the prospect pipeline to the formal application workflow and is the precursor to the student master record in the student domain.

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the applicant master record in the enrollment data lakehouse. Serves as the primary key bridging the prospect pipeline to the formal application workflow and the eventual student master record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — SPRIDEN/SPBPERS base person record

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.academic_program. Business justification: The applicant's intended program is a core admissions data point used in application review, program capacity management, and admissions funnel analytics. Linking enrollment_applicant to curriculum.ac

attributes.name: intended_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Applicant yield and conversion reporting by college is a standard admissions analytics requirement. intended_college_code is a denormalized org unit identifier. Higher-ed enrollment management and col

attributes.name: slate_prospect_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the individual in the Slate CRM system during the prospect management phase, prior to formal application submission. Enables traceability from initial recruitment contact through matriculation.

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Level of study the applicant is pursuing. Determines applicable admissions requirements, financial aid eligibility rules, tuition rate schedules, and IPEDS reporting category.
attributes.references: IPEDS Completions Survey; Ellucian Banner SARADAP.SARADAP_LEVL_CODE; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: act_composite_score
attributes.description: Applicant's ACT composite score (range 1–36) as reported by ACT, Inc. Used alongside SAT scores in admissions merit review and scholarship eligibility determination under test-optional or test-flexible policies.
attributes.references: ACT Score Reporting Standards; NACAC; Ellucian Banner SORTEST

attributes.name: admissions_decision_code
attributes.description: Official admissions decision rendered by the institution for the applicant's most recent application. Drives downstream enrollment deposit processing, financial aid packaging, and IPEDS admissions reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP.SARADAP_RSTS_CODE; IPEDS Admissions Survey; NACAC

attributes.name: admissions_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the institution rendered an official admissions decision (admit, deny, waitlist, or defer) for the applicant. Used for decision turnaround time analytics and NACAC compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP.SARADAP_RSTS_DATE; NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice

attributes.name: applicant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the applicant based on their prior academic history and enrollment intent. FTIAC (First-Time-In-Any-College) applicants are tracked separately for IPEDS first-time student cohort reporting. Drives admissions review workflow routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ftiac|transfer|readmit|graduate|international|non_degree|dual_enrollment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS First-Time Student Definition; Ellucian Banner SARADAP.SARADAP_STYP_CODE; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: application_fee_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has paid the required application fee or received an approved fee waiver. Applications with unpaid fees are typically held from admissions review until payment or waiver is confirmed.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SAAADMS; College Board Fee Waiver Policy; NACAC Fee Waiver Guidelines

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the applicant's most recent or active application within the admissions workflow. Drives Slate CRM communications, Banner SIS record activation, and enrollment funnel reporting. Represents the applicant-level rollup status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospect|applied|under_review|decision_pending|admitted|denied|waitlisted|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP.SARADAP_APST_CODE; Slate CRM Application Processing Module

attributes.name: application_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant formally submitted their application for admission. Used for application deadline compliance tracking, admissions cycle reporting, and funnel conversion analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARADAP.SARADAP_APPL_DATE; Slate CRM Application Processing Module

attributes.name: banner_pidm
attributes.description: Internal Banner SIS person identifier (PIDM) that uniquely identifies the individual across all Banner modules including Admissions, Financial Aid, Student Accounts, and Academic History. Acts as the cross-module linkage key within the source system.

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Applicant's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, FERPA minor-student protections, NCAA eligibility checks, and demographic reporting to IPEDS.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); IPEDS Reporting; NCAA Eligibility Rules; Ellucian Banner SPBPERS.SPBPERS_BIRTH_DAY

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Federal citizenship classification of the applicant. Determines Title IV financial aid eligibility (FAFSA), in-state tuition residency analysis, visa requirements, and IPEDS reporting. Sourced from Ellucian Banner GORVISA/SPBPERS.
attributes.references: Title IV HEA; IPEDS Reporting; FERPA; Ellucian Banner SPBPERS.SPBPERS_CITZ_CODE

attributes.name: country_of_birth
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the applicant's country of birth. Used for international student classification, visa eligibility determination, and demographic analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SEVIS; Ellucian Banner SPBPERS.SPBPERS_BIRTH_NATION

attributes.name: country_of_citizenship
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the applicant's country of citizenship. Required for international student visa processing (F-1, J-1), SEVIS reporting, and IPEDS international student counts.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System); IPEDS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the applicant master record was first created in the enrollment data lakehouse Silver layer. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and ETL pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FERPA Audit Requirements; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has self-disclosed a disability requiring academic accommodations. Triggers referral to Disability Services office. Stored as disclosure status only — specific disability details are maintained separately under ADA/Section 504 protections.
attributes.references: ADA (42 U.S.C. § 12101); Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act; FERPA

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary personal email address provided by the applicant for admissions communications, application status notifications, and pre-enrollment correspondence via Slate CRM. Distinct from any institutional email assigned post-admission.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); CAN-SPAM Act; Slate CRM Communications Module

attributes.name: enrollment_deposit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the admitted applicant paid the enrollment confirmation deposit. Used for yield analysis, melt tracking, and enrollment projection modeling.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SAAADMS; NACAC; NACUBO Enrollment Management Reporting

attributes.name: enrollment_deposit_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the admitted applicant has paid the enrollment confirmation deposit, signaling intent to enroll. A key yield metric in enrollment management and the trigger for orientation and housing assignment workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SAAADMS; NACAC Enrollment Deposit Practices; NACUBO

attributes.name: entry_term_code
attributes.description: Academic term code for which the applicant is seeking enrollment (e.g., '202501' for Spring 2025). Used for cohort tracking, capacity planning, and term-based enrollment cycle management in Banner SIS.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey

attributes.name: ethnicity_code
attributes.description: Federal race/ethnicity category code for the applicant per IPEDS reporting standards. Used for Title VI compliance, diversity reporting, and accreditation data submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hispanic_latino|american_indian_alaska_native|asian|black_african_american|native_hawaiian_pacific_islander|white|two_or_more_races|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Categories; Title VI (42 U.S.C. § 2000d); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: fee_waiver_type
attributes.description: Type of application fee waiver granted to the applicant, if applicable. Identifies the authorizing body (College Board, ACT, NACAC, or institutional) for audit and equity reporting purposes.
attributes.references: College Board Fee Waiver; ACT Fee Waiver; NACAC Fee Waiver Policy

attributes.name: ferpa_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant provided or last updated their FERPA consent authorization. Required for compliance audit trails and determining the effective period of consent.

attributes.name: ferpa_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has provided written FERPA consent authorizing the institution to release education records to designated third parties (e.g., parents, guardians). False indicates records are protected and cannot be disclosed without further authorization.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); 34 CFR Part 99; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: first_generation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is a first-generation college student, defined as neither parent having completed a bachelor's degree. Used for targeted support program eligibility, Title III/IV reporting, and equity analytics.
attributes.references: Higher Education Act Title IV; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education First-Generation Definition

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given (first) name of the applicant as provided on the application. Used for identity verification, FERPA-protected communications, and official enrollment records.

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Self-reported gender identity of the applicant. Collected for IPEDS demographic reporting, Title IX compliance, and inclusive student services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: male|female|non_binary|genderqueer|transgender|prefer_not_to_say|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Gender Reporting; Title IX (20 U.S.C. § 1681); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: high_school_ceeb_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: High School College Entrance Examination Board (CEEB) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit College Board CEEB code identifying the applicant's high school or secondary institution. Used for transcript verification, SAT/ACT score matching, and high school partnership analytics.
attributes.references: College Board CEEB Code Registry; SAT/ACT Score Reporting Standards

attributes.name: high_school_gpa
attributes.description: Applicant's cumulative high school GPA on a 4.0 scale as reported on the official transcript. A key academic merit indicator used in admissions review, merit scholarship eligibility, and predictive enrollment analytics.
attributes.references: NACAC Admission Practices; Ellucian Banner SORHSCH; College Board Standards

attributes.name: ielts_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Band Score
attributes.description: Applicant's IELTS overall band score (range 0.0–9.0 in 0.5 increments) as an alternative English proficiency measure to TOEFL. Used for international student admissions decisions and conditional admission routing.
attributes.references: British Council / IDP IELTS Score Reporting; SEVIS; Ellucian Banner SORTEST

attributes.name: inquiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant first expressed interest in the institution, either through a direct inquiry, college fair contact, or Slate CRM prospect capture. Marks the start of the recruitment funnel for time-to-application analytics.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Prospect Management Module; NACAC Enrollment Management Standards

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal surname (last name) of the applicant as provided on the application. Used for identity verification, official correspondence, and enrollment records.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the applicant. Used for identity disambiguation when first and last names are common, and for official document generation.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the applicant in E.164 international format. Used for admissions outreach, interview scheduling, and enrollment communications via Slate CRM.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); Slate CRM

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the applicant prefers to be addressed by in non-legal communications, such as advising, orientation, and LMS interactions. Distinct from legal name used on official documents.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); Higher Education best practice for inclusive student services

attributes.name: prior_college_gpa
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior College Cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA)
attributes.description: Cumulative GPA from all prior postsecondary institutions attended, on a 4.0 scale. Applicable for transfer, readmit, and graduate applicants. Used in transfer admissions review and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) baseline assessment.
attributes.references: NACAC Transfer Admission Practices; SAP Policy (34 CFR 668.34); Ellucian Banner SORHSCH

attributes.name: recruitment_source_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary recruitment channel or initiative through which the applicant was first engaged (e.g., college fair, high school visit, digital campaign, alumni referral). Used for ROI analysis of recruitment spend and Slate CRM campaign attribution.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Prospect Management Module; NACAC Recruitment Practices

attributes.name: residency_classification
attributes.description: Tuition residency classification assigned to the applicant based on domicile verification. Determines applicable tuition rate tier (in-state, out-of-state, international). Critical for revenue forecasting and NACUBO financial reporting.
attributes.references: State Higher Education Residency Statutes; NACUBO; Ellucian Banner SGASTDN residency indicator

attributes.name: sat_total_score
attributes.description: Applicant's total SAT composite score (Evidence-Based Reading and Writing + Math, range 400–1600) as reported by College Board. Used in admissions merit review, scholarship eligibility, and test-optional policy analytics.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Score Reporting; NACAC; Ellucian Banner SORHSCH/SORTEST

attributes.name: state_of_legal_residence
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the applicant's state of legal domicile. Used for residency classification determination, in-state tuition eligibility, and state-level enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; State Residency Statutes; IPEDS

attributes.name: toefl_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) Score
attributes.description: Applicant's TOEFL iBT total score (range 0–120) as reported by ETS. Required for international applicants whose primary language is not English. Used to determine English language proficiency and conditional admission eligibility.
attributes.references: ETS TOEFL Score Reporting; SEVIS; Ellucian Banner SORTEST

attributes.name: transfer_credit_hours
attributes.description: Total number of transferable credit hours (CR) evaluated from prior postsecondary institutions. Used for degree audit, time-to-degree planning, and financial aid credit hour eligibility calculations.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SHRTRAM; NACAC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the applicant master record in the enrollment data lakehouse Silver layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FERPA Audit Requirements; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: Military service classification of the applicant. Determines eligibility for GI Bill benefits, Yellow Ribbon Program, in-state tuition waivers for veterans, and VA certification requirements. Reported to IPEDS and the VA.
attributes.references: 38 U.S.C. § 3001 (GI Bill); Veterans Benefits Administration; IPEDS; Ellucian Banner SPBPERS.SPBPERS_VETC_CODE

products.name: application_program
products.description: Association entity linking an application to the specific academic program(s) and plan(s) being applied to, supporting multiple-program applications. Captures CIP code, degree level, college, department, concentration, and program priority rank when an applicant applies to more than one program simultaneously.
