attributes.references: SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System); DHS; IPEDS

attributes.name: last_date_of_attendance
attributes.description: The last date on which the student attended class or participated in an academically related activity during the term. Required for Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations when a student withdraws and for federal financial aid compliance.
attributes.references: 34 CFR §668.22 Return to Title IV (R2T4); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: quality_points_cumulative
attributes.description: Total cumulative grade quality points earned across all terms at the institution as of the end of this term. Used as the numerator in cumulative GPA calculation.

attributes.name: quality_points_term
attributes.description: Total grade quality points earned during the term, calculated as the sum of (grade points × credit hours) for each course. Used as the numerator in term GPA calculation.

attributes.name: registration_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has an active registration hold at the time of this term record snapshot. Holds may be academic (probation), financial (outstanding balance), or administrative. Used for enrollment management and student services workflows.

attributes.name: residency_classification
attributes.description: Student's tuition residency classification for the term as determined by the institution's residency policy. Drives tuition rate assessment, state funding formulas, and IPEDS residency reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGBSTDN; State Higher Education Finance Policy

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) status for the term as required by Title IV federal financial aid regulations. Evaluates qualitative (GPA), quantitative (pace/completion rate), and maximum timeframe standards. Determines continued financial aid eligibility.
attributes.references: 34 CFR §668.34; U.S. Department of Education Title IV SAP

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this student term record was sourced. Primarily Ellucian Banner (SGBSTDN/SHRTTRM) for enrollment domain. Supports data lineage and ETL audit in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: student_level
attributes.description: Broad academic level of the student for the term (undergraduate, graduate, professional, doctoral, non-degree). Distinct from class level — drives tuition rate schedules, financial aid programs, and accreditation reporting.

attributes.name: term_gpa
attributes.description: Student's Grade Point Average (GPA) calculated for the current term only, based on quality points earned divided by credit hours attempted with grade points. Protected under FERPA. Used for academic standing determination and Dean's List eligibility.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; AACRAO

attributes.name: transfer_credit_hours_accepted
attributes.description: Total credit hours accepted from prior institutions via transfer credit evaluation. Included in cumulative hours for degree audit and class level but may be excluded from institutional GPA calculation per policy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.description: Number of courses from which the student officially withdrew during the term. Distinct from DFW count — used for financial aid Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations and enrollment intensity adjustments.

Sourced from Banner SPRHOLD. Critical for enforcing prerequisite compliance, financial clearance, and advising mandates before registration opens. Supports batch hold processing and automated release workflows.

attributes.description: Academic standing condition that triggered an academic hold, if applicable (e.g., probation, suspension, dismissal). Null or 'none' for non-academic hold types. Supports Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) compliance reporting.

attributes.name: blocks_graduation

attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold prevents the student from adding, dropping, or modifying course registrations. Core enforcement flag for the registration workflow.

attributes.name: blocks_transcript

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the outstanding balance amount (e.g., USD). Defaults to USD for domestic institutions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hold automatically expires if not manually released. Null indicates the hold has no automatic expiration and requires manual release. Corresponds to Banner SPRHOLD_TO_DATE.

attributes.name: hold_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the hold, resolution steps required, or additional context provided by the originating office. Displayed to students and advisors.

attributes.name: hold_notes
attributes.description: Internal staff notes providing additional context about the hold, resolution history, or special circumstances. Not displayed to students. Supports case management and inter-office communication.

attributes.name: hold_severity

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hold. attributes.name: hold_type_code

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold was placed by an automated batch process (True) or manually by a staff member (False). Supports workflow auditing and distinguishes system-generated from human-initiated holds.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student was notified of the hold via email, student portal, or other communication channel.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a notification has been sent to the student informing them of the hold placement and required resolution steps.

attributes.name: placed_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the hold was placed on the student account. Represents the principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: placed_timestamp

attributes.name: release_reason_code

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the hold was released, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail and SLA measurement for hold resolution.

attributes.name: c_code_flag
attributes.description: Federal comment codes from the ISIR indicating issues that must be resolved before aid can be disbursed (e.g., conflicting information, missing signatures, data mismatches).
attributes.references: ISIR Comment Codes and Text Guide

attributes.name: coa_amount
attributes.description: Total Cost of Attendance budget assigned to this application. Includes tuition, fees, room, board, books, supplies, transportation, and personal expenses. Used to calculate financial need.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the aid application record was first created in the Student Information System.

attributes.name: default_overpayment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is in default on a federal student loan or owes an overpayment on a federal grant. Students with this flag are ineligible for Title IV aid until resolved.

attributes.name: direct_loan_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for Federal Direct Loans (subsidized and/or unsubsidized) based on enrollment, citizenship, and loan limit checks.
attributes.references: William D. Ford Federal Direct Loan Program

attributes.name: drug_conviction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has a federal or state drug conviction that affects Title IV aid eligibility during the period of enrollment.

attributes.name: enrollment_intensity
attributes.description: Expected enrollment intensity for the award year. Determines eligibility for certain aid programs and affects disbursement amounts.

attributes.name: fafsa_receipt_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) Receipt Date
attributes.description: Date the institution received the students FAFSA data from the federal processor. Critical for priority deadline determination and aid packaging sequencing.

attributes.name: financial_need_amount
attributes.description: Calculated financial need for the application. Computed as Cost of Attendance minus Expected Family Contribution (or Student Aid Index). Determines eligibility for need-based aid.

attributes.name: housing_plan_code
attributes.description: Students planned housing arrangement for the award year. Affects Cost of Attendance (COA) calculation as different housing plans have different budget allowances.

attributes.name: institutional_methodology_efc
attributes.description: Expected Family Contribution calculated using the institutions own methodology (e.g., CSS Profile). Used for awarding institutional need-based aid, separate from federal methodology.

attributes.name: pell_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for a Federal Pell Grant based on EFC/SAI and enrollment status.

attributes.name: pell_leu_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the students lifetime Pell Grant eligibility used. Students are limited to 600% (equivalent to six years of full-time enrollment). Tracked cumulatively across all institutions.

attributes.name: professional_judgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial aid administrator exercised professional judgment to adjust the students EFC/SAI or dependency status based on special circumstances.

attributes.name: professional_judgment_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for professional judgment adjustment, such as loss of employment, medical expenses, or dependency override.

attributes.name: selective_service_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether male students aged 18-25 have registered with Selective Service as required for Title IV aid eligibility.

attributes.name: state_aid_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for state-funded financial aid programs based on residency and state-specific requirements.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the student initially submitted the financial aid application to the institution.

attributes.name: unusual_enrollment_history_flag
attributes.description: Federal flag indicating the student has an unusual enrollment history pattern (attending multiple institutions in a short period). Requires additional documentation before aid can be disbursed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the aid application record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: veteran_benefits_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is receiving or eligible for veteran education benefits (e.g., GI Bill, Yellow Ribbon Program). Affects coordination of benefits and COA adjustments.

products.name: award_package
products.description: Represents the complete financial aid award package assembled for a student for a specific award year. Tracks total awarded amount, packaging methodology, COA budget reference, unmet need, overaward detection and resolution status, packaging date, counselor, and package status (proposed, accepted, revised, cancelled). SSOT for a student's aggregate aid offer and overaward management.

attributes.name: award_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial aid award package. Primary key.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.academic_program. Business justification: Award packaging methodology varies by program—professional programs have different COA structures, program-specific scholarship pools require program identification, and packaging rules often differen

attributes.name: award_year_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the award year for which this package is assembled.

attributes.name: coa_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the COA budget used for this award package, defining the total allowable cost for the student.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the financial aid counselor who assembled this award package.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Award packaging is governed by institutional aid policies (packaging methodology, professional judgment, coordination of aid). Financial aid directors reference specific policy documents when assembli

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student receiving this award package.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Award packages must comply with federal methodology requirements (34 CFR 668.2 for COA, Pell LEU limits, aggregate loan caps). Tracking regulatory basis ensures packaging decisions are defensible duri

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Award packages reduce billing obligations and appear as anticipated aid on statements. Financial aid officers review account status during packaging; billing systems need award totals to calculate net

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this award package record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this package (typically USD for U.S. institutions).

attributes.name: default_status_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is in default on any federal student loans, affecting eligibility for additional aid.

attributes.name: demonstrated_need_amount
attributes.description: Calculated financial need for the student, typically COA minus EFC, representing the gap to be filled by aid.

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: Student dependency status as determined by FAFSA, affecting eligibility for certain aid types.

attributes.name: efc_amount
attributes.description: Expected Family Contribution calculated from FAFSA data, representing the amount the family is expected to contribute toward educational costs.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Student enrollment intensity at the time of packaging, affecting aid eligibility and amounts.

attributes.name: housing_status
attributes.description: Student housing arrangement used to determine the appropriate COA budget.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this award package record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision to this award package.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this award package, used for internal documentation and communication among financial aid staff.

attributes.name: offer_letter_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the award offer letter was sent to the student.

attributes.name: overaward_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which total awarded aid exceeds the COA or regulatory limits, requiring resolution to maintain Title IV compliance.

attributes.name: overaward_detected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an overaward condition has been detected for this package.

attributes.name: overaward_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the overaward was resolved or waived.

attributes.name: overaward_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of overaward resolution efforts, tracking whether the overaward has been addressed.

attributes.name: package_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the award package, typically used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the award package indicating its stage in the financial aid workflow.

attributes.name: packaging_date
attributes.description: Date on which the award package was initially assembled and packaged by the financial aid office.

attributes.name: packaging_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology or strategy used to assemble this award package, indicating the basis for aid allocation.

attributes.name: pell_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for Federal Pell Grant based on EFC and enrollment.

attributes.name: pell_lifetime_eligibility_used_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of lifetime Pell Grant eligibility the student has used, capped at 600 percent (equivalent to 6 years).

attributes.name: professional_judgment_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether professional judgment was exercised to adjust the EFC or COA for this student.

attributes.name: professional_judgment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the circumstances that warranted professional judgment adjustment.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating how many times this award package has been revised.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for the most recent revision to the award package, such as change in enrollment status, additional aid received, or correction.

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: Student Satisfactory Academic Progress status at the time of packaging, required for continued Title IV eligibility.

attributes.name: student_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student accepted the award package or specific awards within it.

attributes.name: total_awarded_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of financial aid awarded in this package across all aid types (grants, loans, scholarships, work-study).

attributes.name: total_coa_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of attendance amount for the student for this award year, including tuition, fees, room, board, books, and other allowable expenses.

attributes.name: total_grant_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of grant aid (gift aid that does not require repayment) included in this package.

attributes.name: total_loan_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of loan aid (funds requiring repayment) included in this package.

attributes.name: total_scholarship_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of scholarship aid (merit or need-based gift aid) included in this package.

attributes.name: total_work_study_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of work-study aid (earned through part-time employment) included in this package.

attributes.name: unmet_need_amount
attributes.description: Remaining financial need after all awarded aid is applied, representing the gap the student must cover through other means.

attributes.name: verification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which FAFSA verification was completed for this award package.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of FAFSA verification process for this student and award year, required for Title IV compliance.

products.name: aid_award
products.description: Individual financial aid award record within a students package, representing a single fund allocation (e.g., Pell Grant, Direct Subsidized Loan, institutional merit scholarship, Federal Work-Study). Tracks fund reference, award amount, accepted amount, disbursed-to-date amount, award status (offered, accepted, declined, cancelled, revised), academic period, enrollment intensity requirement, and SAP eligibility requirement. Supports both need-based and merit-based awards across all fund types (grants, loans, scholarships, work-study). SSOT for individual award decisions and amounts.

attributes.name: aid_award_id
attributes.description: Primary key for award

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.academic_program. attributes.name: aid_fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the financial aid fund being awarded (e.g., Pell Grant, Direct Subsidized Loan, institutional merit scholarship). Links to the fund master record.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: award_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.award_package. Business justification: Individual awards are components of an award package. This is a standard parent-child relationship (one package contains many awards). The award table should FK to award_package. No columns to remove

attributes.name: award_year_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.award_year. Business justification: aid_award has an aid_year STRING column but no FK to the award_year master reference table. Every individual award is tied to a specific award year for federal reporting, packaging, and disbursement e

attributes.name: coa_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Cost of Attendance (COA) budget used to determine eligibility for this award. Links to the COA master record.
attributes.references: COA (Cost of Attendance) - U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instruction.course_section. Business justification: Departmental scholarships and work-study awards frequently require enrollment in specific course sections (e.g., 'Chemistry Lab Assistant Award requires enrollment in CHEM 301L', 'Music Performance Sc

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student receiving this financial aid award. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Each Title IV award type (Pell, FSEOG, Direct Loan) is governed by specific HEA sections and CFR parts defining eligibility, award limits, and disbursement rules. Required for COD reporting and compli

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Graduate research assistantship stipends and tuition waivers funded by sponsored grants require linking the aid award to the originating research award for Title IV coordination, overaward detection,

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Individual awards post as anticipated aid credits on billing statements, reducing amounts due. Required for statement generation, payment processing, account holds management, and reconciliation betwe

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the academic term or period for which this award applies (e.g., Fall 2023, Spring 2024, Academic Year 2023-2024). Links to the academic period master record.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student accepted this award. Null if the award has not been accepted or was declined.

attributes.name: accepted_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount the student has accepted for this award. May be less than or equal to the offered amount. Null if award has not been accepted.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: award_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this award within the student's aid package. Human-readable reference number used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: award_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the award. Tracks progression from initial offer through acceptance, disbursement, or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: offered|accepted|declined|cancelled|revised|disbursed|completed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this award was cancelled or revoked. Null if the award has not been cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this award was cancelled. Common reasons include enrollment changes, SAP failure, over-award corrections, student withdrawal, or fund exhaustion.

attributes.name: cancelled_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of this award that has been cancelled or revoked. Used when awards are reduced or eliminated after initial offer.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or administrative comments about this award. Used for internal documentation and communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this award record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: disbursed_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative dollar amount that has been disbursed to the student or applied to their account to date for this award. Tracks actual funds distributed.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: efc_amount
attributes.description: The Expected Family Contribution (EFC) amount calculated from the student's FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) at the time this award was packaged. Used to determine need-based aid eligibility.

attributes.name: enrollment_status_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum enrollment intensity required to receive or maintain this award. Based on credit hour thresholds defined by the institution and federal regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: federal_fund_code
attributes.description: Federal reporting code for Title IV funds as defined by the U.S. Department of Education. Used for FISAP, COD, and other federal reporting. Null for non-federal funds.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: first_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The date of the first disbursement for this award. Null if no disbursements have occurred yet.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: For loan awards, the annual interest rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.045 for 4.5%). Null for non-loan awards.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Direct Loan Program

attributes.name: last_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent disbursement for this award. Null if no disbursements have occurred yet.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: loan_period_begin_date
attributes.description: For loan awards, the start date of the loan period. Defines the enrollment period covered by the loan. Null for non-loan awards.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Direct Loan Program

attributes.name: loan_period_end_date
attributes.description: For loan awards, the end date of the loan period. Defines the enrollment period covered by the loan. Null for non-loan awards.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Direct Loan Program

attributes.name: need_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award is need-based (true) or merit-based (false). Need-based awards require demonstrated financial need via FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) or institutional methodology.
attributes.references: FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid)

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The date on which this award was officially offered to the student. Marks the beginning of the award lifecycle.

attributes.name: offered_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount initially offered to the student for this award. Represents the maximum potential award before student acceptance or adjustments.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: origination_fee_amount
attributes.description: For loan awards, the dollar amount of the origination fee deducted by the lender or federal government. Null for non-loan awards.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Direct Loan Program

attributes.name: packaging_group
attributes.description: Classification code used to group students for aid packaging purposes (e.g., freshman, transfer, graduate, athlete). Determines packaging rules and fund priority.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the order in which this award should be applied within the student's aid package. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount remaining to be disbursed for this award. Calculated as accepted amount minus disbursed amount.

attributes.name: renewable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award is renewable for subsequent academic years if eligibility criteria continue to be met. True for multi-year scholarships and grants.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter tracking the number of times this award has been revised or adjusted. Starts at 0 for original award, increments with each change.

attributes.name: sap_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award requires the student to maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) as defined by federal Title IV regulations and institutional policy. True if SAP compliance is mandatory.
attributes.references: SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) - U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: self_help_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award is classified as self-help aid (loans and work-study) as opposed to gift aid (grants and scholarships). Used for packaging and reporting.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: subsidized_flag
attributes.description: For loan awards, indicates whether the loan is subsidized (true) or unsubsidized (false). Subsidized loans do not accrue interest while the student is enrolled. Null for non-loan awards.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Direct Loan Program

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or process that last modified this award record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this award record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

SSOT for actual fund movement. Sourced from Ellucian Banner Disbursement module.

attributes.description: Reference to the fund source providing the disbursement (federal, state, institutional, private). Identifies the origin of the funds.

attributes.name: award_year_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial aid year for which this disbursement applies. Typically spans July 1 to June 30.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Tracking regulatory basis is critical for COD reporting accuracy and

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Disbursements credit student accounts, reducing billing balances. This is the core transaction linking aid delivery to account management. Essential for daily reconciliation, refund processing, accoun

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term for which this disbursement is being made. Disbursements are typically term-specific.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross amount of funds disbursed to the student or credited to the student account. Represents the actual fund movement.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Programs

attributes.name: anticipated_disbursement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement was made in anticipation of future enrollment. Used for early disbursements before term start.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Programs - 34 CFR 668.164(h)

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disbursement was authorized by the financial aid office. Precedes the actual disbursement date.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The system or channel through which the disbursement was processed. Distinguishes internal vs external payment channels.

attributes.name: coa_amount
attributes.description: The Cost of Attendance used for this disbursement calculation. Represents the maximum aid the student can receive.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Programs - 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: cod_reporting_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Reporting Date
attributes.description: The date on which this disbursement was reported to the federal COD system. Used for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: cod_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement has been reported to the federal COD system. Required for all Title IV disbursements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disbursement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the disbursement. Typically USD for U.S. institutions.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disbursement was actually released to the student account or paid to the student. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Programs

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: The method by which funds were disbursed. Indicates whether funds were credited to student account, sent via EFT, issued as check, or direct deposited.

attributes.name: disbursement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the disbursement. Human-readable reference number used in communications and reconciliation.

attributes.name: disbursement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disbursement. Tracks the disbursement through approval, release, and potential return workflows.

attributes.name: efc_amount
attributes.description: The Expected Family Contribution calculated from FAFSA at the time of disbursement. Used to determine need-based aid eligibility.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a hold was placed on this disbursement preventing release. Holds may be due to verification, SAP, or other compliance issues.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which any disbursement hold was released, allowing the disbursement to proceed.

attributes.name: late_disbursement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement was made after the normal disbursement window. Requires special processing and documentation.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Programs - 34 CFR 668.164(g)

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disbursement record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: The net amount received by the student after deductions for fees, charges, or institutional holds. May differ from gross disbursement amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special circumstances, processing exceptions, or additional context for this disbursement.

attributes.name: nslds_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement has been reported to NSLDS. Required for federal loan and grant tracking.

attributes.name: origination_fee_amount
attributes.description: Federal loan origination fee deducted from the disbursement. Applicable to Direct Loans and other federal loan programs.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment processor or bank. Used for reconciliation with financial systems.

attributes.name: period_begin_date
attributes.description: The start date of the enrollment period covered by this disbursement. Defines the academic period for which aid is being disbursed.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the enrollment period covered by this disbursement. Defines the academic period for which aid is being disbursed.

attributes.name: sap_status_at_disbursement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Status at Disbursement
attributes.description: The students SAP status at the time of disbursement. Students must meet SAP standards to receive Title IV aid.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Programs - 34 CFR 668.34

attributes.name: scheduled_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for the disbursement. May differ from actual disbursement date due to holds, eligibility changes, or processing delays.

attributes.name: sequence

Essential for fund setup, allocation management, and demonstrating regula

attributes.name: academic_level_requirement
attributes.description: The academic level(s) of students eligible for this fund. Federal Pell Grants are undergraduate-only, while some institutional funds may be graduate-only or open to all levels.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Institutional Financial Aid Policy

attributes.name: annual_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount allocated to this fund for the current award year. For federal funds, this represents the institutional allocation from the Department of Education. For institutional funds, this is the budgeted amount.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, NACUBO

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: The five-digit CFDA number assigned to federal financial aid programs for tracking and reporting purposes (e.g., 84.063 for Federal Pell Grant, 84.268 for Federal Direct Loan). Applicable only to federal funds.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education, CFDA Catalog, IPEDS

attributes.name: citizenship_requirement
attributes.description: The citizenship or residency status required for eligibility. Federal Title IV aid requires U.S. citizenship or eligible non-citizen status. Some institutional funds may be open to international students.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations (34 CFR 668.33), FERPA

attributes.name: coa_component_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies if this fund can only be applied to specific components of the student's Cost of Attendance (e.g., tuition and fees only, room and board only, books and supplies). Null if no restriction exists.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations (34 CFR 668.2), Institutional Financial Aid Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fund record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disbursement_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency with which this fund is disbursed to eligible students: one-time, per academic term, per semester, monthly (for work-study), or biweekly.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Institutional Financial Aid Policy

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: The method by which funds are disbursed: directly to the student, applied to the student account, paid by an employer (for work-study), or paid by a third party.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Ellucian Banner Student Accounts

attributes.name: donor_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any donor-imposed restrictions on fund use, such as major field of study, geographic origin, demographic criteria, or other special conditions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fund becomes available for awarding and disbursement. Typically the start of the award year or the date donor funds are received.

attributes.name: endowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an endowed fund where only investment earnings are awarded, preserving the principal in perpetuity.
attributes.references: NACUBO Endowment Management Standards, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: enrollment_status_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum enrollment status required for a student to be eligible for this fund. Federal Pell Grants are available at any enrollment status, while some institutional scholarships require full-time enrollment.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Institutional Financial Aid Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fund is no longer available for new awards. For federal funds, this is typically the end of the award year. For endowed funds, this may be null indicating perpetual availability.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Fund Management, U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations

attributes.name: fund_category
attributes.description: The aid category indicating the nature of the financial assistance: grant (gift aid), loan (repayable), scholarship (merit or need-based gift), work-study (earned aid), fellowship, or assistantship.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, IPEDS Financial Aid Survey

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique code identifying this financial aid fund within the institution's fund management system. Used for fund accounting, award packaging, and disbursement processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Fund Management, NACUBO Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: fund_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fund's purpose, eligibility criteria, and any special conditions. Used for student communication and financial aid counseling.
attributes.references: Institutional Financial Aid Policy, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The official name of the financial aid fund as it appears in institutional records and student award letters.

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fund indicating whether it is available for awarding, temporarily suspended, depleted of funds, pending approval, or permanently closed.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: The primary classification of the fund source indicating whether it is federal, state, institutional, private donor, or external scholarship.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, NACUBO

attributes.name: gpa_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum cumulative GPA required for initial eligibility or continued eligibility (Satisfactory Academic Progress). Null if no GPA requirement exists.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education SAP Regulations (34 CFR 668.34), Institutional Financial Aid Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fund record was last updated.

attributes.name: matching_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of institutional funds required to match federal allocation. For example, SEOG requires 25% institutional match. Null if no matching requirement exists.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations (SEOG 34 CFR 676.20)

attributes.name: matching_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund requires institutional matching funds. True for programs like Federal SEOG and Federal Work-Study that require institutional cost-sharing.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations (SEOG 34 CFR 676, FWS 34 CFR 675)

attributes.name: maximum_award_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount that can be awarded to a single student from this fund per award year. For federal programs, this is the statutory maximum (e.g., Pell maximum).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: maximum_years_eligible
attributes.description: The maximum number of academic years a student may receive this fund. Federal Pell Grant has a 12-semester (6-year) lifetime limit. Null if no limit exists.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations (34 CFR 690.80)

attributes.name: merit_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is awarded based on academic merit, talent, or achievement criteria rather than financial need.

attributes.name: minimum_award_amount
attributes.description: The minimum dollar amount that can be awarded to a single student from this fund. Used to ensure awards meet federal or donor-specified minimums.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: need_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is need-based (requires demonstrated financial need via FAFSA EFC calculation) or non-need-based (merit or other criteria).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, FAFSA

attributes.name: payout_rate
attributes.description: The annual payout rate applied to endowed funds to determine the amount available for awarding, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.5%). Null for non-endowed funds.
attributes.references: NACUBO Endowment Management Standards, Institutional Investment Policy

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether disbursed funds can be refunded to the student (creating a credit balance) or must only be applied to institutional charges. Relevant for Return of Title IV (R2T4) calculations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations (34 CFR 668.22)

attributes.name: regulatory_program_code
attributes.description: The federal or state program code for Title IV or state-regulated aid programs (e.g., PELL for Federal Pell Grant, SEOG for Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant, DL for Direct Loan, FWSP for Federal Work-Study Program). Empty for non-regulated institutional or private funds.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Program Regulations, Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) System

attributes.name: remaining_balance_amount
attributes.description: The current unawarded or undisbursed balance remaining in the fund. Updated in real-time as awards are packaged and disbursements are processed.

attributes.name: renewable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund award is renewable for multiple years if eligibility criteria continue to be met. Common for multi-year scholarships.
attributes.references: Institutional Financial Aid Policy, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: The category used for external reporting to IPEDS, state agencies, or accreditation bodies. Maps fund to standardized reporting classifications.
attributes.references: IPEDS Financial Aid Survey, State Higher Education Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: residency_requirement
attributes.description: State or geographic residency requirement for eligibility. Common for state grants and some institutional scholarships (e.g., must be a resident of California, must be from a specific county).
attributes.references: State Financial Aid Regulations, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: sap_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether students must meet Satisfactory Academic Progress standards to receive this fund. True for all federal Title IV aid; may vary for institutional funds.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education SAP Regulations (34 CFR 668.34)

attributes.name: self_help_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is classified as self-help aid (loans and work-study) versus gift aid (grants and scholarships). Used in financial aid packaging strategies.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Aid Best Practices, Institutional Financial Aid Policy

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is considered taxable income to the student. Scholarships exceeding qualified education expenses and work-study earnings are typically taxable.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 970 (Tax Benefits for Education), Form 1098-T Reporting Requirements

Tracks budget components (tuition, fees, room, board, books, transportation, personal expenses), enrollment status assumptions, housing type, academic level, program of study, and component dollar amounts. Supports multiple budget versions per award year for different student populations (dependent on-campus, independent off-campus, etc.). SSOT for COA determination and need-based packaging calculations.

attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Cost of Attendance budgets are campus-specific under 34 CFR 668.41 — residential, commuter, and satellite campuses carry distinct COA components (room/board, transportation). Financial aid directors m

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Required for program reviews an

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Academic level of students for whom this COA budget applies (undergraduate, graduate, professional, post-baccalaureate, doctoral, certificate).
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Definitions

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this COA budget template was officially approved for use in financial aid packaging.

attributes.name: books_supplies_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost of books, course materials, supplies, and equipment required for the academic program.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Institution-defined code uniquely identifying this COA budget template (e.g., UG_DEP_ONCAMPUS, GRAD_IND_OFFCAMPUS).

attributes.name: budget_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the student population and assumptions for this COA budget template, including eligibility criteria and usage notes.

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the COA budget template (e.g., Undergraduate Dependent On-Campus, Graduate Independent Off-Campus with Family).

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this COA budget template (draft, active, superseded, archived).

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version number of this COA budget template, incremented when budget amounts are revised during the award year.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this COA budget template record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_hour_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of credit hours covered by this COA budget template, null if no upper limit applies.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: credit_hour_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours required for students to be eligible for this COA budget template, based on enrollment status.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: FAFSA dependency status assumption for this COA budget (dependent or independent student).
attributes.references: FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) Dependency Criteria

attributes.name: dependent_care_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for dependent care expenses (childcare or eldercare) for students with dependents, if applicable to this budget template.

attributes.name: disability_expenses_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for disability-related expenses for students with documented disabilities, if applicable to this budget template.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2, ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this COA budget template expires or is superseded by a new version, null if currently active.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this COA budget template becomes effective for financial aid packaging and need calculations.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Expected enrollment intensity for this COA budget (full-time, three-quarter-time, half-time, less-than-half-time) as defined by Title IV regulations.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: federal_methodology_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COA budget complies with federal Title IV methodology requirements for need-based aid packaging (True/False).
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: housing_type
attributes.description: Expected housing arrangement for students using this COA budget (on-campus, off-campus, with-parents).
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: institutional_methodology_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COA budget uses institutional methodology for institutional aid packaging, which may differ from federal methodology (True/False).

attributes.name: loan_fees_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for loan origination fees and other costs associated with federal student loans, if applicable.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, assumptions, or special instructions related to this COA budget template for financial aid staff reference.

attributes.name: personal_expenses_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for miscellaneous personal expenses including clothing, laundry, entertainment, and other living costs.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: professional_licensure_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for professional licensure exam fees, certification costs, and related expenses for professional programs (e.g., bar exam, medical boards).
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Student residency classification for tuition and fee purposes (in-state, out-of-state, international).

attributes.name: room_board_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for housing and food expenses based on the housing type assumption (on-campus room and board rates or off-campus living allowance).
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: study_abroad_amount
attributes.description: Additional allowance for study abroad program costs including international travel, visa fees, and higher living expenses, if applicable.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Academic term structure for which this COA budget is calculated (academic-year, fall-semester, spring-semester, summer-session, quarter, trimester).

attributes.name: total_coa_amount
attributes.description: Total Cost of Attendance calculated as the sum of all component amounts in this budget template, representing the maximum financial aid eligibility.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: transportation_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for transportation costs including commuting to campus and travel between home and school.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: tuition_fees_amount
attributes.description: Standard tuition and mandatory fees component of the COA budget for the award year and enrollment status.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.2

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this COA budget template record was last modified in the system.

SSOT for federal need analysis data. Sourced from Ellucian Banner ISIR Import.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student to whom this ISIR record belongs.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: ISIR processing follows annual regulatory guidance (HEA Title IV, annual Federal Register notices). Tracking which regulatory version governs each transaction year is essential for audit compliance an

attributes.name: automatic_zero_efc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automatic Zero Expected Family Contribution (EFC) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student qualifies for an automatic zero EFC based on income thresholds and other criteria.

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Student's citizenship status for federal financial aid eligibility purposes.

attributes.name: comment_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of comment codes providing additional information about the student's application, eligibility issues, or required actions.

attributes.name: correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ISIR represents a correction to a previously processed FAFSA application.

attributes.name: cps_version
attributes.description: Two-digit version number of the CPS software used to process this FAFSA application.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ISIR record was first loaded into the institutional system.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Student's date of birth as reported on the FAFSA.

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is classified as dependent or independent for federal financial aid purposes based on FAFSA dependency criteria.

attributes.name: efc
attributes.description: Expected Family Contribution calculated by the federal need analysis formula. Represents the amount a family is expected to contribute toward the student's education. Used for award years prior to 2024-2025.

attributes.name: fafsa_signature_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) Signature Date
attributes.description: Date when the student (and parent, if applicable) signed the FAFSA application.

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of people in the student's or parent's household as reported on the FAFSA. Used in federal need analysis calculation.

attributes.name: isir_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ISIR is from an original FAFSA submission, a correction, or a renewal application.

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Student's marital status as of the FAFSA filing date.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ISIR record was last updated in the institutional system.

attributes.name: number_in_college
attributes.description: Number of household members who will be enrolled in postsecondary education during the award year. Used in federal need analysis calculation.

attributes.name: parent_agi
attributes.description: Parent's adjusted gross income from federal tax return for the base year. Applicable only for dependent students.

attributes.name: parent_cash_savings
attributes.description: Total value of parent's cash, savings, and checking account balances as of the FAFSA filing date. Applicable only for dependent students.

attributes.name: parent_income_tax_paid
attributes.description: Amount of U.S. income tax paid by the parent(s) for the base year. Applicable only for dependent students.

attributes.name: parent_investment_net_worth
attributes.description: Net worth of parent's investments including stocks, bonds, real estate (excluding primary residence), and other investment assets. Applicable only for dependent students.

attributes.name: parent_marital_status
attributes.description: Marital status of the parent(s) as of the FAFSA filing date. Applicable only for dependent students.

attributes.name: parent_untaxed_income
attributes.description: Total untaxed income and benefits received by the parent(s). Applicable only for dependent students.

attributes.name: pell_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for a Federal Pell Grant based on the calculated EFC/SAI and other eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the FAFSA application was processed by the Central Processing System (CPS) and the ISIR was generated.

attributes.name: professional_judgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the financial aid office has exercised professional judgment to adjust data elements on this ISIR.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the institution received the ISIR record from the CPS.

attributes.name: reject_reason_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of reject codes indicating data errors or missing information that prevented full processing of the FAFSA. Blank if no rejects.

attributes.name: sai
attributes.description: Student Aid Index calculated by the federal need analysis formula. Replaces EFC starting with the 2024-2025 award year. Represents the measure of a family's financial strength.

attributes.name: simplified_needs_test_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student qualifies for the simplified needs test, which excludes asset information from the need analysis calculation.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Student's Social Security Number as reported on the FAFSA. Used for federal aid eligibility verification and identity matching.

attributes.name: state_of_legal_residence
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the student's state of legal residence for tuition purposes.

attributes.name: student_agi
attributes.description: Student's adjusted gross income from federal tax return for the base year. Used in federal need analysis calculation.

attributes.name: student_cash_savings
attributes.description: Total value of student's cash, savings, and checking account balances as of the FAFSA filing date.

attributes.name: student_income_tax_paid
attributes.description: Amount of U.S. income tax paid by the student for the base year.

attributes.name: student_investment_net_worth
attributes.description: Net worth of student's investments including stocks, bonds, real estate (excluding primary residence), and other investment assets.

attributes.name: student_untaxed_income
attributes.description: Total untaxed income and benefits received by the student, including child support, IRA deductions, and other untaxed income sources.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Sequential transaction number assigned by the Central Processing System (CPS) for each FAFSA submission or correction. Higher numbers indicate more recent submissions.

attributes.name: verification_selection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has been selected for federal verification by the CPS. True if selected, False if not selected.

attributes.name: verification_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Two-character code indicating the specific verification tracking group assigned by the CPS (e.g., V1, V4, V5, V6). Blank if not selected for verification.

products.name: sap_evaluation
products.description: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) evaluation record for a student at a defined checkpoint (end of term, payment period, or academic year). Captures qualitative measure (cumulative GPA vs. minimum), quantitative measure (pace/completion rate vs. 67% threshold), maximum timeframe check (150% of published program length), overall SAP status (meeting, warning, suspension, probation), evaluation date, and evaluation period. Includes appeal tracking (appeal date, appeal reason, appeal decision, approving official) and academic plan terms when students are placed on probation with conditions. SSOT for SAP compliance per 34 CFR 668.34.

attributes.name: academic_plan_conditions

attributes.name: academic_plan_end_term

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student submitted their SAP appeal. Null if no appeal was submitted.

attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the SAP appeal review: approved (student placed on probation with academic plan), denied (suspension upheld), pending review, or withdrawn by student.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SAP appeal decision was rendered by the financial aid office or appeals committee.

attributes.name: appeal_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason(s) for the SAP appeal, such as serious illness, death of family member, military deployment, or other mitigating circumstances that affected academic performance.

attributes.name: appeal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial aid officer, committee chair, or official who reviewed and decided the SAP appeal.

attributes.name: appeal_submitted_flag

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or documentation related to the SAP evaluation, appeal decision, or special circumstances considered by the evaluator.

attributes.name: completion_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The student's pace of progression, calculated as (cumulative earned credits / cumulative attempted credits) * 100. Federal regulation requires minimum 67% completion rate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SAP evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_attempted
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has attempted in the program as of this evaluation, including withdrawals, incompletes, and failed courses.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_earned

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: The student's cumulative GPA at the time of this SAP evaluation, calculated across all attempted coursework in the program.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Satisfactory Academic Progress evaluation was performed. Typically occurs at the end of a term or payment period.

attributes.name: evaluation_type

attributes.name: financial_aid_eligibility_status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SAP evaluation record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_credits_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of credit hours the student may attempt to complete the program, calculated as 150% of the published program length per federal regulation.

attributes.name: maximum_timeframe_status
attributes.description: Status of the maximum timeframe measure. Within_limit indicates the student can complete the program within 150% of published length; exceeded indicates the student cannot.

attributes.name: minimum_completion_rate_required
attributes.description: The minimum completion rate percentage required by the institution's SAP policy. Federal regulation mandates at least 67%.

attributes.name: minimum_gpa_required
attributes.description: The minimum cumulative GPA required by the institution's SAP policy for the student's program and academic level at the time of evaluation.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the SAP evaluation results were communicated to the student: email, postal mail, student portal message, in-person meeting, or phone call.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the institution notified the student of their SAP evaluation results and financial aid eligibility status.

attributes.name: overall_sap_status
attributes.description: The overall Satisfactory Academic Progress status resulting from this evaluation: meeting standards, warning (first failure), suspension (ineligible for aid), probation (on academic plan after appeal), dismissed, or reinstated.

attributes.name: prior_sap_status
attributes.description: The student's SAP status from the immediately preceding evaluation period, used to determine progression through warning, suspension, and probation stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: meeting|warning|suspension|probation|dismissed|reinstated|first_evaluation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: program_published_length
attributes.description: The published length of the student's academic program in credit hours, used as the basis for calculating the 150% maximum timeframe.

attributes.name: qualitative_measure_status
attributes.description: Status of the qualitative measure (cumulative GPA requirement). Pass indicates the student meets the minimum cumulative GPA threshold; fail indicates below threshold.

attributes.name: quantitative_measure_status
attributes.description: Status of the quantitative measure (pace/completion rate requirement). Pass indicates the student meets the minimum 67% completion rate; fail indicates below threshold.

attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: coa_amount
attributes.description: The total Cost of Attendance for the loan period, in USD. Includes tuition, fees, room, board, books, supplies, transportation, and personal expenses. Used to determine loan eligibility.

attributes.name: cod_accepted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Accepted Date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan record was accepted by the COD system. Confirms federal approval for loan origination and disbursement.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: cod_transaction_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Transaction Number
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the COD system for this loan origination or disbursement. Used for reconciliation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.description: The timestamp when this loan record was first created in the Student Information System. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.200; Federal Student Aid PLUS Loan Requirements

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is classified as dependent or independent for federal financial aid purposes. Determines loan eligibility and annual limits.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net loan amount was disbursed (credited) to the student's account. May differ from origination date due to processing delays or scheduled disbursement dates.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.164; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: disbursement_number
attributes.description: The sequence number of this disbursement within the loan period (e.g., 1 for first disbursement, 2 for second). Federal loans are typically disbursed in multiple installments per academic year.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.164; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: efc_amount
attributes.description: The Expected Family Contribution calculated from the FAFSA for the award year, in USD. Used to determine financial need and subsidized loan eligibility. Replaced by SAI (Student Aid Index) starting 2024-2025.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.2; FAFSA Processing; Federal Student Aid Handbook

attributes.name: endorser_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an endorser (co-signer) is required for a PLUS loan due to adverse credit history. True=endorser required, False=not required.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.200; Federal Student Aid PLUS Loan Requirements

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: The student's enrollment intensity at the time of loan origination. Affects loan eligibility and disbursement amounts.

attributes.name: entrance_counseling_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student completed entrance counseling, a federal requirement for first-time borrowers. Must be completed before first disbursement.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.304; Federal Student Aid Counseling Requirements

attributes.name: financial_need_amount
attributes.description: The calculated financial need for the loan period (COA minus EFC and other aid), in USD. Determines eligibility for subsidized loans.

attributes.name: grade_level
attributes.description: The student's academic grade level at the time of loan origination. Determines annual and aggregate loan limits. UG=Undergraduate, GRAD=Graduate, PROFESSIONAL=Professional (e.g., law, medicine).

attributes.name: gross_loan_amount
attributes.description: The total loan amount before any fees are deducted, in USD. This is the principal amount the student is authorized to borrow.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to the loan, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045 for 4.5%). Rate is fixed at origination and varies by loan type and award year.

attributes.name: loan_period_begin_date

attributes.name: loan_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the academic period (term or payment period) for which the loan is intended to cover costs. Defines the effective-until boundary for the loan period.

attributes.name: loan_servicer_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the federal loan servicer assigned to manage this loan after disbursement (e.g., MOHELA, Nelnet, Great Lakes). Used for borrower communication and repayment tracking.

attributes.name: loan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loan record. ORIGINATED=loan has been originated but not yet disbursed, DISBURSED=funds have been released to student account, CANCELLED=loan was cancelled before disbursement, RETURNED=disbursed funds were returned, ADJUSTED=loan amount or terms were adjusted post-origination.

attributes.name: loan_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the loan product. SUB=Direct Subsidized Loan, UNSUB=Direct Unsubsidized Loan, PLUS_PARENT=Direct PLUS Loan for Parents, PLUS_GRAD=Direct PLUS Loan for Graduate Students, PERKINS=Federal Perkins Loan, PRIVATE=Private/Alternative Loan.

attributes.name: mpn_signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student (or parent for PLUS loans) signed the Master Promissory Note. Required before loan disbursement.

attributes.name: net_loan_amount
attributes.description: The actual loan amount disbursed to the student after origination fees are deducted (gross_loan_amount minus origination_fee_amount), in USD.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: nslds_reported_date

attributes.description: The date on which this loan record was reported to the National Student Loan Data System. Required for federal compliance and borrower loan history tracking.

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan was officially originated and the borrower became legally obligated. This is the principal business event timestamp for the loan record.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: origination_fee_amount
attributes.description: The federal origination fee deducted from the gross loan amount, in USD. Fee percentage varies by loan type and award year.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.202; Federal Student Aid Fee Schedule

attributes.name: subsidized_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan is subsidized (government pays interest during in-school, grace, and deferment periods). True for Direct Subsidized Loans, False for all other loan types.

attributes.description: The academic term code (e.g., FALL2023, SPR2024) during which the loan was originated. Links to the institutional term calendar.
