Business justification: Federally-funded scholarships (TEACH grants, state grant programs, SEOG) carry specific regulatory requirements governing eligibility, service obligations, and reporting. scholarship already has polic

attributes.name: student_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.student_org. Business justification: Many scholarships are restricted to members of specific student organizations (Greek life scholarships, club-specific awards, honor society scholarships). Business process: Scholarship eligibility ver

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Academic level or degree program for which the scholarship is available. Restricts eligibility to undergraduate, graduate, doctoral, professional, or postdoctoral students, or allows any level.

attributes.name: application_deadline
attributes.description: Final date by which students must submit scholarship applications or supporting materials to be considered for the award cycle.

attributes.name: application_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether students must submit a separate scholarship application to be considered, or if the scholarship is automatically awarded based on admission or FAFSA data.

attributes.name: award_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which scholarship recipients are notified of their award. Used for planning financial aid packaging timelines and student communication.

attributes.name: class_standing
attributes.description: Specific class year or standing required for scholarship eligibility. May restrict awards to incoming freshmen, continuing sophomores, juniors, seniors, or graduate students.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for scholarship inquiries and administration. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for scholarship inquiries and administration. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: coordination_rule
attributes.description: Rule governing how this scholarship interacts with other financial aid in the student's award package. Determines whether the scholarship is stackable with other aid, reduces need-based aid, replaces loans, replaces work-study, or has no coordination requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scholarship record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the scholarship program ends or is no longer available for new awards. Null for perpetual endowed scholarships or ongoing programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the scholarship becomes available for awarding. Marks the beginning of the scholarship program's active period.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of all eligibility requirements for the scholarship, including academic qualifications, demographic criteria, residency requirements, major or program restrictions, financial need thresholds, and any other donor-specified or institutional criteria.

attributes.name: endowment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship is funded by an endowment with perpetual principal and annual earnings distribution, as opposed to annual or one-time funding.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Origin of the scholarship funds. Indicates whether the scholarship is funded by the institution, federal government, state government, private donor, corporation, foundation, alumni association, or endowment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: institutional|federal|state|private|corporate|foundation|alumni|endowment — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: major_restriction
attributes.description: Academic major, program, or field of study required for scholarship eligibility. May specify a single major, a list of eligible majors, or a broad discipline such as STEM (Science Technology Engineering Mathematics) or business.

attributes.name: maximum_award_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be awarded to a single recipient per academic year or term. Used in financial aid packaging to cap individual awards.

attributes.name: maximum_years_awarded
attributes.description: Maximum number of academic years a student may receive this scholarship, including initial award and renewals. Typically 4 for undergraduate scholarships, variable for graduate programs.

attributes.name: merit_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship is awarded based on academic merit, standardized test scores, or other achievement criteria independent of financial need.

attributes.name: minimum_award_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount that must be awarded if the scholarship is granted. Ensures awards meet donor or program requirements for minimum funding levels.

attributes.name: minimum_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours per term that a student must be enrolled in to be eligible for or retain the scholarship. Typically used to enforce full-time or half-time enrollment requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_gpa
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative or term GPA required for initial eligibility or renewal of the scholarship. Expressed on a 4.0 scale.

attributes.name: need_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship requires demonstrated financial need as determined by FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) and EFC (Expected Family Contribution) calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal administrative notes, special instructions, donor preferences, or historical context about the scholarship program. Not visible to students.

attributes.name: renewable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship can be renewed for multiple academic years if the recipient continues to meet eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: renewal_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the academic, enrollment, and behavioral requirements a student must maintain to renew the scholarship for subsequent years. May include minimum GPA, credit hour requirements, major continuation, and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) standards.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Classification of the scholarship for IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) and other regulatory reporting purposes. Aligns with federal financial aid reporting categories.

attributes.name: residency_requirement
attributes.description: Geographic or residency restrictions for scholarship eligibility, such as state residency, county of origin, or international student status. May specify in-state, out-of-state, or specific geographic regions.

attributes.name: scholarship_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or identifier for the scholarship used in financial aid packaging and student communications. Business identifier for the scholarship.

attributes.name: scholarship_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the scholarship or grant program as it appears in institutional publications and award letters.

attributes.name: scholarship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scholarship. Indicates whether the scholarship is actively available for awarding, temporarily suspended, permanently discontinued, or pending approval for activation.

attributes.name: scholarship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scholarship by its primary awarding criteria and funding structure. Distinguishes merit-based, need-based, departmental, endowed, external/private, athletic, diversity, research, and service scholarships. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: merit|need_based|departmental|endowed|external|athletic|diversity|research|service — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship is considered taxable income under IRS regulations. Scholarships used for room, board, or non-qualified expenses may be taxable.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scholarship record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes to scholarship terms, funding, or eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Web address for additional scholarship information, application instructions, and donor recognition. May link to institutional financial aid portal or external scholarship provider site.

SSOT for veteran benefit administration, enrollment certification, and SCO compliance under 38 U.S.C.

attributes.name: award_package_id

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: GI Bill Chapter 33 Monthly Housing Allowance is calculated using the campus ZIP code/BAH rate. School Certifying Officials must certify enrollment at a specific campus for VA enrollment certification

attributes.name: certification_term_id

attributes.name: certified_course_section_id

attributes.name: enrollment_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to student.enrollment_status. Business justification: VA benefit certification requires official enrollment verification — the SCO must certify credit hours and training time against the official enrollment_status record. This is a named VA compliance pr

VA certification process requires documented housing assignment to determine correct BAH

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id

Business justification: VA enrollment certifications submitted via VA-ONCE are regulatory filings to the VA. veteran_benefit.certification_date and sco_remarks confirm this named filing process. SCOs must track which VA-ONCE

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. SCO certification requires compliance with specific VA regulatory requirements. veteran_b

attributes.name: benefit_chapter
attributes.description: The specific VA education benefit program chapter under which the student is receiving benefits. CH33 = Post-9/11 GI Bill, CH30 = Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty, CH35 = Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance, CH1606 = Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserve, VRAP = Veteran Rapid Retraining Assistance Program.

attributes.name: benefit_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of full benefit entitlement the student is eligible to receive, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. For Post-9/11 GI Bill, determined by length of active duty service (e.g., 90 days = 40%, 36 months = 100%).

attributes.name: benefit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the veteran benefit. Active = currently receiving benefits, Pending = application submitted awaiting approval, Suspended = temporarily paused, Terminated = ended by student or institution, Exhausted = all benefit entitlement used, Denied = application rejected by VA.

attributes.name: book_stipend_amount
attributes.description: The annual book and supplies stipend amount the student is eligible to receive under Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33). Typically $1,000 per academic year, prorated based on training time and benefit percentage. Not applicable for other benefit chapters.

attributes.name: certificate_of_eligibility_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the Department of Veterans Affairs confirming the student's eligibility for education benefits. Required for enrollment certification and benefit disbursement.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the School Certifying Official (SCO) certified the student's enrollment to the VA for the current term. Required for VA payment processing and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: certified_credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of credit hours certified to the VA for the current enrollment period. Used to determine the student's training time (full-time, three-quarter-time, half-time) and corresponding benefit payment rate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this veteran benefit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delimiting_date
attributes.description: The final date by which the student must use their veteran education benefits. For Post-9/11 GI Bill, typically 15 years from the date of last discharge from active duty. After this date, unused benefits expire.

attributes.name: eligibility_begin_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student becomes eligible to receive veteran education benefits under this benefit chapter. Typically corresponds to the service discharge date or eligibility determination date.

attributes.name: eligibility_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's eligibility for veteran education benefits expires. For Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33), typically 15 years from last discharge date. Null if no expiration or benefit exhausted before expiration.

attributes.name: kicker_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is eligible for an additional monthly kicker payment (also known as College Fund) based on their military service agreement. True = kicker eligible, False = not eligible. Kicker is an additional benefit on top of standard GI Bill payments.

attributes.name: kicker_monthly_amount
attributes.description: The additional monthly kicker payment amount the student is eligible to receive based on their military service agreement. Null if student is not kicker eligible.

attributes.name: last_certification_change_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent change to the student's enrollment certification submitted to the VA. Changes may include enrollment status updates, credit hour adjustments, or program changes that affect benefit eligibility.

attributes.name: last_certification_change_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the most recent change to the student's enrollment certification. Examples include course withdrawal, program change, enrollment status change, or correction of certification error.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this veteran benefit record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the most recent benefit payment disbursed by the VA for this student. Includes tuition, housing allowance, and book stipend components as applicable.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent benefit payment disbursed by the VA for this student. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: monthly_housing_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The monthly housing allowance amount the student is eligible to receive under Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33). Amount is based on the Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) rate for an E-5 with dependents at the institution's ZIP code. Not applicable for other benefit chapters.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the VA benefit payment for the certified enrollment period. Pending = certification submitted awaiting VA processing, In Progress = VA processing payment, Paid = payment completed and disbursed, Denied = payment rejected by VA, Suspended = payment temporarily halted.

attributes.name: remaining_entitlement_months
attributes.description: The number of months of benefit entitlement remaining for the student. Typically starts at 36 months for full-time enrollment and decreases based on certified enrollment hours. Tracked to two decimal places for partial month usage.

attributes.name: sco_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text notes and remarks entered by the School Certifying Official regarding the student's veteran benefit status, certification issues, special circumstances, or communication with the VA. Used for case management and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: training_time
attributes.description: The enrollment intensity classification for the student based on certified credit hours. Full-time = 12+ credits (undergraduate) or 9+ credits (graduate), Three-quarter-time = 9-11 credits (UG) or 7-8 credits (G), Half-time = 6-8 credits (UG) or 5-6 credits (G), Less-than-half-time = below half-time threshold.

attributes.name: tuition_and_fees_paid_to_school
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tuition and Fees Paid to School Amount
attributes.description: The total amount of tuition and fees paid directly to the institution by the VA on behalf of the student for the current enrollment period. For Post-9/11 GI Bill, capped at the in-state tuition rate for public institutions or the national maximum for private institutions.

attributes.name: vocational_rehab_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is receiving benefits under the Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) program (Chapter 31) in addition to or instead of standard education benefits. True = VR&E participant, False = not VR&E participant.

attributes.name: vr_and_e_counselor_email
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Counselor Email Address
attributes.description: The email address for the VA Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor assigned to the student. Null if student is not a VR&E participant.

attributes.name: vr_and_e_counselor_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Counselor Name
attributes.description: The name of the VA Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor assigned to the student. Null if student is not a VR&E participant.

attributes.name: vr_and_e_counselor_phone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vocational Rehabilitation and Employment (VR&E) Counselor Phone Number
attributes.description: The contact phone number for the VA Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor assigned to the student. Null if student is not a VR&E participant.

attributes.name: yellow_ribbon_institution_contribution
attributes.description: The amount the institution has agreed to contribute toward the student's tuition and fees under the Yellow Ribbon Program. The VA matches this amount dollar-for-dollar. Null if student is not a Yellow Ribbon participant.

attributes.name: yellow_ribbon_participant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is participating in the Yellow Ribbon Program, which provides additional funding for tuition and fees exceeding the Post-9/11 GI Bill maximum benefit. True = participating, False = not participating. Only applicable to Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33) recipients at 100% benefit level.

attributes.name: yellow_ribbon_va_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Yellow Ribbon Veterans Affairs (VA) Contribution Amount
attributes.description: The amount the Department of Veterans Affairs contributes toward the student's tuition and fees under the Yellow Ribbon Program, matching the institution's contribution. Null if student is not a Yellow Ribbon participant.

products.name: award_year
products.description: Master reference table for award_year. Referenced by award_year_id.

attributes.name: award_year_id
attributes.description: Primary key for award_year

attributes.name: prior_award_year_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on award_year (prior_award_year_id)

attributes.name: academic_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the academic calendar year associated with this award year.

attributes.name: academic_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the academic calendar year associated with this award year, which may differ from the financial aid award year start date.

attributes.name: application_deadline_date
attributes.description: The priority deadline date for students to submit financial aid applications for this award year.

attributes.name: application_open_date
attributes.description: The date when financial aid applications open for this award year.

attributes.name: award_year_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the award year in format YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2023-2024). This is the externally-known code used across financial aid operations.

attributes.name: award_year_description
attributes.description: Detailed description or notes about this award year including any special considerations, policy changes, or operational notes.

attributes.name: award_year_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the award year (e.g., 'Academic Year 2023-2024').

attributes.name: award_year_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the award year indicating whether it is currently in use for financial aid processing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this award year record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: default_cost_of_attendance_amount
attributes.description: The default or baseline cost of attendance amount used for financial aid calculations for this award year before student-specific adjustments.

attributes.name: direct_subsidized_loan_annual_limit
attributes.description: The annual borrowing limit for Direct Subsidized Loans for dependent undergraduate students in this award year.

attributes.name: direct_unsubsidized_loan_annual_limit
attributes.description: The annual borrowing limit for Direct Unsubsidized Loans for undergraduate students in this award year.

attributes.name: disbursement_end_date
attributes.description: The latest date financial aid disbursements can be made for this award year.

attributes.name: disbursement_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date financial aid disbursements can be made for this award year.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the award year ends and financial aid processing concludes for this period.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The latest date students can be enrolled for terms within this award year.

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date students can begin enrollment for terms within this award year.

attributes.name: fafsa_cycle_code
attributes.description: FAFSA processing cycle identifier associated with this award year for federal aid application processing.

attributes.name: federal_award_year_code
attributes.description: Four-digit federal award year code used for Title IV federal student aid reporting and FAFSA processing (e.g., 2024 for the 2023-2024 award year).

attributes.name: federal_pell_maximum_amount
attributes.description: The maximum Federal Pell Grant award amount available for this award year as determined by federal regulations.

attributes.name: is_current_year
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active award year for financial aid operations.

attributes.name: is_default_year
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this award year should be used as the default selection in financial aid systems.

attributes.name: packaging_end_date
attributes.description: The date when financial aid packaging operations conclude for this award year.

attributes.name: packaging_start_date
attributes.description: The date when financial aid packaging operations begin for this award year.

attributes.name: r2t4_calculation_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Return to Title IV calculations are enabled and required for withdrawals in this award year.

attributes.name: sap_evaluation_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Satisfactory Academic Progress evaluation is required for students receiving aid in this award year.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of award years in user interfaces and reports, with lower values appearing first.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the award year becomes effective and financial aid processing begins for this period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this award year record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: verification_deadline_date
attributes.description: The deadline date by which students must complete verification requirements for this award year.

domains.name: research
domains.description: Governs the full sponsored research lifecycle including grant proposals, award management, IRB protocol compliance, subaward administration, and PI tracking. Manages funding sources (NSF, NIH), F&A rates, IDC recovery, research expenditures, and closeout processes. Integrates with Kuali Research and supports RAE assessments and federal sponsor reporting.

Captures the full proposal lifecycle from pre-submission through agency decision, including proposal number, title, abstract, submission deadline, sponsor agency, program announcement, requested budget, F&A rate applied, submission date, status (draft, submitted, awarded, declined, withdrawn), PI information, lead department, CFDA number, project period start/end, indirect cost rate type, and Kuali Research proposal ID. Serves as the authoritative source for all pre-award activity.

Higher-ed research admi

attributes.name: proposal_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the academic or research department that is the primary organizational unit responsible for the proposal.

Business justification: Proposals must document compliance with specific regulatory requirements (45 CFR 46 for human subjects, Animal Welfare Act, EAR/ITAR) for sponsor review and institutional approval. Required for pre-aw

attributes.name: sponsor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.sponsor. Business justification: proposal has sponsor_agency_name which should be normalized via FK to sponsor master table. Proposals are submitted to sponsors; this is a critical relationship for accessing sponsor requirements, sub

attributes.name: abstract
attributes.description: Executive summary or abstract of the research proposal describing the project objectives, methodology, and expected outcomes. Used for internal review and reporting.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Primary type of sponsored activity proposed (research, instruction, public service, or other). Used for institutional reporting and cost accounting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: biohazard_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the proposed research involves biohazardous materials and requires Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) approval.
attributes.references: NIH Guidelines for Research Involving Recombinant DNA, IBC Regulations

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the proposal budget (typically USD for U.S. institutions). Required for international collaborations and multi-currency proposals.

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: Five-digit CFDA number identifying the federal program under which funding is requested. Required for federal grant proposals and used for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of institutional cost sharing or matching funds committed in the proposal. Represents the institutions financial contribution to the project.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Sponsor Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_sharing_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the sponsor requires institutional cost sharing or matching funds as a condition of the award.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Sponsor Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: decision_date

attributes.references: NSF Grant Proposal Guide, NIH Application Guide

attributes.name: direct_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total direct costs requested in the proposal budget, including salaries, equipment, supplies, and travel. Excludes indirect costs.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF Grant Proposal Guide

attributes.name: fa_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) indirect cost rate percentage applied to the proposal budget. This is the negotiated rate approved by the federal cognizant agency.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Institutional F&A Rate Agreement

attributes.name: human_subjects_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the proposed research involves human subjects and requires Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval.

attributes.name: iacuc_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) Approval Status
attributes.description: Current status of Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) approval for vertebrate animal research. Required for proposals involving animal subjects.
attributes.references: PHS Policy on Humane Care and Use of Laboratory Animals, USDA Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: ibc_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) approval for biohazard research. Required for proposals involving recombinant DNA or biohazardous materials.
attributes.references: NIH Guidelines for Research Involving Recombinant DNA, IBC Regulations

attributes.name: indirect_cost_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Indirect Cost Amount (Facilities and Administrative Costs)
attributes.description: Total indirect costs (also known as Facilities and Administrative or F&A costs) requested in the proposal budget. Calculated by applying the institutional IDC rate to the direct cost base.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Institutional F&A Rate Agreement

attributes.name: irb_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval for human subjects research. Required for proposals involving human participants.

attributes.name: kuali_research_proposal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proposal in the Kuali Research system. Used for integration and cross-reference with the source system of record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proposal record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: project_duration_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the proposed project period expressed in months. Calculated from project start and end dates.
attributes.references: NSF Grant Proposal Guide, NIH Application Guide

attributes.name: project_end_date

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.name: submission_deadline

attributes.name: title

Supports NACUBO-compliant financial reporting and federal sponsor drawdown reconciliation.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_costs

attributes.name: personnel_costs

attributes.name: sponsor_approved_amount

attributes.name: subcontract_costs

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget was formally submitted to the sponsor for review and approval.

attributes.name: supplies_costs
attributes.description: Total costs for consumable supplies, laboratory materials, and other items with a unit cost below the equipment threshold.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.94; NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget for the period, calculated as the sum of total direct costs and total F&A costs.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: total_direct_costs
attributes.description: Sum of all direct cost categories including personnel, fringe, equipment, travel, supplies, subcontracts, and other direct costs for the budget period.

attributes.name: total_fa_costs
attributes.description: Total indirect costs calculated based on the institution's negotiated F&A rate applied to the modified total direct costs base.

attributes.name: travel_costs
attributes.description: Total costs for domestic and international travel necessary for the conduct of the research project, including airfare, lodging, meals, and ground transportation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.474; NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: unrecovered_fa_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the F&A costs calculated at the institution's negotiated rate and the amount actually recovered from the sponsor, representing institutional cost sharing.

attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the sponsor's program officer or grants administrator. Includes country code, area code, and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the sponsor organization's primary location (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Used to classify domestic vs. foreign sponsors for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to uniquely identify the sponsor organization. Legacy identifier being replaced by UEI but still required for historical awards.

attributes.name: federal_agency_code
attributes.description: Standard federal agency abbreviation for U.S. government sponsors (e.g., NSF, NIH, DOD, DOE, NASA, ED). Null for non-federal sponsors. Used for federal compliance reporting and IPEDS surveys.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Federal Agency Code List

attributes.name: idc_rate_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum indirect cost rate percentage allowed by this sponsor, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). Null if sponsor accepts institution's negotiated rate without cap.
attributes.references: Sponsor-Specific IDC Policy and 2 CFR Part 200

attributes.name: indirect_cost_negotiation_status
attributes.description: Sponsor's policy on indirect cost recovery. Determines whether institution's federally negotiated F&A rate applies or if sponsor-specific rate caps are enforced.
attributes.references: 2 CFR Part 200 Subpart E (Cost Principles) and Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: is_federal_sponsor
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sponsor is a U.S. federal government agency. True for federal agencies (NSF, NIH, DOD, etc.); False for all other sponsor types. Determines applicability of federal compliance requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Federal Agency Classification

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for research administrators to capture sponsor-specific policies, special requirements, historical context, or other relevant information not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Kuali Research Sponsor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: payment_mechanism
attributes.description: Primary method by which the sponsor disburses award funds to the institution. Determines cash flow management and drawdown procedures for awarded grants.
attributes.references: 2 CFR Part 200.305 (Payment) and Treasury Financial Manual

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from invoice submission to payment for reimbursement-based sponsors. Null for letter-of-credit or advance payment mechanisms.

attributes.name: portal_url
attributes.description: Web address of the sponsor's online grant management portal or system. Used by Principal Investigators (PIs) and research administrators for proposal submission, award management, and reporting.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the sponsor organization's primary mailing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: preferred_submission_system
attributes.description: Primary electronic system or platform required by the sponsor for proposal submissions. Federal agencies typically mandate specific systems (Grants.gov for most agencies, FastLane for NSF, eRA Commons for NIH). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grants_gov|fastlane|era_commons|workspace|sponsor_portal|email|not_specified — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Grant Application Systems and Sponsor Guidelines

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sponsor record was first created in the research administration system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the research administrator who last modified this sponsor record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sponsor record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute value changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: requires_cost_sharing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sponsor mandates institutional cost sharing as a condition of award. True if cost sharing is required; False if optional or not allowed.
attributes.references: 2 CFR Part 200.306 (Cost Sharing or Matching) and Sponsor Guidelines

attributes.name: requires_iacuc_approval
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) Approval Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sponsor mandates IACUC protocol approval for research involving vertebrate animals. True for federal sponsors and most foundations funding animal research.
attributes.references: Animal Welfare Act and PHS Policy on Humane Care and Use of Laboratory Animals

attributes.name: requires_institutional_review_board
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Institutional Review Board (IRB) Approval Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sponsor mandates IRB protocol approval for human subjects research. True for most federal sponsors and many foundations; False for sponsors that do not fund human subjects research.
attributes.references: 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule) and Sponsor-Specific Requirements

attributes.name: sam_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date when the sponsor's SAM.gov registration expires. Federal sponsors must renew annually. Null for non-federal sponsors.

attributes.name: sam_registration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Registration Status
attributes.description: Current registration status of the sponsor in SAM.gov. Federal sponsors must maintain active SAM registration to award grants. Non-federal sponsors are marked not_applicable.

attributes.name: sponsor_code
attributes.description: Institution-assigned unique alphanumeric code for the sponsor. Used as the business identifier in proposal routing, award setup, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the funding sponsor organization as registered with federal or state authorities. Used for official proposal submissions and award documents.

attributes.name: sponsor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sponsor record. Active sponsors are eligible for new proposal submissions; inactive sponsors are retained for historical award management only.

attributes.name: sponsor_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the sponsor entity. Determines applicable compliance requirements, reporting obligations, and indirect cost policies.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Research Revenue Classification

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the sponsor organization's primary mailing address. Use standard two-letter abbreviations for U.S. states.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations and International Standards

attributes.name: uei_number
attributes.description: Twelve-character alphanumeric Unique Entity Identifier assigned by SAM.gov to replace DUNS. Required for all federal grant applications submitted after April 2022.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Primary web address of the sponsor organization's public website. Provides access to funding opportunity announcements, program guidelines, and sponsor policies.

products.name: subaward
products.description: Transactional record for a subaward issued to a subrecipient organization under a prime sponsored research award. Captures subaward number, subrecipient organization name, subrecipient DUNS/UEI, subrecipient PI name, subaward type (subcontract, subgrant), total subaward amount, executed amount, period of performance, scope of work summary, monitoring risk level, subrecipient audit requirement (Single Audit threshold), invoicing frequency, payment terms, subaward status (pending, executed, active, closed), and federal flow-down clause applicability. Supports OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 subrecipient monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: subaward_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subaward record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant_account. Business justification: Subawards are funded from grant accounts. This link supports subrecipient cost tracking against the parent grant account budget — required for federal financial reporting (SF-425) and subrecipient mon

attributes.name: idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.idc_rate. Business justification: subaward has indirect_cost_rate which should be normalized via FK to idc_rate master table. Subawards apply specific IDC rates (either the subrecipient's negotiated rate or a rate specified in the pri

attributes.name: institutional_contact_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Subaward monitoring requires institutional liaison for compliance oversight, invoice review, reporting coordination, and subrecipient communication. Essential for post-award office workload distributi

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.purchase_order. Business justification: Subawards are encumbered via purchase orders in the financial system. Linking subaward to the PO supports encumbrance tracking, financial commitment reporting, and procurement compliance on federally-

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent prime sponsored research award under which this subaward is issued.

attributes.name: closeout_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward was officially closed out after all financial and administrative requirements were satisfied.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of cost sharing or matching funds that the subrecipient has committed to provide, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subrecipient is required to provide cost sharing or matching funds as a condition of the subaward.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the research administrator who created this subaward record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subaward record was first created in the research administration system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this subaward record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: executed_amount
attributes.description: Amount currently executed and available for expenditure under the subaward. May differ from total amount if incremental funding is used.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward agreement was fully executed by all parties. Represents the official start of the contractual relationship.

attributes.name: federal_award_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Award Identification Number assigned by the prime sponsor to the parent award. Required for FFATA subaward reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA)

attributes.name: federal_flow_down_clauses_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal flow-down clauses and requirements from the prime award must be incorporated into the subaward agreement. Typically true for federally-funded subawards.

attributes.name: invoicing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the subrecipient is permitted to submit invoices for reimbursement or payment under the subaward terms.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the research administrator who last modified this subaward record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subaward record was last modified in the research administration system.

attributes.name: monitoring_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk assessment level assigned to the subrecipient for monitoring purposes. Determines frequency and intensity of oversight activities required under OMB Uniform Guidance.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of the payment terms and conditions, including timing, method, and any advance payment provisions applicable to the subaward.

attributes.name: period_of_performance_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward period of performance ends. Subrecipient must complete all work and incur all allowable costs by this date.

attributes.name: period_of_performance_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward period of performance begins. Subrecipient may incur allowable costs starting from this date.

attributes.name: prime_sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the federal or non-federal sponsor providing funding for the prime award under which this subaward is issued (e.g., NSF, NIH, DOE).

attributes.name: scope_of_work_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the research activities, deliverables, and objectives that the subrecipient is responsible for under this subaward.

attributes.name: single_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subrecipient is required to undergo a Single Audit under the OMB Uniform Guidance. Required if subrecipient expends $750,000 or more in federal awards in a fiscal year.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F

attributes.name: subaward_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the subaward, typically assigned by the institution's research administration office. Used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: subaward_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subaward. Pending indicates awaiting execution; executed indicates signed but not yet active; active indicates work in progress; suspended indicates temporary hold; closed indicates normal completion; terminated indicates early cancellation.

attributes.name: subaward_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subaward instrument. Distinguishes between subcontracts (procurement), subgrants (assistance), consortium agreements, consultant agreements, vendor agreements, and other arrangements.

attributes.name: subrecipient_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: subrecipient_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address (suite, building, department).

attributes.name: subrecipient_city
attributes.description: City of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: subrecipient_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary administrative contact at the subrecipient organization.

attributes.name: subrecipient_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary administrative contact at the subrecipient organization for subaward management and compliance matters.

attributes.name: subrecipient_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary administrative contact at the subrecipient organization.

attributes.name: subrecipient_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the subrecipient organization's location.

attributes.name: subrecipient_pi_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the subrecipient PI for official communications regarding the subaward.

attributes.name: subrecipient_pi_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Principal Investigator at the subrecipient organization who is responsible for the scientific and technical direction of the subaward project.

attributes.name: subrecipient_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: subrecipient_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward was terminated prior to the scheduled end date, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the reason for early termination of the subaward, if applicable. May include convenience, cause, or mutual agreement.

attributes.name: total_subaward_amount
attributes.description: Total obligated amount of the subaward over its entire period of performance, including all modifications and amendments.

products.name: irb_protocol
products.description: Master record for an Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol governing human subjects research. Captures protocol number, protocol title, PI name, study type (exempt, expedited, full board), review category, approval date, expiration date, protocol status (pending, approved, suspended, closed, expired), subject population description, estimated enrollment, risk level classification, consent waiver status, data safety monitoring requirements, adverse event reporting history, continuing review due date, and Kuali Research IRB protocol ID. Required for OHRP compliance and federal research assurance (FWA) reporting.
products.reference: Kuali Research - IRB Module / 45 CFR 46 (Common Rule)

attributes.description: Primary key for irb_protocol

Existing college_name and department

attributes.description: Reference to the faculty or researcher serving as the Principal Investigator responsible for the conduct of this research study.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: IRB protocols implement specific federal regulations (45 CFR 46 Common Rule, FDA 21 CFR 50/56). Direct link required for regulatory compliance reporting, OHRP/FDA audits, and accreditation reviews (AA

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant award funding this research protocol. Links IRB protocol to sponsored research administration records.
attributes.references: Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Institutional Research Administration

attributes.name: research_room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: IRB protocols must document exact rooms where human subjects research occurs for compliance audits, emergency response, and regulatory inspections. OHRP and FDA audits require room-level documentation

attributes.name: sponsor_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_program. Links protocol to required training for personnel authorization and regulatory compliance ve

attributes.name: actual_enrollment
attributes.description: The actual number of human subjects enrolled in the study to date. Updated throughout the study lifecycle.

attributes.name: adverse_event_count
attributes.description: Total number of adverse events reported for this protocol to date. Used for safety monitoring and continuing review.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of amendments or modifications submitted and approved for this protocol since initial approval.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB granted approval for the research protocol to commence. This is the effective start date for the protocol.

attributes.name: clinical_trial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol is a clinical trial as defined by NIH and FDA. Clinical trials have additional registration and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: clinicaltrials_gov_number
attributes.description: The unique NCT number assigned by ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials subject to registration requirements. Required for applicable clinical trials.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol was officially closed by the IRB. Indicates completion of all research activities and final reporting.

attributes.name: consent_waiver_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IRB has granted a waiver or alteration of informed consent requirements for this protocol.

attributes.name: continuing_review_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the PI must submit a continuing review application to maintain active IRB approval. Critical for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.109(e), OHRP Guidance on Continuing Review

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IRB protocol record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_safety_monitoring_plan
attributes.description: Description of the data and safety monitoring procedures in place for this protocol, including frequency of monitoring and responsible parties.
attributes.references: NIH Policy on Data and Safety Monitoring, FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: data_safety_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol requires a formal data and safety monitoring plan or Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB). Typically required for higher-risk studies.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.111, NIH Policy on Data and Safety Monitoring

attributes.name: estimated_enrollment
attributes.description: The anticipated total number of human subjects to be enrolled in the research study. Used for risk assessment and resource planning.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current IRB approval expires. Research activities must cease or continuing review must be completed before this date.

attributes.name: fda_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the research involves FDA-regulated products (drugs, biologics, devices) and is subject to FDA regulations in addition to Common Rule.

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Primary category of funding supporting this research protocol. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46, NSF Grant Policy Manual, NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol requires HIPAA authorization for use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI). Applicable to research involving medical records or health data.

attributes.name: initial_approval_date
attributes.description: Date of the very first IRB approval for this protocol. Distinct from approval_date which may reflect a continuing review approval.

attributes.name: irb_of_record
attributes.description: Name of the IRB serving as the single IRB of record for multi-site research. For single-site studies, this is the institutions own IRB.

attributes.name: kuali_research_protocol_number
attributes.description: The unique protocol identifier in the Kuali Research system of record. Used for integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent protocol amendment approval. Used for version control and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this IRB protocol record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: multi_site_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the research is conducted at multiple sites or institutions. Multi-site studies may use a single IRB of record or require local IRB review at each site.

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique protocol number assigned by the IRB office. This is the business identifier used in all communications, submissions, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: protocol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IRB protocol. Tracks the protocol through submission, review, approval, active research, and closure phases.

attributes.name: protocol_title
attributes.description: The full title of the research study as submitted to the IRB. This is the official name of the research project.

attributes.name: protocol_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the protocol document. Incremented with each amendment or modification approved by the IRB.

attributes.name: review_category
attributes.description: Specific regulatory category under which the protocol was reviewed (e.g., exempt category 1-8, expedited category 1-9). Provides granular classification within study type.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.104, 45 CFR 46.110, Federal Register Vol. 83 No. 21

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: IRB assessment of the level of risk to human subjects participating in the research. Determines review requirements and monitoring intensity.

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_count
attributes.description: Total number of serious adverse events (SAEs) reported for this protocol. SAEs require expedited reporting to the IRB and sponsor.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the research study based on the level of IRB review required. Determines the review pathway and approval authority.

attributes.name: subject_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the human subjects population to be enrolled in the study, including inclusion and exclusion criteria, vulnerable populations, and demographic characteristics.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol was originally submitted to the IRB for review.

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study involves vulnerable populations such as children, prisoners, pregnant women, or cognitively impaired individuals. Triggers additional regulatory protections.

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_types
attributes.description: Specific types of vulnerable populations included in the study (e.g., children, prisoners, pregnant women, economically disadvantaged, cognitively impaired). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

Supports federal financial reporting (SF-425 Federal Financial Report), IPEDS research expenditure reporting, and IDC recovery calculations.

attributes.description: The budget period number within the award lifecycle during which this expenditure occurred (e.g., Year 1, Year 2).
attributes.references: NSF Grant Proposal Guide - Budget Periods

attributes.name: closeout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure is part of the award closeout process and final financial reporting to the sponsor.

attributes.name: cost_share_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure represents institutional cost sharing or matching funds required by the sponsor.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Cost Sharing

attributes.name: cumulative_expenditure_to_date
attributes.description: The total cumulative expenditure amount charged to the award account from inception through this transaction date.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD for US Dollar).

attributes.name: direct_cost_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure is classified as a direct cost (true) or indirect cost (false) for federal reporting purposes.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.413 - Direct Costs

attributes.name: effort_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of an employee's total compensated effort devoted to this research award, used for salary cost allocation and effort reporting.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of funds reserved or committed for future payment but not yet expended (e.g., purchase orders, contracts).

attributes.name: expenditure_category
attributes.description: The high-level categorization of the expenditure aligned with federal sponsor reporting requirements and budget categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salaries|fringe_benefits|travel|supplies|equipment|subcontracts|other_direct_costs|indirect_costs — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NSF Grant Proposal Guide - Budget Categories

attributes.name: expenditure_description
attributes.description: A detailed textual description of the expenditure transaction providing context about the goods, services, or purpose of the charge.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the transaction was posted, typically numbered 1-12.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the expenditure transaction occurred, typically represented as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: The sponsor-assigned grant or award number for external identification and reporting (e.g., NSF award number, NIH grant number).

attributes.name: idc_amount
attributes.description: The calculated indirect cost (facilities and administrative) amount recovered on this expenditure transaction.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.414 - Indirect Costs

attributes.name: idc_rate
attributes.description: The facilities and administrative (F&A) indirect cost rate applied to this expenditure for overhead recovery, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5400 for 54%).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.414 - Indirect Costs

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the expenditure record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: object_code
attributes.description: The financial object code that classifies the nature of the expenditure in the chart of accounts (e.g., salaries, supplies, travel).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: object_code_description
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the object code providing human-readable classification of the expenditure type.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the expenditure transaction was posted to the financial system.

attributes.name: reasonable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the expenditure is reasonable in nature and amount for the performance of the research award.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.404 - Reasonable Costs

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the expenditure transaction charged to the award account. Positive values represent charges; negative values represent credits or reversals.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date when the expenditure transaction was posted to the award account in the financial system.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier or journal entry reference number from the source financial system.

attributes.name: transaction_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source financial system from which this expenditure transaction originated (e.g., PeopleSoft Financials, Kuali Research).

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the expenditure transaction in the financial system workflow.

products.name: idc_rate
products.description: Reference record for negotiated Facilities and Administrative (F&A) / Indirect Cost (IDC) rates established between the institution and its federal cognizant agency (typically DHHS or ONR). Captures rate type (on-campus research, off-campus research, instruction, other sponsored activities), rate percentage, applicable base (MTDC - Modified Total Direct Costs), effective start date, effective end date, negotiation agreement date, cognizant federal agency, rate agreement document reference, and predetermined vs. fixed vs. provisional rate designation. Governs IDC recovery calculations on all federal awards.
products.reference: 2 CFR 200 Appendix III / F&A Rate Negotiation Agreement

attributes.name: idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Primary key for idc_rate

attributes.name: prior_rate_agreement_idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous rate agreement that this rate supersedes or replaces. Enables tracking of rate history and changes over time.

attributes.name: administrative_rate_component
attributes.description: The administrative portion of the F&A rate, covering general administration, departmental administration, and sponsored projects administration costs. Typically 26% of the total rate.

attributes.name: applicable_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The institution's fiscal year to which this rate applies. Used for multi-year rate agreements where different rates may apply to different fiscal periods.

attributes.name: approved_by_official
attributes.description: Name and title of the cognizant agency official who approved and signed the rate agreement. Used for verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: carryforward_provision
attributes.description: Description of any carryforward provisions in the rate agreement that allow over- or under-recovery of IDC in one period to be adjusted in subsequent periods.

attributes.name: cognizant_agency
attributes.description: The federal agency responsible for negotiating and approving the institution's IDC rates. Typically DHHS (Department of Health and Human Services) or ONR (Office of Naval Research) for most universities.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.19 Cognizant Agency for Indirect Costs

attributes.name: cost_base_type
attributes.description: The cost base to which the rate percentage is applied. MTDC (Modified Total Direct Costs) is most common and excludes equipment, capital expenditures, subawards over $25K, and other specified costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IDC rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this IDC rate expires and is no longer applicable to new awards. Nullable for open-ended agreements or provisional rates pending final negotiation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this IDC rate becomes effective and applicable to sponsored awards. Typically aligns with the institution's fiscal year start.

attributes.name: equipment_exclusion_threshold
attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which equipment purchases are excluded from the MTDC base for IDC calculation. Typically $5,000 per federal capitalization policies.

attributes.name: facilities_rate_component
attributes.description: The facilities portion of the F&A rate, covering depreciation, interest, operations and maintenance, and library costs. Combined with administrative component to form total F&A rate.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_rate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether fringe benefit costs are included in the IDC rate calculation or treated separately. True if fringe is part of the rate; false if fringe is calculated independently.

attributes.name: institutional_signatory
attributes.description: Name and title of the institutional official (typically CFO or VP for Research) who signed the rate agreement on behalf of the university.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this IDC rate record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IDC rate record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mtdc_exclusion_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC) Exclusion Threshold
attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which certain costs (e.g., subawards, equipment) are excluded from the MTDC base. Commonly $25,000 for subawards per federal guidelines.

attributes.name: negotiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rate agreement was formally negotiated and executed between the institution and the cognizant federal agency.

attributes.name: rate_agreement_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the official rate agreement document signed by the cognizant agency. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: rate_agreement_number
attributes.description: Official agreement number assigned by the cognizant federal agency for this negotiated rate agreement. Serves as the business identifier for the rate record.

attributes.name: rate_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent audit or review of the IDC rate calculation by the cognizant agency or external auditors. Used for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: rate_calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to calculate the IDC rate, including cost pools, allocation bases, and any special adjustments. Documents the technical approach for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: rate_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable IDC rate percentage imposed by specific sponsors or programs. Some federal programs (e.g., training grants) cap IDC at 8%. Nullable if no cap applies.

attributes.name: rate_determination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate determination method. Predetermined rates are negotiated in advance for a multi-year period; provisional rates are temporary pending final rate calculation; fixed rates remain constant; final rates are determined after actual costs are known.

attributes.name: rate_negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, exceptions, or context from the rate negotiation process. Used for institutional memory and future negotiations.

attributes.name: rate_percentage
attributes.description: The negotiated percentage rate applied to the cost base to calculate indirect cost recovery. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 54.50 for 54.5%).

attributes.name: rate_proposal_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the institution submitted its IDC rate proposal to the cognizant agency for review and negotiation.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate agreement. Active rates are currently in use; expired rates are past their end date; superseded rates have been replaced by newer agreements; pending rates await approval; draft rates are under negotiation.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate based on the type of sponsored activity and location. On-campus research typically has higher rates than off-campus due to facility usage.

attributes.name: special_rate_conditions
attributes.description: Documentation of any special conditions, restrictions, or requirements attached to this rate agreement by the cognizant agency or specific sponsors.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this IDC rate record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: award_account
products.description: Master record for the institutional financial account (project/grant account) established to receive and track expenditures for a sponsored research award. Captures account number (project ID), account title, fund code, organization code, PI employee ID, award ID, account open date, account close date, total authorized budget, total expenditures to date, total encumbrances, available balance, account status (open, restricted, closed, pending closeout), cost-sharing account flag, residual balance disposition, F&A recovery account linkage, and ERP project ID. The financial SSOT linking research awards to institutional accounting within the research domain. Distinct from the finance domain's general ledger accounts — this is the research-specific project account managed by grants accounting staff.
products.reference: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Project Costing / Grants Module

attributes.name: award_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the award account record. Primary key for the award account entity.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Financial account management assigned to specific grant accountant or business officer for reconciliation, financial reporting, and closeout. Critical for post-award office portfolio management and ef

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.advancement_fund. Business justification: Fund reconciliation and donor stewardship reporting: research award accounts funded by donor gifts must be reconciled against the advancement fund balance. Research finance and gift officers jointly p

attributes.name: award_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.award_budget. Business justification: Award accounts are established based on approved budgets. The account's total_authorized_budget comes from a specific approved budget version. Adding award_budget_id FK links the account to its govern

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Award accounts are administered within cost centers for financial reporting and overhead allocation. The organization_code plain text attribute is a denormalization signal; cost_center_id enables prop

attributes.name: fa_recovery_ledger_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fa Recovery Ledger Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Award accounts post F&A cost recovery to specific ledger accounts. The fa_recovery_account_linkage plain text attribute is a direct denormalization signal. Role-prefixed fa_recovery_ distinguishes thi

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Award account project periods must align with fiscal periods for year-end close, carryforward processing, and financial reporting. Grants accountants require this link to process period-end award acco

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant_account. Business justification: The award_account (research administration system) and grant_account (financial system) represent the same sponsored project from two perspectives. This link enables reconciliation between Kuali Resea

attributes.name: idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.idc_rate. Business justification: award_account has fa_rate_percentage and idc_rate_type which should be normalized via FK to idc_rate master table. Award accounts apply specific negotiated IDC rate agreements; linking provides full r

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Award account financial reporting, indirect cost recovery, and departmental research portfolio management require linking award accounts to org units. Sponsored project closeout and financial reportin

attributes.name: primary_building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Award accounts fund building operations, maintenance, and utilities. Financial reporting and cost allocation require linking accounts to buildings for facilities cost recovery, utility chargeback calc

attributes.name: primary_room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: Award accounts pay for room-specific costs including lab setup, specialized equipment, and room modifications. Space chargeback systems and cost allocation models require room-level account linkage fo

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator responsible for this award account. The PI has primary accountability for scientific and financial stewardship of the project.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sponsored research award that this account was established to support. Links the financial account to the underlying award agreement.

attributes.name: sponsor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.sponsor. Business justification: award_account has sponsor_agency_name which should be normalized via FK to sponsor master table. This allows joining to get full sponsor details (type, contact info, payment terms, etc.) rather than s

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: The date the award account was officially closed after all expenditures were finalized, final reports submitted, and residual balances resolved. Nullable for active accounts.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance closeout requirements; NACUBO closeout procedures

attributes.name: account_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for grants accounting staff to record special instructions, restrictions, compliance notes, or other important information about this award account.

attributes.name: account_number
