attributes.description: The institutional project or grant account number assigned by grants accounting or the ERP system. This is the externally-known identifier used in financial transactions, journal entries, and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials project accounting; NACUBO financial reporting standards

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: The date the award account was opened and made available for charging expenditures. Typically coincides with the award start date or the date of award execution.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance period of performance

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the award account. Open accounts accept charges; restricted accounts require special approval; closed accounts are finalized; pending closeout accounts are in the 90-day closeout window; suspended accounts are temporarily frozen; pre-award accounts are established before formal award receipt.
attributes.references: NACUBO grants accounting guidelines; 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance closeout requirements

attributes.name: account_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the award account, typically derived from the project title or sponsor program name. Used for human-readable identification in financial reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The primary functional category of sponsored activity supported by this account. Used for IPEDS reporting and institutional cost allocation.
attributes.references: IPEDS Finance Survey component; NACUBO functional expense classification

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unspent and unencumbered budget available for new commitments. Calculated as total authorized budget minus expenditures minus encumbrances.
attributes.references: NACUBO budget management standards; institutional budget control policies

attributes.name: award_type
attributes.description: The legal instrument type under which the award was made. Determines compliance requirements, intellectual property rights, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance definitions; federal grant vs contract distinctions

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget and financial amounts in this award account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Most U.S. institutions use USD exclusively.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency codes; institutional financial reporting standards

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: The CFDA number identifying the federal program under which this award was made. Required for federal awards and used in Single Audit reporting and SEFA schedules.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance Appendix XI; SAM.gov CFDA catalog

attributes.name: cost_sharing_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is designated for tracking institutional cost sharing or matching contributions required by the sponsor. True if this is a cost-sharing account.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance cost sharing requirements; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of committed institutional cost sharing or matching funds for this award, as specified in the proposal and award agreement. Must be tracked and documented per sponsor requirements.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance cost sharing requirements; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this award account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: erp_project_code
attributes.description: The project or grant identifier in the institutional ERP system (Oracle PeopleSoft Financials) that corresponds to this award account. Used for system integration and financial transaction posting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials project accounting module

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award involves research subject to export control regulations (ITAR, EAR) requiring special compliance procedures and technology transfer review.
attributes.references: ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations); EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The institutional fund code or fund type that classifies the source of funds for this account (e.g., federal, state, private foundation, corporate). Used for financial reporting and compliance segregation.
attributes.references: GASB/FASB fund accounting standards; NACUBO fund classification

attributes.name: human_subjects_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award involves research with human subjects requiring Institutional Review Board (IRB) oversight and approval per federal regulations.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46 Common Rule; institutional IRB policies

attributes.name: last_financial_report_date
attributes.description: The date the most recent financial report (Federal Financial Report, invoice, or expenditure report) was submitted to the sponsor for this award account.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance financial reporting requirements; sponsor reporting schedule

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who last modified this award account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this award account record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mtdc_base
attributes.description: The Modified Total Direct Cost base amount used for calculating F&A costs. Excludes equipment, capital expenditures, subaward amounts over $25K, and other items per 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance Section 200.68 MTDC definition

attributes.name: next_financial_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date the next financial report is due to the sponsor per the award terms and reporting schedule. Used for compliance tracking and deadline management.
attributes.references: Sponsor award terms; 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance reporting requirements

attributes.name: project_end_date
attributes.description: The official end date of the project period of performance as specified in the award agreement. Defines the end of the allowable cost period, after which closeout procedures begin.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance period of performance; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: project_start_date
attributes.description: The official start date of the project period of performance as specified in the award agreement. Defines the beginning of the allowable cost period.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance period of performance; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: residual_balance_disposition
attributes.description: Specifies how any remaining unspent balance at account closeout will be handled per sponsor terms and institutional policy. Options include returning funds to sponsor, retaining for institutional use, transferring to PI discretionary account, or carrying forward to a continuation award.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance closeout; sponsor award terms and conditions

attributes.name: sponsor_award_number
attributes.description: The unique award or grant number assigned by the sponsoring agency. This is the external identifier used in all sponsor correspondence and reporting.
attributes.references: Sponsor award notice; federal grant award documentation

attributes.name: total_authorized_budget
attributes.description: The total budget amount authorized by the sponsor for this award account, including all approved modifications and amendments. Represents the cumulative funding ceiling.
attributes.references: Sponsor award notice; 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance budget requirements

attributes.name: total_encumbrances
attributes.description: The total amount of outstanding commitments and obligations (purchase orders, contracts, payroll commitments) that have been encumbered against this award account but not yet expended.
attributes.references: GASB encumbrance accounting standards; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials commitment control

attributes.name: total_expenditures_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative total of all posted expenditures charged to this award account from inception through the current reporting period. Includes direct and indirect costs.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials general ledger; NACUBO financial reporting

attributes.name: unrecovered_fa_amount
attributes.description: The amount of F&A costs that were incurred but not recovered from the sponsor due to rate caps, waivers, or sponsor policy limitations. Represents institutional cost sharing.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance cost sharing; institutional cost accounting standards

attributes.name: vertebrate_animals_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award involves research with vertebrate animals requiring Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) oversight and approval per federal regulations.
attributes.references: PHS Policy on Humane Care and Use of Laboratory Animals; USDA Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who created this award account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: proposal_personnel
products.description: Association record linking personnel (PI, Co-PI, senior personnel, graduate students, postdocs) to a specific grant proposal with their proposed role, effort, and compensation. Captures proposal ID, person ID, person name, role type (PI, Co-PI, Senior Personnel, Postdoctoral Associate, Graduate Research Assistant, Undergraduate Researcher), proposed effort percentage (academic year, summer, calendar year), proposed salary, fringe benefit rate, appointment type, and person status on proposal. Supports NSF and NIH biosketches, senior personnel listings, and budget justification requirements.
products.reference: Kuali Research - Proposal Personnel / NSF FastLane / NIH eRA Commons

attributes.name: proposal_personnel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proposal personnel association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.alumnus. Business justification: Research personnel often include alumni postdocs, research scientists, or collaborators. Advancement needs this for engagement tracking, prospect identification, and demonstrating continued institutio

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual assigned to this proposal. May link to employee, faculty, or external collaborator records.

attributes.name: faculty_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instruction.faculty_assignment. Business justification: Sponsored programs offices must verify proposed effort percentages against existing teaching assignments during proposal preparation. Linking proposal personnel to their faculty_assignment supports ef

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.fee_schedule. Business justification: Proposal budgets for graduate student personnel must include tuition remission costs calculated from the applicable fee schedule. Grants administrators reference fee schedules during proposal preparat

attributes.name: home_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Sponsored research effort reporting (2 CFR 200) and budget justification require linking personnel to their home department org unit. Role-prefixed 'home_org_unit_id' distinguishes from the proposal's

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.position. Business justification: NIH salary cap compliance and effort reporting (2 CFR 200) require linking proposal personnel to their HR position to validate institutional base salary and appointment type. Sponsor budget justificat

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.principal_investigator. Business justification: proposal_personnel tracks PI, Co-PI, and senior personnel roles on proposals. When the personnel member holds a PI role, they should be directly linked to the authoritative principal_investigator reco

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to student.profile. Business justification: Graduate and undergraduate student researchers named on proposals require direct identity resolution to the student record for eligibility verification, enrollment confirmation, and visa/export-contro

attributes.name: proposal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant proposal to which this personnel member is assigned.

attributes.name: academic_rank
attributes.description: Academic or professional rank of the personnel member at the time of proposal submission. Used for biosketches and to determine eligibility for certain roles (e.g., PI eligibility often requires faculty rank). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Professor|Associate Professor|Assistant Professor|Instructor|Lecturer|Research Scientist|Postdoctoral Associate|Graduate Student|Undergraduate Student|Staff — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: academic_year_effort_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the individual's academic year time (typically 9 months for faculty on academic-year appointments) committed to this project. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for effort reporting and budget justification.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: added_date
attributes.description: Date this personnel member was added to the proposal team.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Type of appointment for this personnel member on the project. Academic Year (9-month) is typical for faculty. Calendar Year (12-month) is typical for research staff. Summer appointments are for faculty during summer months. Hourly is for part-time or student workers. Stipend is for graduate students and postdocs receiving fixed payments.

attributes.name: biosketch_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a biographical sketch (biosketch) is required for this personnel member as part of the proposal submission. Typically required for PI, Co-PIs, and senior personnel; not required for graduate students or undergraduates.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.f(i), NIH Biosketch Requirements

attributes.name: biosketch_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biographical sketch for this personnel member has been submitted as part of the proposal package.

attributes.name: calendar_year_effort_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the individual's calendar year time (12 months) committed to this project. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for personnel on 12-month appointments or when aggregating academic year and summer effort.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Citizenship or visa status of the personnel member. Required for certain sponsor programs (e.g., Department of Defense, Department of Energy) and for export control compliance.
attributes.references: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)

attributes.name: college_school_name
attributes.description: Name of the college or school to which the personnel member's home department belongs. Higher-level organizational unit in the institutional hierarchy.

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_disclosed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this personnel member has disclosed any financial or personal conflicts of interest related to this proposal, as required by institutional policy and federal regulations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.112, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.1.f, Institutional COI Policy

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: Amount of this individual's compensation that will be cost-shared (contributed by the institution rather than charged to the sponsor). Cost sharing may be mandatory (required by the sponsor) or voluntary (offered by the institution).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.306, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(xi)

attributes.name: current_and_pending_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current and Pending Support Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Current and Pending Support document is required for this personnel member. Required for senior personnel to disclose all current and pending research support to identify potential overlaps and conflicts.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.f(ii), NIH Current and Pending Support Requirements

attributes.name: current_and_pending_submitted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current and Pending Support Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Current and Pending Support document for this personnel member has been submitted as part of the proposal package.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary institutional email address for the personnel member. Used for proposal communications and sponsor correspondence.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First (given) name of the personnel member as it appears on the proposal and biosketches submitted to sponsors.
attributes.references: NSF Biographical Sketch Requirements, NIH Biosketch Format

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Total fringe benefit cost for this individual, calculated by applying the fringe benefit rate to the proposed salary amount. Part of the total personnel cost in the proposal budget.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Institutional fringe benefit rate applied to this individual's salary. Covers benefits such as health insurance, retirement contributions, and other employee benefits. Rate is typically negotiated with the federal government and varies by employee category.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.431, Institutional Fringe Benefit Rate Agreement

attributes.name: institutional_base_salary
attributes.description: The individual's institutional base salary at the time of proposal submission. Used to calculate the proposed salary amount based on effort percentage. IBS is the annual compensation paid by the institution for an individual's appointment, whether that individual's time is spent on research, teaching, or other activities.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.430, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: key_personnel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this individual is designated as key personnel on the project. Key personnel are individuals who contribute in a substantive, measurable way to the scientific development or execution of the project, whether or not they receive salaries or compensation.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.f(i), NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date this personnel record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last (family) name of the personnel member as it appears on the proposal and biosketches submitted to sponsors.
attributes.references: NSF Biographical Sketch Requirements, NIH Biosketch Format

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the personnel member.
attributes.references: NSF Biographical Sketch Requirements, NIH Biosketch Format

attributes.name: orcid_identifier
attributes.description: Unique persistent digital identifier for this researcher, assigned by ORCID. Increasingly required by sponsors (NSF, NIH) to disambiguate researchers and link their scholarly activities. Format: 0000-0000-0000-0000.
attributes.references: ORCID Registry, NSF PAPPG 23-1 Chapter II.C.2.f(i)(c)

attributes.name: person_months
attributes.description: Total person months of effort committed by this individual to the project over the entire project period. Calculated by multiplying the effort percentage by the number of months in the project period. Used in budget justification and effort reporting.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)(a), NIH Budget Instructions

attributes.name: personnel_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this personnel member's role, qualifications, or participation in the proposal. Used for internal coordination and budget justification preparation.

attributes.name: personnel_status
attributes.description: Current status of this personnel member's participation in the proposal. Proposed indicates initial inclusion in the proposal. Confirmed indicates the individual has agreed to participate. Declined indicates the individual has declined participation. Replaced indicates the individual was substituted with another person. Removed indicates the individual was removed from the proposal team.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the personnel member.

attributes.name: proposed_salary_amount
attributes.description: Total salary amount requested for this individual on this proposal, calculated based on institutional base salary and proposed effort. Includes academic year and summer salary components. Expressed in the proposal's budget currency.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.430, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The role this individual will serve on the proposed project. PI (Principal Investigator) is the lead researcher responsible for the scientific and administrative conduct of the project. Co-PI (Co-Principal Investigator) shares leadership responsibilities. Senior Personnel includes faculty and other professionals with significant roles. Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Research Assistants, and Undergraduate Researchers are trainees supported by the project.
attributes.value_regex: PI|Co-PI|Senior Personnel|Postdoctoral Associate|Graduate Research Assistant|Undergraduate Researcher
attributes.references: NSF Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG), NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: summer_effort_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the individual's summer time (typically 3 months for faculty on academic-year appointments) committed to this project. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Summer salary is often requested for faculty on 9-month appointments.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: total_compensation_amount
attributes.description: Total compensation requested for this individual, including both salary and fringe benefits. Sum of proposed_salary_amount and fringe_benefit_amount.

products.name: compliance_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing compliance-related events, findings, and corrective actions associated with sponsored research activities. Captures event type (audit finding, protocol deviation, adverse event, noncompliance report, suspension, debarment notice, sponsor site visit finding), event date, associated award or protocol, severity level, description, corrective action plan, corrective action due date, corrective action completion date, regulatory body notified, and resolution status. Supports institutional research compliance program management and federal agency reporting obligations.
products.reference: 2 CFR 200 / OHRP / NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for compliance_event

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Research compliance events are frequently discovered during audits. Linking compliance_event to audit replaces the denormalized audit_report_reference text field with a proper FK, enabling corrective

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: EHS and regulatory compliance reporting requires identifying the campus building where a compliance incident (biosafety violation, IACUC finding, audit finding) occurred. Incident location is mandator

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant_account. Business justification: Compliance events on sponsored research (audit findings, corrective actions) have financial impacts tracked against grant accounts. The financial_impact_amount attribute requires a grant account refer

attributes.name: irb_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IRB protocol associated with this compliance event, if applicable to human subjects research.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Departmental compliance reporting and corrective action assignment require linking compliance events to org units. Federal audit findings (2 CFR 200) and sponsor notifications must be attributed to sp

attributes.name: previous_event_compliance_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to a previous compliance event record if this is a repeat or related finding.

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the principal investigator associated with the research activity under compliance review.

attributes.name: proposal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research proposal associated with this compliance event, if applicable.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sponsored research award associated with this compliance event, if applicable.

attributes.name: responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Corrective action tracking and regulatory audit response require identifying the responsible institutional employee for each compliance event. Federal sponsor notifications and internal audit reports

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: Regulatory and EHS incident reporting requires room-level precision for compliance events (e.g., a specific BSL-2 lab where a biosafety incident occurred). Room-level tracking supports corrective acti

attributes.name: sponsor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.sponsor. Business justification: compliance_event currently stores sponsor_agency_name as a denormalized STRING. The sponsor table is the authoritative reference for all funding sponsors. Adding sponsor_id normalizes this relationshi

attributes.name: subaward_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.subaward. Business justification: Compliance events frequently arise from subaward monitoring activities — subrecipient audit findings, monitoring visit results, and corrective action plans are all compliance events tied to a specific

attributes.name: audit_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance event originated from an internal or external audit finding.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which all corrective actions were completed and verified.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which corrective actions must be completed to resolve the compliance event.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action plan developed to address the compliance event and prevent recurrence.

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action plan implementation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this compliance event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (typically USD for U.S. institutions).

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance event, finding, or incident occurred or was identified.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the compliance event, including circumstances, findings, and any immediate actions taken.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the compliance event, used for tracking and reporting purposes. May follow institutional numbering convention.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance event indicating its resolution state.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compliance event indicating the nature of the finding or incident. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: audit_finding|protocol_deviation|adverse_event|noncompliance_report|suspension|debarment_notice|sponsor_site_visit_finding|corrective_action_request|allegation_of_misconduct|export_control_violation|conflict_of_interest_violation|financial_noncompliance — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal research compliance frameworks (FERPA, HIPAA, 2 CFR 200)

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual financial impact of the compliance event, including potential disallowed costs, penalties, or required refunds.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who last modified this compliance event record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this compliance event record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context related to the compliance event, corrective actions, or resolution process.

attributes.name: regulatory_body_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external regulatory body was formally notified of the compliance event.
attributes.references: Federal oversight agencies (OHRP, FDA, NSF OIG, NIH, USDA APHIS)

attributes.name: regulatory_body_notified
attributes.description: Name of the external regulatory body or oversight agency that was notified of this compliance event (e.g., OHRP, FDA, NSF OIG, NIH).
attributes.references: Federal oversight agencies (OHRP, FDA, NSF OIG, NIH, USDA APHIS)

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Citation of the specific federal, state, or institutional regulation, policy, or guideline that was violated or is relevant to this compliance event.
attributes.references: Federal research compliance frameworks (2 CFR 200, 45 CFR 46, 21 CFR 50/56, FERPA, HIPAA)

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance event is a repeat or recurring finding of a previously identified issue.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance event was formally reported to the institutional compliance office or regulatory body.
attributes.references: Federal research compliance frameworks (2 CFR 200, 45 CFR 46)

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance event was formally resolved and closed.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Overall resolution status of the compliance event, indicating whether it has been satisfactorily closed.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the severity or risk level of the compliance event, used to prioritize response and corrective actions.
attributes.references: Institutional research compliance risk assessment framework

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsoring agency was formally notified of the compliance event.

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsoring agency has been formally notified of this compliance event, as required by federal regulations.

attributes.name: systemic_issue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance event represents a systemic institutional issue requiring broader policy or process changes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created this compliance event record.

domains.name: faculty
domains.description: Owns faculty and instructor master data including academic appointments, tenure track status, rank, teaching load, credentials, scholarly activity, and departmental affiliations. Supports faculty evaluation, promotion and tenure processes, CUPA-HR reporting, and accreditation qualification tracking. SSOT for instructional personnel referenced by instruction, curriculum, and research domains.

products.name: instructor
products.description: Core master record for all faculty and instructional personnel at the institution. Serves as the SSOT for faculty identity, biographical data, academic credentials summary, employment classification (full-time, part-time, adjunct, visiting), current rank (Assistant Professor through Distinguished Professor), tenure status, primary department affiliation, research interests and expertise areas (with CIP/NSF classification codes), EMPLID from Workday HCM, and Banner person ID. Referenced by instruction, curriculum, research, and enrollment domains as the authoritative source for instructional personnel identity.
products.reference: Faculty Master Record (Workday HCM / Ellucian Banner)

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the instructor record. Primary key for the instructor entity. Serves as the authoritative reference for all instructional personnel across instruction, curriculum, research, and enrollment domains.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: IPEDS headcount reporting, payroll reconciliation, and HR compliance audits require linking the faculty record to the HR employee record. Every higher-ed institution maps faculty to their HR system-of

attributes.name: office_room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: Faculty office assignments are core operational data for directory services, space cost allocation, utilization reporting, and facilities planning. Currently stored as text in office_location; normali

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.principal_investigator. Business justification: Faculty instructors who conduct sponsored research are registered as principal investigators. Essential for: grant eligibility verification, effort reporting, compliance tracking (COI, export control)

attributes.name: appointment_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the instructor's current appointment or contract period. Null for tenured faculty with indefinite appointments. Critical for adjunct and visiting faculty contract management and renewal planning.

attributes.name: appointment_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the instructor's current appointment or contract period. May differ from hire_date for faculty with multiple appointment types or breaks in service. Used for contract renewal tracking.

attributes.name: banner_pidm
attributes.description: Internal person identifier from Ellucian Banner Student Information System. Links instructor to Banner person master for academic history, course assignments, and student interactions. PIDM is the Banner system key for all person entities.

attributes.name: canvas_user_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Canvas Learning Management System (LMS) User Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Unique user identifier for the instructor in the Canvas LMS. Links instructor record to course shells, gradebooks, and student interactions in the learning management system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the instructor record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: diversity_self_identification
attributes.description: Voluntary self-identification of demographic characteristics for diversity reporting and equity analysis. Collected per EEOC and IPEDS requirements. Confidential and used only for aggregate reporting, never individual evaluation.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, EEOC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary institutional email address for the instructor. Used for official communications, LMS notifications, and student contact. Must be active institutional domain email.

attributes.name: emplid
attributes.description: Employee identifier from Workday HCM system. Links instructor record to human resources master data for payroll, benefits, and talent management. Required for all faculty with employment relationship.

attributes.name: employment_classification
attributes.description: Employment status classification of the instructor. Determines teaching load expectations, benefits eligibility, and governance participation rights. Full-time includes tenure-track and non-tenure-track faculty. Adjunct refers to part-time instructors hired per course. Visiting indicates temporary appointments. Emeritus denotes retired faculty with honorary status. Affiliate covers joint appointments and courtesy faculty.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources) Faculty Classification Standards

attributes.name: faculty_rank
attributes.description: Current academic rank of the instructor within the institutional hierarchy. Reflects seniority, credentials, and scholarly achievement. Instructor and Lecturer ranks typically non-tenure-track. Assistant, Associate, and Full Professor ranks typically tenure-track or tenured. Distinguished Professor is highest honor rank. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: instructor|assistant-professor|associate-professor|professor|distinguished-professor|lecturer|senior-lecturer — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AAUP (American Association of University Professors) Rank Guidelines

attributes.name: faculty_status
attributes.description: Current employment and activity status of the instructor. Active indicates currently teaching or available for assignment. On-leave includes medical, personal, or professional development leave. Sabbatical indicates approved scholarly leave. Retired includes emeritus faculty. Terminated covers resignations and dismissals. Deceased for memorial records.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the instructor as recorded in official personnel records. Used for formal communications, course rosters, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: graduate_faculty_status
attributes.description: Approval status for teaching graduate courses and serving on doctoral committees. Full status allows chairing dissertations. Associate status allows committee membership. Not-approved restricts to undergraduate teaching only. Determined by graduate council review of credentials and scholarly activity.

attributes.name: highest_degree_earned
attributes.description: Highest academic degree earned by the instructor. Doctorate includes PhD, EdD, DBA, etc. Professional includes MD, JD, DDS, etc. Critical for accreditation qualification tracking and faculty credential reporting.
attributes.references: AACSB Faculty Qualification Standards, ABET Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: highest_degree_field
attributes.description: Academic discipline or field of study for the instructor's highest degree. Used to assess teaching qualification alignment with course content for accreditation purposes.

attributes.name: highest_degree_institution
attributes.description: Name of the institution that awarded the instructor's highest degree. Used for faculty diversity analysis and accreditation documentation of faculty credentials.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Institution Directory

attributes.name: highest_degree_year
attributes.description: Year in which the instructor completed their highest degree. Used for career stage analysis and intellectual currency assessment for accreditation.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the instructor was first hired by the institution in any capacity. Used for service credit calculations, benefits vesting, and anniversary recognition. For rehires, reflects most recent continuous service start date.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname/family name) of the instructor as recorded in official personnel records. Primary sorting and indexing field for instructor directories.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: last_promotion_date
attributes.description: Date of the instructor's most recent promotion in academic rank. Used for promotion cycle tracking and eligibility calculations for next rank advancement.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the instructor. Optional field used for formal identification and disambiguation of common names.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: office_hours
attributes.description: Scheduled office hours when the instructor is available for student consultation. Free-text field accommodating various formats (e.g., 'MWF 2-4pm', 'By appointment'). Published in syllabi and LMS.

attributes.name: orcid_identifier
attributes.description: Unique persistent digital identifier for the instructor as a researcher. Format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Links to global research output and disambiguates author identity across publications. Increasingly required by funding agencies and publishers.

attributes.name: phd_advisor_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the instructor is approved to serve as primary advisor (chair) for doctoral students. True indicates full graduate faculty status with dissertation chair privileges. False for associate graduate faculty or undergraduate-only faculty.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary office or contact phone number for the instructor. Published in faculty directories and course syllabi for student and administrative contact.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the instructor prefers to use in professional and academic contexts. May differ from legal name. Used in course catalogs, syllabi, and student-facing communications.

attributes.name: primary_college_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the instructor's primary college or school affiliation. Higher-level organizational unit above department. Used for college-level reporting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: primary_research_cip_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Research Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code classifying the instructor's primary research area using the federal Classification of Instructional Programs taxonomy. Format: XX.XXXX. Used for research portfolio analysis and interdisciplinary collaboration identification.
attributes.references: NCES (National Center for Education Statistics) CIP 2020 Taxonomy

attributes.name: professional_licensure
attributes.description: Professional licenses, certifications, or credentials held by the instructor relevant to their teaching discipline. Examples: CPA, PE, RN, JD bar admission, medical board certification. Critical for accreditation of professional programs.
attributes.references: Professional Accreditation Standards (AACSB, ABET, ABA, LCME)

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: System of origin for the instructor record. Workday for HR-sourced faculty, Banner for academic appointments, Manual for direct data entry, Import for bulk loads. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: research_interests
attributes.description: Narrative description of the instructor's research interests, scholarly focus areas, and areas of expertise. Used for faculty directory profiles, research collaboration matching, and graduate student advisor assignment. Free-text field allowing comprehensive description.

attributes.name: sabbatical_eligible_date
attributes.description: Date on which the instructor becomes eligible for their next sabbatical leave. Calculated based on institutional sabbatical policy (typically 6-7 years of service). Null for non-tenure-track faculty ineligible for sabbatical.

attributes.name: teaching_load_fte
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent teaching load assignment for the instructor. 1.0 represents full-time teaching load per institutional standards. Reduced for research appointments, administrative duties, or part-time status. Used for workload planning and IPEDS faculty FTE reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, CUPA-HR Workload Standards

attributes.name: tenure_date
attributes.description: Date on which tenure was officially awarded to the instructor. Null for non-tenured faculty. Critical for seniority calculations, sabbatical eligibility, and governance voting rights.

attributes.name: tenure_status
attributes.description: Current tenure status of the instructor. Tenured indicates permanent appointment with academic freedom protections. Tenure-track indicates probationary period toward tenure review. Non-tenure-track includes lecturers, instructors, and clinical faculty. Not-applicable for adjunct, visiting, and affiliate appointments.

attributes.name: union_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of faculty union or collective bargaining unit to which the instructor belongs, if applicable. Null for non-unionized faculty. Used for contract administration and labor relations reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the instructor record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring. Updated on any field modification.

products.name: appointment
products.description: Represents a formal academic appointment record for a faculty member, capturing appointment type (tenure-track, tenured, clinical, research, adjunct, visiting, emeritus), FTE allocation, appointment start and end dates, salary basis, appointing department, college, and academic rank at time of appointment. For initial appointments (hires): additionally captures search type (national, internal, emergency), offer and acceptance dates, search committee chair, position requisition reference, and diversity hire tracking flag. Tracks the official employment relationship between the institution and the faculty member as managed in Workday HCM. Supports CUPA-HR reporting, IPEDS HR survey, EEO compliance, and accreditation qualification tracking.

attributes.name: appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the faculty appointment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.advancement_fund. Business justification: Endowed chair appointments are directly funded by named advancement funds (e.g., 'Smith Professor of Chemistry' funded by the Smith Endowment Fund). Higher-ed advancement and provost offices track whi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the college or school within which the appointing department resides. Used for higher-level budget allocation and strategic planning.

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant_account. Business justification: Grant-funded faculty appointments (grant_funded_flag=true) must be linked to the sponsoring grant account for sponsored research compliance, effort reporting certification, and grant closeout. Higher-

attributes.name: hire_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to faculty.hire_event. Business justification: hire_event captures the formal faculty hiring transaction (position requisition, search type, offer date, acceptance date, diversity hire flag, etc.). appointment is the resulting employment record. T

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty member receiving this appointment. Links to the faculty master record.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.job_profile. Business justification: Faculty appointments must map to HR job profiles for IPEDS occupational category reporting, compensation grade assignment, and FLSA classification. Higher-ed HR and academic affairs jointly use job pr

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic department to which this appointment is primarily assigned. Determines budget responsibility, teaching assignments, and administrative reporting line.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Supervisory Organization; IPEDS - Organizational Structure

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.position. Business justification: Position control reporting and FTE budget reconciliation require each faculty appointment to reference an authorized HR position. Higher-ed budget offices and IPEDS headcount reports depend on appoint

attributes.name: academic_rank
attributes.description: Faculty rank at the time of this appointment. Reflects the hierarchical position within the academic career ladder and influences salary, teaching load, and committee assignments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: professor|associate-professor|assistant-professor|instructor|lecturer|senior-lecturer|distinguished-professor|endowed-chair — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AAUP - Academic Ranks; CUPA-HR - Faculty Rank Classification

attributes.name: annual_salary_amount
attributes.description: Base salary amount for the appointment, annualized for comparison purposes. For academic-year appointments, this represents the 9-month salary; for per-course or hourly, this is calculated based on expected load. Used for CUPA-HR reporting and budget planning.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR - Faculty Salary Survey; IPEDS HR Survey - Salary Data

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the appointment, typically generated by the HR system. Used in official correspondence and HR documentation.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the appointment. Active indicates the faculty member is currently serving in the role; on-leave indicates approved absence; terminated or completed indicates the appointment has ended.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the faculty appointment indicating the nature of the academic position and employment relationship. Determines eligibility for tenure review, benefits, and institutional privileges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tenure-track|tenured|clinical|research|adjunct|visiting|emeritus|lecturer|instructor|postdoctoral — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AAUP - Faculty Appointment Types; CUPA-HR - Faculty Classification Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the appointment was formally approved by the appropriate institutional authority (department chair, dean, provost, or board of trustees, depending on rank and type). Used for governance audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the institutional officer or body that approved this appointment (e.g., 'Provost', 'Board of Trustees', 'Dean of College of Engineering'). Used for governance transparency and audit trail.

attributes.name: benefits_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appointment qualifies the faculty member for institutional benefits (health insurance, retirement contributions, tuition remission). Typically based on FTE threshold and appointment type.
attributes.references: ERISA - Benefits Eligibility; IRS - Affordable Care Act (ACA) Employer Mandate

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appointment record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the salary amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports international faculty appointments and multi-currency reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date when the appointment concludes. Null for open-ended tenured appointments. Populated for term-limited appointments (visiting, adjunct, fixed-term contracts).

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Proportion of full-time effort allocated to this appointment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 for full-time, 0.5000 for half-time). Used for workload planning, IPEDS reporting, and salary proration.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey Component; CUPA-HR - FTE Calculation Standards

attributes.name: grant_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this appointment is wholly or partially funded by external grant or contract funds (e.g., NSF, NIH). True for grant-funded research faculty; false for institutionally funded positions. Critical for Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost recovery and effort reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Effort Reporting; NSF - Principal Investigator (PI) Eligibility

attributes.name: joint_appointment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a joint appointment spanning multiple departments or colleges. True if the faculty member holds concurrent appointments with split FTE across units; false for single-unit appointments.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that most recently modified this appointment record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appointment record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data freshness assessment, and audit trail.

attributes.name: primary_department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the instructor's primary academic department affiliation. Determines budget responsibility, teaching assignments, and governance participation. Follows institutional department coding standards. [Moved from instructor: This attribute represents the instructors primary departmental affiliation, which is a specific instance of the instructor-cost_center relationship. In a properly normalized model, this should be derived from the appointment association where primary_affiliation_flag=true, rather than denormalized on the instructor record. However, it may be retained on instructor for query performance if the business frequently needs primary department without joining to appointments.]

attributes.name: research_expectation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's effort expected to be devoted to research and scholarly activity under this appointment. Complements teaching and service expectations to total 100% of FTE.
attributes.references: AAUP - Faculty Workload Distribution; NSF - Principal Investigator (PI) Effort Reporting

attributes.name: sabbatical_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the faculty member is eligible for sabbatical leave under this appointment. Typically true for tenured and tenure-track faculty; false for adjunct, visiting, and non-tenure-track appointments.

attributes.name: salary_basis
attributes.description: Compensation structure for the appointment. Annual indicates 12-month salary; academic-year indicates 9-month; per-course and hourly are typical for adjunct faculty; stipend is used for postdoctoral and some research appointments.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR - Salary Reporting Standards; IPEDS HR Survey - Salary Basis

attributes.name: service_expectation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's effort expected to be devoted to institutional service, committee work, and administrative duties. Used for workload planning and promotion/tenure evaluation.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Official date when the faculty appointment becomes effective. Used for tenure clock calculations, benefits eligibility, and seniority determination.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Hire Date; AAUP - Tenure Clock Guidelines

attributes.name: teaching_load_credit_hours
attributes.description: Expected teaching load for this appointment, expressed in credit hours per academic year or term. Used for workload equity analysis and accreditation reporting of instructional capacity.
attributes.references: AAUP - Faculty Workload Standards; Regional Accreditation - Faculty Load Requirements

attributes.name: tenure_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appointment carries tenure, is on a tenure-track path, or is non-tenure-track. Critical for promotion and tenure processes and accreditation qualification tracking.
attributes.references: AAUP - Tenure Standards; Regional Accreditation Agencies - Faculty Qualification Requirements

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the appointment was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from appointment_end_date (which may be scheduled). Populated when an appointment ends early due to resignation, dismissal, or other cause. Used for turnover analysis and exit process tracking.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for appointment termination. Populated only when termination_date is set. Used for turnover analysis, retention strategy, and compliance with employment law documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|retirement|dismissal|non-renewal|end-of-contract|death|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC - Termination Documentation; CUPA-HR - Turnover Reporting

attributes.name: union_affiliation_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining unit to which this appointment is subject, if applicable. Null for non-unionized positions. Used for contract compliance and labor relations reporting.

attributes.name: visa_sponsorship_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is sponsoring a work visa (H-1B, J-1, O-1, etc.) for this appointment. True for international faculty requiring visa sponsorship; false for U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or those with independent work authorization. Used for immigration compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USCIS - Employment-Based Immigration; Department of State - J-1 Exchange Visitor Program

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that created this appointment record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

products.name: tenure_case
products.description: Tracks the formal promotion and tenure review process for a faculty member, including the review cycle year, tenure clock start date, tenure clock extensions granted, current review stage (third-year review, pre-tenure review, tenure review, post-tenure review), committee assignments, external reviewer status, dean recommendation, provost decision, board approval status, and final outcome. Supports the institution's faculty evaluation and promotion and tenure (P&T) governance process.

attributes.name: tenure_case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion and tenure review case. Primary key for the tenure case entity.

attributes.name: appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to faculty.appointment. Business justification: A tenure case is initiated in the context of a specific tenure-track appointment. Linking tenure_case to appointment allows the institution to identify exactly which appointment is under review, track

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the faculty member undergoing promotion and tenure review. Links to the faculty master data entity.

attributes.name: primary_tenure_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic department in which the faculty member holds their primary appointment and where the tenure case originates.

attributes.name: tenure_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Tenure cases must follow institutional tenure and promotion policies that define criteria, timelines, committee composition, and appeal procedures. Provosts and deans reference policy during case revi

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the faculty member filed a formal appeal of a negative promotion and tenure decision.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of any appeal filed regarding the promotion and tenure decision.

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: The date the board of trustees formally approved or denied the promotion and tenure case.

attributes.name: board_approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status from the institution's board of trustees, which typically has final authority over tenure and promotion decisions.

attributes.name: case_initiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the promotion and tenure case was formally initiated and entered into the review workflow.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the promotion and tenure case, typically formatted as year-department-sequence (e.g., 2024-ENG-003).

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotion and tenure case within the institutional review workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|in_progress|committee_review|dean_review|provost_review|board_review|approved|denied|withdrawn|deferred — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: college_committee_recommendation
attributes.description: The college-level promotion and tenure committee's formal recommendation regarding the case.

attributes.name: college_committee_vote_date
attributes.description: The date on which the college-level promotion and tenure committee conducted its vote on the case.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tenure case record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_rank
attributes.description: The faculty member's current academic rank at the time the tenure case is initiated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: instructor|assistant_professor|associate_professor|professor|distinguished_professor|clinical_assistant|clinical_associate|clinical_professor — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dean_recommendation
attributes.description: The dean's formal recommendation regarding the promotion and tenure case.

attributes.name: dean_recommendation_date
attributes.description: The date the dean submitted their formal recommendation letter.

attributes.name: department_chair_recommendation
attributes.description: The department chair's formal recommendation regarding the promotion and tenure case.

attributes.name: department_chair_recommendation_date
attributes.description: The date the department chair submitted their formal recommendation letter.

attributes.name: department_committee_vote_abstain
attributes.description: The number of department committee members who abstained from voting on the tenure case.

attributes.name: department_committee_vote_against
attributes.description: The number of department committee members who voted against granting promotion and/or tenure.

attributes.name: department_committee_vote_date
attributes.description: The date on which the departmental promotion and tenure committee conducted its vote on the case.

attributes.name: department_committee_vote_for
attributes.description: The number of department committee members who voted in favor of granting promotion and/or tenure.

attributes.name: dossier_submission_date
attributes.description: The date the faculty member submitted their complete promotion and tenure dossier (including curriculum vitae, teaching portfolio, research statement, and supporting materials).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the granted promotion and/or tenure becomes effective, typically the start of the next academic year following approval.

attributes.name: external_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external peer review letters from scholars at other institutions are required for this tenure case. Typically true for tenure and promotion to full professor.
attributes.references: AAUP Guidelines on Promotion and Tenure

attributes.name: external_reviewers_solicited_count
attributes.description: The number of external reviewers who were contacted and asked to provide evaluation letters for this tenure case.

attributes.name: external_reviews_received_count
attributes.description: The number of external review letters actually received and included in the tenure dossier.

attributes.name: final_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of the promotion and tenure review process after all levels of review and approval are complete. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tenure_granted|tenure_denied|promotion_granted|promotion_denied|both_granted|both_denied|withdrawn|deferred — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: final_outcome_date
attributes.description: The date the final promotion and tenure outcome was determined and communicated to the faculty member.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special circumstances, or administrative remarks related to the tenure case.

attributes.name: proposed_rank
attributes.description: The academic rank being sought through this promotion and tenure review process. May be the same as current rank if only tenure (not promotion) is being sought.

attributes.name: provost_decision
attributes.description: The provost's formal decision on the promotion and tenure case. In many institutions, the provost makes the final administrative recommendation to the board of trustees.

attributes.name: provost_decision_date
attributes.description: The date the provost rendered their formal decision on the tenure case.

attributes.name: review_cycle_year
attributes.description: The academic year in which the promotion and tenure review is conducted, typically represented as the ending year (e.g., 2024 for 2023-2024 academic year).

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: The type of faculty review being conducted: third-year review (formative mid-probationary assessment), pre-tenure review (final probationary review before tenure decision), tenure review (formal tenure decision), promotion review (rank advancement without tenure), post-tenure review (periodic evaluation of tenured faculty), or comprehensive review (combined promotion and tenure).
attributes.references: AAUP Guidelines on Promotion and Tenure

attributes.name: tenure_clock_start_date
attributes.description: The official start date of the tenure clock for this faculty member, which may differ from appointment date due to prior service credit or negotiated adjustments.

attributes.name: tenure_clock_stop_count
attributes.description: The total number of tenure clock extensions or stops granted to the faculty member (e.g., for parental leave, medical leave, or other approved circumstances).

attributes.name: tenure_clock_years_elapsed
attributes.description: The number of years that have elapsed on the tenure clock at the time of review, accounting for any stops or extensions. Typically ranges from 0 to 7 years.

attributes.name: tenure_track_appointment_date
attributes.description: The date the faculty member began their tenure-track appointment, establishing the start of the probationary period and tenure clock.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tenure case record was last modified in the system.

products.name: rank_history
products.description: Immutable historical record of all academic rank changes for a faculty member, capturing prior rank, new rank, effective date, reason for change (promotion, initial appointment, reclassification), approving authority, and associated tenure case reference. Enables longitudinal tracking of faculty career progression and supports accreditation reporting on faculty qualifications over time.

attributes.name: rank_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this rank change record. Primary key for the rank history entity.

attributes.name: governing_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Faculty rank changes and promotions are governed by a specific policy version (faculty handbook, collective bargaining agreement). Faculty affairs offices must reference the governing policy for each

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the faculty member whose rank changed. Links to the faculty master record.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Rank changes are department-specific and reported by org_unit for accreditation body reviews and IPEDS faculty rank distribution reporting. department_code is a denormalized org_unit reference; a prop

attributes.name: tenure_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to faculty.tenure_case. Business justification: rank_history.tenure_case_reference is currently a STRING field. When a rank change results from a promotion and tenure case, we should link it properly via FK to tenure_case.tenure_case_id. This allow

attributes.name: accreditation_qualified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the faculty member met accreditation body qualification standards (e.g., AACSB, ABET) at this rank. Used for accreditation reporting and program review.
attributes.references: AACSB Faculty Qualification Standards, ABET Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: The employment appointment type associated with this rank. Distinguishes between full-time, part-time, adjunct, visiting, and emeritus appointments.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Faculty Classification, IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rank change was formally approved by the approving authority. May differ from the effective date if approval occurs in advance of the effective date.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: The name or title of the individual or body that approved this rank change. Typically includes Provost, Board of Trustees, President, or Promotion and Tenure Committee.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or trigger for this rank change. Common reasons include promotion through tenure and promotion process, initial appointment at hire, reclassification due to role change, or administrative adjustment.
attributes.references: Institutional Faculty Handbook, AAUP Promotion and Tenure Guidelines

attributes.name: college_code
attributes.description: The code of the college or school in which the faculty member held this rank at the time of the change. Enables college-level faculty progression analysis.

attributes.name: contract_months
attributes.description: The number of months in the faculty member's annual contract at this rank. Common values are 9 (academic year) or 12 (calendar year).
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Faculty Classification, AAUP Contract Standards

attributes.name: cumulative_years_of_service
attributes.description: The total number of years of service at the institution at the time of this rank change. Includes all prior appointments and ranks. Used for seniority and tenure clock calculations.
attributes.references: Institutional Human Resources Policy, AAUP Service Credit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the salary amount. Typically USD for U.S. institutions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the new rank officially became effective. This is the authoritative date for calculating time-in-rank for future promotion eligibility and for accreditation reporting.

attributes.name: external_hire_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this rank change represents an initial appointment from outside the institution (external hire) versus an internal promotion. Used to distinguish hiring patterns from internal progression.

attributes.name: fte
attributes.description: The Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value representing the proportion of a full-time workload assigned to this faculty member at this rank. Used for IPEDS reporting and workload analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, CUPA-HR Standards

attributes.name: new_rank
attributes.description: The academic rank assigned to the faculty member as a result of this change. Represents the current rank following promotion, initial appointment, or reclassification.
attributes.references: AAUP Faculty Rank Guidelines, CUPA-HR Faculty Classification Standards

attributes.name: prior_institution_name
attributes.description: The name of the institution where the faculty member was employed immediately before this appointment, if applicable. Captured for external hires to track faculty mobility and recruitment sources.

attributes.name: prior_rank
attributes.description: The academic rank held by the faculty member immediately before this change. Standard academic ranks include Instructor, Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor, Distinguished Professor, and Lecturer.
attributes.references: AAUP Faculty Rank Guidelines, CUPA-HR Faculty Classification Standards

attributes.name: promotion_eligibility_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which the faculty member becomes eligible for consideration for the next rank, based on institutional time-in-rank policies. Calculated from the effective date of this rank change.
attributes.references: Institutional Faculty Handbook, AAUP Promotion Guidelines

attributes.name: rank_change_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context or details about this rank change. May include special circumstances, conditions, or administrative remarks.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rank history record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_current_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this is the most recent and currently active rank history record for the faculty member. Used to simplify queries for current state analysis.

attributes.name: record_effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this rank history record is considered valid and effective in the data warehouse. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 historization.

attributes.name: record_effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this rank history record is considered valid and effective in the data warehouse. Null indicates the record is currently active. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 historization.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this rank history record originated. Typically Workday HCM, Ellucian Banner HR, or PeopleSoft HCM.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rank history record was last updated in the source system. Used for change tracking and data freshness assessment.

attributes.name: salary_at_change
attributes.description: The annual base salary assigned to the faculty member at the time of this rank change. Captured for historical compensation analysis and equity studies.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Faculty Salary Survey, AAUP Salary Standards

attributes.name: tenure_track_status
attributes.description: The tenure track classification associated with this rank at the time of the change. Indicates whether the position is tenure-track, tenured, or non-tenure track (e.g., clinical, research, or teaching track).
attributes.references: AAUP Tenure Standards, CUPA-HR Faculty Classification

attributes.name: terminal_degree_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the faculty member held a terminal degree in their discipline at the time of this rank change. Terminal degree is typically a PhD, EdD, or equivalent highest degree in the field.
attributes.references: AACSB Standards, AAUP Faculty Qualification Guidelines

attributes.name: years_in_prior_rank
attributes.description: The number of years the faculty member served in the prior rank before this change. Calculated from the prior rank's effective date to this change's effective date. Used for promotion velocity analysis.

products.name: department_affiliation
products.description: Association entity capturing a faculty member's formal affiliations with academic departments, schools, and colleges, including primary vs. secondary/joint appointment designation, affiliation type (teaching, research, administrative), FTE percentage allocated to each unit, effective dates, and the department chair who approved the affiliation. A single faculty member may hold joint appointments across multiple departments, making this a critical many-to-many relationship with its own business attributes.

attributes.name: department_affiliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the department affiliation record. Primary key for this association entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Joint appointments and departmental affiliations split salary and budget across multiple cost centers based on FTE and salary_allocation_percentage. Links enable split-funded position tracking, cross-

attributes.name: office_room_id
