attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: Departmental space allocation reporting, IPEDS space surveys, and accreditation facility audits require structured room references per faculty department affiliation. The existing plain-text 'office_l

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic department to which the faculty member is affiliated. References the department master record.

attributes.name: primary_department_instructor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the faculty member holding this departmental affiliation. References the faculty master record.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources)

attributes.name: accreditation_qualified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the faculty member meets the accreditation body's qualification standards for this departmental affiliation. Critical for AACSB, ABET, and other specialized accreditation reporting. True if the faculty member holds appropriate terminal degree and meets scholarly activity requirements.
attributes.references: AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business) Faculty Qualification Standards

attributes.name: affiliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, arrangements, or context for this departmental affiliation. May include details about joint appointment agreements, temporary assignments, or unique workload arrangements.

attributes.name: affiliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the departmental affiliation. Active indicates the affiliation is in effect. Pending indicates approval in progress. Inactive indicates temporary suspension. Suspended indicates administrative hold. Terminated indicates the affiliation has ended.

attributes.name: affiliation_type
attributes.description: Type of affiliation the faculty member holds with the department. Teaching indicates instructional responsibilities, research indicates research program participation, administrative indicates leadership or service roles, clinical indicates patient care or clinical supervision, joint indicates shared appointment, and courtesy indicates honorary or collaborative affiliation without formal FTE allocation.
attributes.references: AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business) Faculty Qualification Standards

attributes.name: appointment_designation
attributes.description: Designation indicating whether this is the faculty member's primary home department or a secondary/joint appointment. Primary indicates the main administrative home and tenure home if applicable. Secondary and joint indicate additional departmental affiliations. Adjunct and affiliate indicate non-tenure-track or courtesy relationships.
attributes.references: AAUP (American Association of University Professors) Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the departmental affiliation was formally approved by the department chair or appropriate authority. Used for compliance tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this departmental affiliation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: departmental_email
attributes.description: Department-specific email address for the faculty member. May differ from the primary institutional email if the department uses a specialized domain or alias structure. Used for departmental communications and student contact.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Compliance

attributes.name: doctoral_committee_eligibility
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the faculty member is eligible to serve on or chair doctoral dissertation committees within this departmental affiliation. Used for graduate program administration and student advising assignment.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this departmental affiliation ended or is scheduled to end. Null for active, ongoing affiliations. Used to track historical affiliations and support time-based queries for accreditation and reporting.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this departmental affiliation became effective. Marks the beginning of the faculty member's formal association with the department for this appointment.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources)

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's full-time equivalent effort allocated to this department. For primary appointments typically 100.00, for joint appointments the sum across all departments equals 100.00. Used for workload planning, budgeting, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: graduate_faculty_status
attributes.description: Status indicating the faculty member's eligibility to teach graduate courses, chair dissertation committees, and participate in graduate program governance within this department. Full status allows all graduate activities, associate allows limited participation, none indicates undergraduate-only appointment.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who most recently modified this departmental affiliation record. Used for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this departmental affiliation record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: office_phone
attributes.description: Office telephone number for the faculty member at this departmental location. Used for directory services and student contact. May differ across multiple affiliations if the faculty member maintains offices in multiple departments.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Compliance

attributes.name: qualification_category
attributes.description: Accreditation qualification category for the faculty member within this affiliation. Scholarly Academic indicates terminal degree with sustained scholarly research. Practice Academic indicates terminal degree with sustained professional practice. Scholarly Practitioner indicates professional experience with scholarly contributions. Instructional Practitioner indicates teaching expertise. Additional indicates supplemental instructional support. Used for AACSB and specialized accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business) 2020 Standards

attributes.name: research_load_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's effort within this affiliation allocated to research activities. Used for research productivity tracking and grant budgeting. Particularly important for research-intensive institutions and NSF/NIH reporting.

attributes.name: salary_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's total salary charged to this department's budget. For joint appointments, the sum across all affiliations equals 100.00. Used for financial reporting and cost distribution.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers) Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: service_load_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's effort within this affiliation allocated to service and administrative responsibilities. Includes committee work, departmental governance, and institutional service. Used for workload equity analysis and promotion review.
attributes.references: AAUP (American Association of University Professors) Faculty Workload Standards

attributes.name: teaching_load_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the faculty member's effort within this affiliation allocated to teaching responsibilities. Used for workload planning and accreditation reporting. May differ from overall FTE percentage if the affiliation includes research or administrative duties.
attributes.references: AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business) Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: tenure_home_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this department is the faculty member's tenure home. True if this is the department responsible for tenure review and promotion decisions. A faculty member can have only one tenure home at a time.
attributes.references: AAUP (American Association of University Professors) Tenure Standards

attributes.name: voting_rights_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the faculty member has voting rights in departmental governance for this affiliation. Typically true for primary appointments and tenure-track faculty, false for courtesy or adjunct affiliations. Used for meeting quorum calculations and election eligibility.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this departmental affiliation record. Used for audit trails and accountability.

products.name: credential

Sourced from Workday HCM education records.

attributes.name: credential_id

attributes.name: compliance_accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Accreditation officers map credential

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty member who holds this credential. Links to the faculty master data product.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Professional licenses and certifications held by faculty are often mandated by specific regulatory requirements (state licensure board rules, federal program eligibility). Compliance officers map cred

attributes.name: accreditation_qualifier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential qualifies the faculty member to teach in their assigned discipline per accreditation standards (qualified, provisionally qualified, not qualified, under review).
attributes.references: SACSCOC Comprehensive Standard 6.2.a; AACSB Standard A5; ABET Criterion 6

attributes.name: awarding_institution
attributes.description: Name of the college, university, or certifying body that conferred the credential.
attributes.references: IPEDS Institutional Characteristics; SACSCOC Faculty Credentials Policy

attributes.name: awarding_institution_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the awarding institution (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, AUS).

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code representing the field of study (format: XX.XXXX). Used for IPEDS reporting and accreditation qualification tracking.

attributes.name: conferral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential was officially conferred or awarded to the faculty member.

attributes.name: continuing_education_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credential requires ongoing continuing education or professional development to maintain validity (True/False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credential_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the credential (doctoral, masters, bachelors, associate, certificate, license, other). Used for faculty qualification analysis. attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Full official name or title of the credential as conferred by the awarding institution or body (e.g., 'Doctor of Philosophy in Educational Leadership', 'Certified Public Accountant', 'Professional Engineer License').

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credential (e.g., academic degree, professional certification, state license, professional designation, fellowship, other).

attributes.name: degree_type

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this credential record is no longer effective for faculty qualification purposes. Null for currently active credentials.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential expires and requires renewal. Applicable for licenses and certifications with time-limited validity. Null for degrees and permanent credentials.
attributes.references: State Licensing Boards; Professional Certification Bodies

attributes.name: field_of_study
attributes.description: Academic discipline or professional field in which the credential was earned (e.g., 'Computer Science', 'Business Administration', 'Nursing', 'Mechanical Engineering').

attributes.name: issuing_body_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Accreditation status of the institution or body that awarded the credential (regionally accredited, nationally accredited, internationally recognized, not accredited, unknown). Critical for determining credential validity.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Database of Accredited Postsecondary Institutions; CHEA International Directory

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Official license or certification number assigned by the issuing authority. Applicable for professional licenses and certifications. Null for academic degrees.
attributes.references: State Licensing Boards; Professional Certification Bodies

attributes.name: license_state

Sourced from Workday HCM Absence Management module.

attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: hr_case_reference

attributes.name: intermittent_leave_flag

attributes.name: leave_duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days of approved leave. Calculated from approved start date to expected return date, or to actual return date if completed.

attributes.name: leave_duration_weeks
attributes.description: Total leave duration expressed in weeks (decimal). Supports FMLA reporting which is measured in 12-week increments.

attributes.name: leave_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the leave event. May include special arrangements, coverage plans, or administrative details. Confidential HR information.

attributes.name: leave_status

attributes.name: leave_subtype

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave event. attributes.name: paid_leave_flag

attributes.name: partial_pay_percentage

attributes.name: record_source_system

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave record was last modified in the source system. Tracks changes to leave status, dates, or other attributes.

attributes.name: reduced_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave involves a reduced work schedule (true) rather than full absence (false). Common for phased return or accommodation arrangements.

attributes.name: reduced_schedule_fte
attributes.description: FTE percentage during reduced schedule leave (0.000-1.000). For example, 0.500 indicates half-time work during leave period. Null if not a reduced schedule arrangement.

attributes.name: requested_start_date

attributes.name: return_to_work_certification_required_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether medical clearance is required before the faculty member can return to active duty (true) or not (false). Common for medical and disability leave.

attributes.name: teaching_coverage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether teaching coverage or course substitution was required during the leave period (true) or not (false). Drives adjunct hiring and course reassignment decisions.

attributes.name: tenure_clock_extension_months
attributes.description: Number of months the tenure clock was extended as a result of this leave. Typically 12 months for parental or medical leave. Null if no extension granted.
attributes.references: AAUP (American Association of University Professors) tenure guidelines

attributes.name: tenure_clock_stop_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenure probationary clock was stopped during this leave (true) or continued to run (false). Critical for promotion and tenure timeline calculations.
attributes.references: AAUP (American Association of University Professors) tenure guidelines

attributes.name: workers_compensation_claim_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the associated workers compensation claim. Null if leave is not workers compensation related. Links to risk management and insurance systems.

attributes.name: workers_compensation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave is related to a workers compensation claim for work-related injury or illness (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: grade_submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the instructor submitted the final grade. Values include web entry (Banner self-service), LMS import (Canvas gradebook sync), batch upload (spreadsheet), API integration, or scantron (optical scan form).

attributes.name: grade_verified_date

attributes.name: incomplete_deadline_date

attributes.name: incomplete_flag

attributes.name: letter_grade

attributes.name: numeric_grade
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the final grade on a 0-100 scale. May be null for pass/fail, audit, or incomplete grades.

attributes.name: original_letter_grade
attributes.description: The original letter grade that was posted before any grade change occurred. Null if no grade change has occurred. Retained for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: quality_points
attributes.description: Total quality points earned for this course, calculated as grade point value multiplied by credit hours attempted. Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) calculation.

attributes.name: repeat_course_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this course enrollment is a repeat of a previously taken course. Used in repeat course policy enforcement and GPA calculation.

attributes.name: repeat_course_include_flag

attributes.name: published_at
attributes.description: The date and time when this rubric was published and made available for use in grading. Null if the rubric is still in draft status.

attributes.name: read_only
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rubric is locked from further editing. True prevents modifications to the rubric structure or criteria, ensuring consistency after grading has begun.

attributes.name: reusable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rubric is marked as reusable across multiple assignments, courses, or terms. True allows the rubric to be shared and applied to multiple assessment contexts, promoting consistency in grading standards.

attributes.name: rubric_description

attributes.name: rubric_status

attributes.name: has_registration_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student account has an active hold that prevents course registration. True if registration is blocked; false otherwise.

attributes.name: has_transcript_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student account has an active hold that prevents transcript release. True if transcript release is blocked; false otherwise.

attributes.name: hold_count
attributes.description: Number of active holds currently placed on the student account. Holds may prevent registration, transcript release, or graduation based on hold type.

attributes.name: last_1098t_tax_year

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_payment_amount

attributes.name: last_payment_date

attributes.name: maximum_credit_hours

attributes.name: minimum_credit_hours

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: priority_sequence

attributes.name: program_level

attributes.name: proration_allowed

attributes.name: rate_amount

attributes.name: refundable

attributes.name: residency_status

attributes.name: schedule_code

attributes.name: schedule_name

attributes.name: schedule_status

attributes.name: tax_reportable_1098t

attributes.name: version_number

products.name: sponsorship_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between third_party_contract and student_account. It captures the per-student, per-contract authorization record that the bursar's office creates when a specific student is approved for billing under a specific third-party sponsor contract. Each record links one third_party_contract to one student_account and carries the coverage amount, billing period, eligibility verification status, and amounts billed — data that exists only in the context of this specific student-contract pairing.. Existence Justification: In higher education, third-party billing is an operational process where a single sponsor contract (e.g., VA Chapter 33, an employer tuition benefit program) covers many students simultaneously, and a single student can legitimately have multiple sponsors in the same or different terms (e.g., a veteran receiving VA benefits AND an employer tuition reimbursement). The bursar's office actively creates, manages, and terminates individual sponsorship authorizations — each with its own coverage amount, billing period, eligibility verification status, and amount billed — making this a genuine operational M:N with rich relationship-level data.

attributes.name: sponsorship_authorization_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the sponsorship_authorization association

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student financial account of the student authorized under this sponsor contract.

attributes.name: third_party_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sponsorship Authorization - Third Party Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the third-party billing contract under which this student is authorized for sponsor payment.

attributes.name: amount_billed_to_sponsor
attributes.description: The actual dollar amount invoiced to the sponsor for this student under this contract for the billing period. May differ from coverage_amount_per_student if charges were less than the authorized maximum or if partial billing occurred.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bursar's office formally authorized this student for billing under this third-party contract. Marks the start of the authorization lifecycle for this student-contract pairing.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this sponsorship authorization record. Tracks the authorization from initial creation through eligibility verification, invoicing, and payment resolution.

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the academic term or billing period for which this sponsorship authorization is valid. Together with billing_period_start, defines the window during which charges may be billed to the sponsor for this student.

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the academic term or billing period for which this sponsorship authorization is valid. Scopes the authorization to a specific period, enabling per-term sponsor billing.

attributes.name: coverage_amount_per_student
attributes.description: The dollar amount the sponsor has authorized to pay for this specific student under this contract for the applicable billing period. Belongs to the authorization, not to the contract (which may have a global cap) nor to the student account (which aggregates all charges).

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student's eligibility criteria have been confirmed against the contract's eligible_student_criteria for this authorization record. Must be true before invoicing the sponsor for this student.

Controllers map accounts to regulatory reporting categories (NACUBO functional classification, IPEDS finance surve

attributes.name: account_name

Fund managers must track which re

attributes.name: account_string_segment
attributes.description: The fund segment of the institutional chart of accounts string used in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials. Represents the fund component of the multi-segment account code (e.g., fund-department-account-program).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Chart of Accounts, NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards

attributes.name: allow_deficit_spending
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fund is permitted to carry a negative balance or deficit. True if deficit spending is allowed; false if the fund must maintain a positive balance.

attributes.name: balance
attributes.description: The current fund balance representing the net assets available in the fund. Calculated as assets minus liabilities for the fund entity. Updated through the general ledger posting process.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved budget allocation for the fund for the current fiscal year. Represents the planned expenditure authority or revenue target.
attributes.references: NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards, Institutional Budget Policy

attributes.name: carryforward_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether unspent fund balances are permitted to carry forward to the next fiscal year. True if carryforward is allowed; false if balances must be returned or reallocated at fiscal year end.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund was officially closed and removed from active use. Null for funds that remain open.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement
attributes.description: Description of specific compliance requirements, regulations, or reporting obligations associated with the fund, such as federal grant compliance, donor restrictions, or audit requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, GASB 34/35, Donor Agreements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of outstanding encumbrances (purchase orders, contracts, commitments) charged against the fund. Represents committed but not yet expended resources.

attributes.name: endowment_principal
attributes.description: The permanently restricted principal amount of an endowment fund that must be maintained in perpetuity. Only applicable to endowment fund types. Null for non-endowment funds.
attributes.references: NACUBO Endowment Study, UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act)

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund was officially established and authorized for use in the institutional chart of accounts.

attributes.name: expenditure_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative expenditures posted to the fund for the current fiscal year to date. Includes all expense transactions recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: external_reporting_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fund requires external financial reporting to donors, sponsors, regulatory agencies, or other external stakeholders. True if external reporting is required; false otherwise.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the fund in the institutional chart of accounts. Used in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials and all financial transactions.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the fund as it appears in financial reports and institutional documentation.

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the fund. Active funds are operational and accept transactions; inactive funds are dormant but not closed; closed funds are permanently terminated; suspended funds are temporarily halted; pending approval funds await authorization.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: The primary classification of the fund according to higher education fund accounting principles. Current unrestricted funds support general operations; current restricted funds have donor or sponsor restrictions; endowment funds are permanently invested; plant funds support capital assets; loan funds support student lending; agency funds hold assets for others.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Indirect Cost Rate (IDC)
attributes.description: The federally negotiated indirect cost rate applied to sponsored projects and grants managed through this fund. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.5400 for 54%). Used to calculate facilities and administrative cost recovery.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Negotiated Rate Agreement

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent internal or external audit conducted on this fund. Used to track audit compliance and schedule future audits.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Institutional Audit Policy

attributes.name: net_asset_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Net Asset Classification
attributes.description: The GASB net asset classification indicating the level of restriction on the fund resources. Unrestricted assets have no donor-imposed restrictions; temporarily restricted assets have time or purpose restrictions that will expire; permanently restricted assets must be maintained in perpetuity.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the fund management, restrictions, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program or functional classification code associated with the fund, used for program-based budgeting and reporting. Aligns with institutional program taxonomy.

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the intended purpose and allowable uses of the fund resources, including any donor intent, programmatic focus, or operational scope.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: The financial statement reporting category or line item to which this fund maps for external financial reporting purposes, such as GASB or FASB statement presentation.
attributes.references: GASB 34/35, FASB ASC 958, NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: The nature of restrictions placed on the fund resources. Donor-restricted funds have limitations imposed by external donors; sponsor-restricted funds are limited by grant or contract terms; board-designated funds have internal restrictions set by the governing board; regulatory-restricted funds are constrained by law or regulation; time-restricted funds have temporal limitations.
attributes.references: NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: revenue_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative revenue posted to the fund for the current fiscal year to date. Includes all revenue transactions recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: spending_rate
attributes.description: The annual spending rate applied to endowment funds, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.5%). Determines the amount available for annual distribution from endowment earnings. Only applicable to endowment fund types.

attributes.name: sponsoring_entity
attributes.description: The name of the external or internal entity that established or sponsors the fund, such as a donor name, foundation, government agency, or academic department.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost center master data representing departmental and programmatic units used for financial accountability, budget tracking, and NACUBO functional expense classification. Captures cost center code, name, responsible manager, organizational hierarchy level, college/school affiliation, functional category (instruction, research, public service, academic support, student services, institutional support, O&M, scholarships), FTE allocation, and active status. Primary organizational dimension in the PeopleSoft chartfield string.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master data table. Serves as the organizational dimension in the PeopleSoft chartfield string for financial accountability and budget tracking.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting from departments to colleges to divisions to institution. Null for top-level cost centers (e.g., President's Office, Provost).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Tree Manager, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The specialized or programmatic accreditation agency that oversees this cost center's academic programs (e.g., AACSB for business schools, ABET for engineering programs, ABA for law schools, LCME for medical schools). Used for compliance tracking and accreditation reporting. Null for non-accredited programs and administrative units.
attributes.references: CHEA Database of Accrediting Organizations, U.S. Department of Education Accreditation Database

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved operating budget for the current fiscal year in US dollars. Includes all fund sources (general fund, restricted funds, auxiliary funds). Used for budget variance analysis, financial planning, and resource allocation decisions.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit CIP code that classifies the primary instructional program or academic discipline of this cost center. Format: XX.XXXX (e.g., 11.0701 for Computer Science, 52.0201 for Business Administration). Used for IPEDS reporting, program review, and academic planning. Applicable only to academic departments and programs.
attributes.references: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) 2020, IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The business identifier code for the cost center used in financial transactions and reporting. Typically a 4-10 character alphanumeric code that appears on general ledger entries, budget documents, and financial statements. Primary organizational chartfield in PeopleSoft.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Chartfield Standards, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the cost center's mission, scope of operations, and organizational purpose. Used for organizational documentation, budget justification, and institutional knowledge management.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., 'Department of Computer Science', 'Office of Financial Aid', 'College of Engineering Dean's Office'). Used for human-readable reporting and organizational identification.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers accept charges and have budget authority; inactive cost centers are temporarily disabled; pending cost centers are awaiting approval; closed cost centers are permanently retired; suspended cost centers are under review or restructuring.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by organizational purpose. Academic departments deliver instruction and research; administrative units provide institutional support; research centers conduct sponsored and non-sponsored research; service units provide internal services; auxiliary enterprises are self-supporting operations; capital projects track construction and renovation.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 35

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: degrees_awarded_annual
attributes.description: Total number of degrees and certificates awarded by this cost center's academic program(s) in the most recent academic year. Includes associate, bachelor's, master's, doctoral, and professional degrees. Used for IPEDS completions reporting, program productivity analysis, and accreditation review. Applicable only to academic departments offering degree programs.
attributes.references: IPEDS Completions Survey, AACSB Accreditation Standards, ABET Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost center became active and began accepting financial transactions. Used for historical reporting and organizational change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: faculty_fte
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent count of faculty assigned to this cost center. Includes tenured, tenure-track, and non-tenure-track instructional faculty. Used for student-faculty ratio calculations, accreditation reporting, and instructional cost analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, AACSB Accreditation Standards, ABET Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the annual budget amount applies. Typically a four-digit year representing the end of the fiscal period (e.g., 2024 for FY 2023-2024). Most higher education institutions use July 1 - June 30 fiscal years.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Total full-time equivalent employee count allocated to this cost center. Includes faculty, staff, and student workers converted to FTE. Used for IPEDS Human Resources reporting, CUPA-HR benchmarking, and productivity analysis. Calculated as sum of individual employee FTE assignments.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, CUPA-HR Standards, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: functional_category
attributes.description: NACUBO functional expense classification used for IPEDS reporting and GASB/FASB compliance. Instruction includes teaching and departmental research; research includes organized research and sponsored programs; public service includes community engagement; academic support includes libraries and academic administration; student services includes admissions, registrar, and student life; institutional support includes executive management, fiscal operations, and HR; operation and maintenance includes facilities and utilities; scholarships and fellowships includes financial aid; auxiliary enterprises includes housing, dining, and bookstores. attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, IPEDS Finance Survey, GASB Statement 35, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: fund_source_primary
attributes.description: The primary fund source that supports this cost center's operations. General fund represents unrestricted institutional operating funds; restricted fund represents donor-restricted or externally-restricted funds; designated fund represents internally-restricted funds; auxiliary fund represents self-supporting operations; endowment fund represents endowment income; grant fund represents sponsored program funds.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 34, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: grant_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is eligible to serve as the administrative home for sponsored research grants and contracts. True for research-active departments and centers; false for administrative units and non-research departments. Used for proposal routing and award setup in Kuali Research.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the organizational hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents institution-wide (President, Provost); Level 2 represents divisions (Vice Presidents); Level 3 represents colleges/schools; Level 4 represents departments; Level 5 represents sub-departments or programs. Used for roll-up reporting and organizational analysis.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Indirect Cost Rate (IDC) or Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Rate
attributes.description: The federally-negotiated indirect cost rate (also called F&A rate) applicable to sponsored programs administered by this cost center. Expressed as a percentage of modified total direct costs. Used for grant budgeting and cost recovery calculations. Null for non-research cost centers.

products.name: ap_payment_application
products.description: This association product represents the Payment Application event between ap_payment and ap_invoice. It captures the operational record of how a specific payment disbursement is applied against a specific vendor invoice, including the amount applied, any discount taken at application time, the application date, and the application status. Each record links one ap_payment to one ap_invoice and is the authoritative source for vendor ledger reconciliation, audit compliance, and cash flow reporting in the institutional accounts payable process.. Existence Justification: In accounts payable operations, a single payment disbursement (ap_payment) routinely settles multiple vendor invoices simultaneously — this is the standard 'payment run' process in ERP systems like Oracle PeopleSoft. Conversely, a single invoice can be partially paid across multiple payment disbursements (partial payments, installment arrangements, or split payment runs). The business actively manages this payment application process, tracking exactly how much of each payment was applied to each invoice, with its own attributes (amount_applied, discount_taken, application_date, status) that belong to neither the payment nor the invoice alone.

attributes.name: ap_payment_application_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ap Payment Application - Ap Payment Application Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the ap_payment_application association

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ap Payment Application - Ap Invoice Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor invoice being settled by this payment application.

attributes.name: ap_payment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ap Payment Application - Ap Payment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the accounts payable payment disbursement record that is being applied.

attributes.name: amount_applied
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount applied to this specific invoice. Belongs to the application record because a single payment may be split across multiple invoices and a single invoice may receive partial payments from multiple disbursements.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current status of this payment application record (e.g., applied, reversed, pending, voided). Belongs to the application record because a payment application can be reversed independently of the payment or invoice status.

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: The early payment discount amount captured at the time of this specific payment application against this invoice. Belongs to the application record because the discount is realized per invoice per payment event, not at the payment or invoice level alone.

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: The number of vendor invoices paid by this single payment disbursement. Supports batch payment analysis. [Moved from ap_payment: invoice_count on ap_payment is a derived aggregate (count of invoices paid by this payment) that becomes redundant and computable once the ap_payment_application association table exists. It does not belong on the payment record itself — it is a property of the payment-to-invoice relationship set, derivable via COUNT(*) on ap_payment_application grouped by ap_payment_id.]
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Payment Module

attributes.name: payment_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment was applied to this invoice in the AP system. Belongs to the application record as it records when the settlement event occurred for this specific payment-invoice pairing.

products.name: ar_receipt_application
products.description: This association product represents the Cash Application event between ar_receipt and ar_invoice. It captures the operational record of how a specific cash receipt is applied — in full or in part — against a specific AR invoice, including the amount applied, any discount granted, the application date, and the lifecycle status of the application. Each record links one ar_receipt to one ar_invoice and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this receipt-to-invoice application. Required for GASB compliance, sponsored program financial reporting, and AR aging accuracy.. Existence Justification: In higher-education AR operations, a single cash receipt (e.g., a lump-sum payment from a government sponsor) is routinely applied across multiple outstanding invoices simultaneously, and a single invoice can receive partial payments from multiple separate receipts over its lifecycle. This is the standard 'cash application' or 'receipt application' process in Oracle PeopleSoft AR. The relationship is actively managed by AR staff who create, update, and close application records — it is not derivable from joins alone.

attributes.name: ar_receipt_application_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ar Receipt Application - Ar Receipt Application Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the ar_receipt_application association

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ar Receipt Application - Ar Invoice Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the AR invoice being satisfied by this application. Identifies which outstanding invoice is being reduced by this cash application.

attributes.name: ar_receipt_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ar Receipt Application - Ar Receipt Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the cash receipt being applied. Identifies which payment transaction is the source of funds for this application.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which this specific receipt-to-invoice application was posted in the AR system. May differ from the receipt date (when payment was received) and the invoice date. Required for period-accurate AR aging and sponsored program reporting.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this specific receipt-to-invoice application record. Tracks whether the application is fully posted, partially applied, or has been reversed (e.g., due to a returned check or correction). Belongs to the application event, not to the receipt or invoice independently.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the receipt amount applied to this specific invoice in this application record. Belongs to the application event, not to the receipt total or the invoice balance alone. Summing applied_amount across all applications for a receipt yields the receipt's total applied amount; summing across all applications for an invoice yields amount_paid.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 33; PeopleSoft AR Cash Application

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount granted on this specific receipt-to-invoice application (e.g., early payment discount). Distinct from the receipt-level discount_amount aggregate and the invoice-level discount_amount. Belongs to the application event.

attributes.name: invoice_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or concatenated string of invoice numbers to which this receipt has been applied, for quick reference and reporting. [Moved from ar_receipt: This STRING column is a denormalized workaround storing multiple invoice numbers as a comma-separated list. Its data is fully replaced by the ar_receipt_application association table, where each receipt-to-invoice link is a proper relational row. Removing this column eliminates the normalization violation and enables proper FK-based querying, reporting, and audit tracing.]
