products.description: Master record for every campus building and structure. Captures building code, name, address, construction year, gross square footage, assignable square footage, building type (academic, residential, administrative, research, athletic), ownership status (owned, leased, ground-lease), historic designation, ADA compliance status, LEED certification level, and operational status. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for all building-level space inventory and F&A cost rate space calculations reported to federal sponsors.
products.reference: Archibus Building Master / FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual)

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the building. Primary key for the building master record.

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the campus on which this building is located. Links to the campus master record.

attributes.name: responsible_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) reporting and utilities/maintenance budget allocation require identifying the primary administrative org unit responsible for each building. Highe

attributes.name: ada_compliance_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Date
attributes.description: Date on which the building was certified as ADA compliant or most recent ADA compliance assessment date.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building meets ADA accessibility requirements including accessible entrances, elevators, restrooms, and pathways.

attributes.name: annual_operating_cost
attributes.description: Total annual operating cost for the building including utilities, maintenance, custodial services, and routine repairs.

attributes.name: assignable_square_feet
attributes.description: Net assignable square footage available for occupancy and functional use, excluding circulation, mechanical, and structural areas. Critical for Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost rate calculations reported to federal sponsors.

attributes.name: automation_system
attributes.description: Name or type of the building automation system used to control HVAC, lighting, and other building systems.

attributes.name: bike_parking_spaces
attributes.description: Number of bicycle parking spaces available at or near the building.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to uniquely identify the building in campus systems and signage. This is the externally-known business identifier used in room numbering, wayfinding, and operational systems.

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Official name of the building, often honoring a donor, historical figure, or reflecting the building's primary function.

attributes.name: building_type
attributes.description: Primary functional classification of the building indicating its predominant use category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: academic|residential|administrative|research|athletic|library|student_services|dining|parking|utility — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the building is located.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year in which the building was originally constructed and completed.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the building location.

attributes.name: deferred_maintenance_backlog
attributes.description: Estimated dollar value of accumulated deferred maintenance and capital renewal needs for the building.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this building record became effective in the system, typically the date the building was added to the institutional inventory.

attributes.name: emergency_generator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building is equipped with an emergency backup generator for power continuity during outages.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this building record was retired or decommissioned. Null for active buildings.

attributes.name: energy_star_score
attributes.description: EPA Energy Star portfolio manager score (1-100) indicating the building's energy performance relative to similar buildings nationwide.

attributes.name: facility_condition_index
attributes.description: Ratio of deferred maintenance backlog to replacement value, indicating the relative condition of the building. Lower values indicate better condition.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system_type
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed in the building for life safety compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|wet_pipe_sprinkler|dry_pipe_sprinkler|pre_action|deluge|clean_agent|combination — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gross_square_feet
attributes.description: Total gross square footage of the building measured from exterior wall to exterior wall, including all floors. Used for space inventory and capital planning.

attributes.name: historic_designation
attributes.description: Historic preservation status indicating whether the building is listed on national, state, or local historic registers, which may impose renovation and maintenance restrictions.

attributes.name: last_major_renovation_year
attributes.description: Year of the most recent major renovation or capital improvement project affecting the building structure or systems.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the building centroid in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: leed_certification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Date
attributes.description: Date on which the building received its LEED certification.

attributes.name: leed_certification_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Level
attributes.description: LEED green building certification level achieved by the building, indicating sustainability and environmental performance.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the building centroid in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: number_of_floors
attributes.description: Total count of floors in the building including basement and sub-basement levels.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the building indicating whether it is in service, under construction, or retired from use.

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Legal ownership or control status of the building indicating whether the institution owns, leases, or has other rights to the property.

attributes.name: parking_spaces
attributes.description: Number of parking spaces associated with or adjacent to the building.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the building location.

attributes.name: primary_hvac_system_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) System Type
attributes.description: Description of the primary heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system type serving the building.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this building record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this building record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: replacement_value
attributes.description: Estimated current replacement value of the building in US dollars, used for insurance and capital planning purposes.

attributes.name: space_utilization_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of assignable square footage that is actively utilized, calculated from room scheduling and occupancy data.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the building is located.

attributes.name: street_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the building including street number and street name.

attributes.name: wireless_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building has comprehensive wireless network coverage for institutional network access.

products.name: room
products.description: Master record for every assignable and non-assignable room or space within a building. Captures room number, floor, room use code (per FICM classification), room type (classroom, laboratory, office, residence hall unit, common area), design capacity, station count, net assignable square footage, ADA accessibility features, technology infrastructure (smart classroom, AV equipment), and current occupancy status. Foundational entity for space utilization, course scheduling, and F&A indirect cost rate calculations.
products.reference: Archibus Space / FICM Room Use Codes

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the room or space within the institution's facilities inventory. Primary key for the room entity.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Reference to the building in which this room is located. Links to the building master record for campus facility hierarchy.

attributes.name: floor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.floor. Business justification: A room physically exists on a specific floor within a building. The floor table is the authoritative master reference for floors (floor_id, floor_number, floor_name, floor_type, etc.). room.floor_leve

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic or administrative department to which this room is assigned or allocated. Used for space charge-back, F&A cost allocation, and departmental space reporting.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room record is currently active (True) in the facilities inventory or has been deactivated/archived (False). Used for data management and reporting scope control.

attributes.name: ada_accessible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility standards (True) or not (False). Includes considerations for wheelchair access, assistive listening systems, and accessible fixtures.
attributes.references: ADA Standards for Accessible Design (2010), Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: ada_features
attributes.description: Detailed description of ADA accessibility features present in the room (e.g., 'Wheelchair accessible seating', 'Assistive listening system', 'Accessible restroom', 'Adjustable height workstations').

attributes.name: assignable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is assignable space (True) or non-assignable space (False) per FICM standards. Assignable spaces are used for specific institutional functions; non-assignable includes circulation, mechanical, and structural areas.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES

attributes.name: av_equipment_description
attributes.description: Detailed inventory of audio-visual equipment installed in the room (e.g., 'Epson projector, Extron control system, wireless microphone, Blu-ray player, document camera').

attributes.name: av_equipment_level
attributes.description: Classification of the audio-visual technology infrastructure installed in the room. None=no AV; Basic=projector only; Standard=projector + audio; Advanced=smart classroom with document camera and control system; Premium=full multimedia suite with video conferencing and recording.

attributes.name: biosafety_level
attributes.description: The biosafety level classification for laboratories handling biological agents, as defined by CDC/NIH guidelines. BSL-1=minimal hazard; BSL-2=moderate hazard; BSL-3=serious/potentially lethal; BSL-4=dangerous/exotic agents. Not_applicable for non-laboratory spaces.
attributes.references: CDC/NIH Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)

attributes.name: ceiling_height_feet
attributes.description: The height of the ceiling in feet, measured from floor to ceiling. Relevant for space planning, AV equipment installation, and building code compliance.

attributes.name: climate_control_type
attributes.description: The type of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system serving the room. Central=building-wide system; Individual=room-specific unit; None=no climate control; VAV=variable air volume; CAV=constant air volume.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the room based on facilities inspections. Excellent=like new; Good=well maintained; Fair=minor issues; Poor=significant deficiencies; Critical=immediate attention required.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: The year the room was originally constructed as part of the building. Used for historical tracking, depreciation calculations, and facilities planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this room record was first created in the facilities management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_capacity
attributes.description: The maximum number of occupants the room is designed to accommodate based on fire code, seating configuration, and functional design. Used for course scheduling, event planning, and safety compliance.
attributes.references: International Building Code (IBC), NFPA 101 Life Safety Code

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date this room record ceased to be effective, typically due to decommissioning, repurposing, or demolition. Null for currently active rooms.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date this room record became effective in the facilities inventory system. Used for temporal tracking and historical space analysis.

attributes.name: emergency_equipment
attributes.description: Description of emergency safety equipment installed in the room (e.g., 'Emergency shower, eyewash station, fire extinguisher, first aid kit, spill kit').
attributes.references: OSHA Laboratory Standard (29 CFR 1910.1450), NFPA 101 Life Safety Code

attributes.name: fire_safety_rating
attributes.description: Fire safety compliance status of the room based on fire marshal inspections and NFPA standards. Compliant=meets all requirements; Non_compliant=deficiencies identified; Exempt=not subject to inspection; Pending_inspection=awaiting assessment.
attributes.references: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code, State Fire Marshal regulations

attributes.name: fume_hood_count
attributes.description: The number of fume hoods or chemical exhaust systems installed in the room. Relevant for chemistry and biology laboratories. Used for safety compliance and laboratory capacity planning.

attributes.name: furniture_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of furniture and fixtures in the room (e.g., '30 tablet arm chairs, instructor podium, whiteboard, storage cabinets').

attributes.name: gross_square_feet
attributes.description: The total gross square footage of the room, including walls and structural elements. Used for building-level space accounting and capital planning.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES

attributes.name: hazardous_materials_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is approved for storage or use of hazardous materials (True) or not (False). Relevant for laboratories, research spaces, and facilities requiring special safety protocols.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200), EPA regulations

attributes.name: hvac_zone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Zone
attributes.description: The HVAC zone or control area to which this room belongs. Used for energy management, temperature control, and facilities maintenance planning.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent facilities inspection or condition assessment of the room. Used for compliance tracking and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this room record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: natural_light_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room has windows or skylights providing natural daylight (True) or is an interior room without natural light (False). Relevant for occupant comfort, energy efficiency, and space quality assessments.
attributes.references: LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) Indoor Environmental Quality

attributes.name: net_assignable_square_feet
attributes.description: The net assignable square footage of the room, measured per FICM standards. Used for space utilization analysis, Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost rate calculations, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES, IPEDS Facilities Component

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Current occupancy or availability status of the room. Occupied=assigned to a department or individual; Vacant=available for assignment; Reserved=scheduled for specific use; Under_renovation=temporarily unavailable due to construction; Decommissioned=no longer in service; Temporary_closure=short-term unavailability.

attributes.name: renovation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent major renovation or refurbishment of the room. Used for capital planning, deferred maintenance tracking, and space quality assessment.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, department, or unit responsible for the room's management, maintenance, and scheduling. May be a facilities manager, department chair, or administrative contact.

attributes.name: room_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the room, often used for named lecture halls, laboratories, or conference rooms (e.g., 'Smith Auditorium', 'Chemistry Lab A', 'Board Room').

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: The official room number or identifier as displayed on signage and used in campus navigation. May include alphanumeric characters and floor prefixes (e.g., 201A, B-105, L3-220).

attributes.name: room_type
attributes.description: High-level categorical classification of the room's primary function. Used for space utilization reporting, scheduling eligibility, and facilities planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: classroom|laboratory|office|conference_room|study_room|residence_hall_unit|common_area|storage|mechanical|restroom|auditorium|library_space|athletic_facility|dining_facility|healthcare_facility|other — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scheduling_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is available for centralized scheduling through the registrar or scheduling office (True) or is managed independently by a department (False). Relevant for course scheduling and event management.

attributes.name: scheduling_priority
attributes.description: The primary scheduling priority or use category for the room. Academic=prioritized for course instruction; Administrative=departmental meetings and operations; Event=special events and conferences; Research=research activities; Mixed_use=multiple purposes.

attributes.name: seating_configuration
attributes.description: The physical arrangement and type of seating in the room. Fixed=permanent seating; Movable=chairs and tables that can be rearranged; Tiered=lecture hall style; Seminar=conference table; Laboratory=lab benches; Theater=auditorium seating. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed|movable|tiered|seminar|laboratory|conference|theater|flexible|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: smart_classroom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is equipped as a smart classroom with integrated technology for teaching and learning (True) or not (False). Smart classrooms typically include projection systems, document cameras, audio systems, and network connectivity.

attributes.name: station_count
attributes.description: The number of fixed workstations, seats, or positions available in the room. Relevant for classrooms, laboratories, computer labs, and study spaces. Used for scheduling and utilization metrics.

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the room type (e.g., 'Wet Lab', 'Dry Lab', 'Smart Classroom', 'Seminar Room', 'Single Occupancy', 'Double Occupancy').

attributes.name: technology_infrastructure
attributes.description: Description of network, power, and technology infrastructure available in the room (e.g., 'Gigabit Ethernet, WiFi 6, 20 power outlets, USB charging stations, HDMI connectivity').

attributes.name: use_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the primary functional use of the room according to Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual (FICM) or institutional taxonomy (e.g., 110=Classroom, 210=Class Laboratory, 310=Research Laboratory, 410=Study Room, 610=Office).
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES

attributes.name: window_count
attributes.description: The number of windows in the room. Used for natural light assessment, energy modeling, and space quality evaluation.

products.name: campus
products.description: Master record for each distinct campus or off-campus instructional site operated by the institution. Captures campus code, campus name, campus type (main campus, branch campus, off-campus center, online), physical address, total acreage, total gross square footage, accreditation status with regional accreditor, IPEDS unit ID, and operational status. Serves as the top-level geographic hierarchy node above buildings for space inventory, IPEDS reporting, and multi-campus institutional planning.

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campus record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accreditation_date
attributes.description: Date when the campus received its current accreditation status. Used for tracking accreditation cycles and reaffirmation timelines.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation standing of the campus with its regional accrediting body. Accredited indicates full approval; candidate indicates provisional status; probation indicates conditional approval with required improvements; not accredited indicates no current accreditation; pending review indicates evaluation in progress.
attributes.references: Regional Accreditation Standards (HLC, SACSCOC, MSCHE, NWCCU, NECHE, WSCUC)

attributes.name: accreditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the regional or specialized accrediting agency responsible for evaluating the campus. Examples include Higher Learning Commission (HLC), Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC), Middle States Commission on Higher Education (MSCHE).
attributes.references: CHEA (Council for Higher Education Accreditation) Directory

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campus meets ADA accessibility requirements. True indicates full compliance; False indicates non-compliance or partial compliance. Used for compliance reporting and facilities planning.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the campus including building number and street name. Used for official correspondence, accreditation documentation, and facilities management.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite number, building name, or department. Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: assignable_square_feet
attributes.description: Total assignable square footage available for occupancy and specific use. Excludes circulation, mechanical, and structural areas. Used for space allocation, utilization metrics, and indirect cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES

attributes.name: athletic_facilities_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campus has dedicated athletic or recreation facilities. True indicates athletic facilities are present; False indicates no athletic facilities. Used for student services planning and NCAA compliance.

attributes.name: building_count
attributes.description: Total number of buildings located on the campus. Includes academic, administrative, residential, and auxiliary buildings. Used for facilities inventory and capital planning.

attributes.name: campus_code
attributes.description: Institution-assigned unique alphanumeric code for the campus. Used in Student Information System (SIS) and Facilities Management System (FMS) for campus identification.

attributes.name: campus_name
attributes.description: Official name of the campus or instructional site as registered with the institution and accrediting bodies.

attributes.name: campus_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campus based on its operational role within the institution. Main campus is the primary instructional and administrative site; branch campus is a geographically separate location with independent operations; regional campus serves a specific geographic area; extension center offers limited programs; online campus is virtual; off-campus center is a satellite instructional site.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the campus is located. Required for IPEDS reporting and accreditation documentation.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the campus ceased operations or was officially closed. Null for active campuses. Used for historical tracking and IPEDS reporting of closed locations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the campus is located. Required for international campuses and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the campus record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for campus administrative contact. Used for official correspondence and public inquiries.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary emergency contact person or office for the campus. Used for crisis management and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 emergency contact phone number for the campus. Used for crisis situations, security incidents, and emergency notifications.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the campus was officially established or opened for instruction. Used for historical records and institutional milestone tracking.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the campus administrative office. Used for official document transmission and legacy communication channels.

attributes.name: ipeds_unit_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Unit Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Six-digit unique identifier assigned by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) for IPEDS reporting. Required for all Title IV eligible institutions and their branch campuses.
attributes.references: IPEDS Unit ID Registry - U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the campus in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, geographic analysis, and location-based services.

attributes.name: library_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campus has a physical library facility. True indicates a library is present; False indicates no library. Used for academic resource planning and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: ACRL (Association of College and Research Libraries) Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the campus in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, geographic analysis, and location-based services.

attributes.name: next_accreditation_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next comprehensive accreditation review or reaffirmation visit. Typically occurs on a 5-10 year cycle depending on the accrediting body.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional campus information, special characteristics, or administrative notes. Used for documenting unique campus attributes not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the campus. Active indicates the campus is fully operational and offering instruction; inactive indicates the campus is not currently in use; planned indicates future campus under development; under construction indicates physical development in progress; decommissioned indicates permanent closure; temporary closure indicates short-term suspension of operations.
attributes.references: Archibus Space Management - Facility Status Codes

attributes.name: parking_spaces_count
attributes.description: Total number of parking spaces available on the campus. Includes student, faculty, staff, visitor, and accessible parking. Used for transportation planning and parking management.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the campus. Used for general inquiries, emergency contact, and directory listings.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the campus location. Used for mail delivery, geographic analysis, and regional reporting.

attributes.name: residence_hall_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of students that can be housed in on-campus residence halls at this campus. Used for housing planning, enrollment management, and student life operations.

attributes.name: security_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campus has a dedicated campus security or police department. True indicates security presence; False indicates no dedicated security. Used for Clery Act reporting and safety planning.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the campus is located. Uses USPS state abbreviations for U.S. locations or ISO 3166-2 codes for international locations.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the campus location. Used for scheduling, course registration, event management, and system timestamp conversions. Examples: America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Los_Angeles.

attributes.name: total_acreage
attributes.description: Total land area of the campus in acres. Includes all owned and leased property. Used for facilities planning, capital project planning, and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: total_gross_square_feet
attributes.description: Total gross square footage of all buildings on the campus. Measured per FICM standards. Used for space utilization analysis, Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost rate calculations, and capital planning.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the campus record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL for the campus. Provides public access to campus information, programs, and services.

products.name: space_assignment

Critical for F&A indirect cost rate space surveys per OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), accreditation space reporting, and IPEDS facilities data submissions. Serves as the bridge between physical space inventory and organizational cost allocation.

attributes.name: accreditation_review_id

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. The existing animal_research_flag

attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this space assignment should be included in accreditation self-study reports and site visit documentation. Used for regional and programmatic accreditation compliance (SACSCOC, HLC, ABET, AACSB, etc.).

attributes.name: ada_compliance_required

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this space assignment requires ADA accessibility compliance due to occupant needs or program requirements. Used for facilities planning and accommodation tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment indicating whether the space is assigned as primary occupancy, shared among multiple units, swing space during renovation, temporary assignment, seasonal use, or reserved for future allocation.

attributes.name: chargeback_rate

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this space assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ficm_room_use_code

attributes.description: Three-digit code from the FICM standard indicating the functional use of the space during this assignment period (e.g., 110 for classroom, 250 for research laboratory, 310 for office). Used for IPEDS facilities reporting and F&A rate space surveys.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual), IPEDS Facilities Component

attributes.name: hazardous_materials_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the assigned space will be used for activities involving hazardous materials, chemicals, or biohazards. Triggers additional safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Laboratory Safety Standards, EPA Regulations, Institutional Environmental Health and Safety

attributes.name: human_subjects_research_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the assigned space will be used for research involving human subjects. Requires IRB (Institutional Review Board) approval and compliance with HIPAA and FERPA as applicable.
attributes.references: IRB (Institutional Review Board), HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act), FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this space assignment should be included in IPEDS facilities reporting. Used to filter assignments for federal reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Facilities Component

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this space assignment record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: occupancy_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the space allocated to this assignment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 50.00 for 50% occupancy). Used for shared space assignments where multiple organizational units share a single room. Sum of all assignments for a room should equal 100.00.

attributes.name: purpose_code
attributes.description: Classification of the space assignment purpose for indirect cost allocation: instruction (teaching activities), research (sponsored research projects), other sponsored (non-research sponsored activities), institutional (administrative support), or unallowable (activities not eligible for F&A recovery). Required for OMB Uniform Guidance compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the space assignment must be renewed or revalidated. Null if renewal is not required. Used for proactive space management and reallocation planning.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this space assignment requires periodic renewal or revalidation. Used for temporary assignments, grant-funded space, or assignments subject to annual review.

attributes.name: space_survey_period
attributes.description: The fiscal year or survey period (YYYY format) during which this space assignment was recorded for F&A rate calculation purposes. Required for OMB Uniform Guidance space surveys conducted biennially or as required by federal sponsors.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Federal F&A Rate Negotiation

products.name: capital_project
products.description: Master record for a capital construction, renovation, or infrastructure improvement project including milestone and phase tracking. Captures project number, project name, project type (new construction, major renovation, deferred maintenance, infrastructure upgrade), scope description, funding source, total authorized budget, current encumbrance, actual expenditures to date, project phase (planning, design, construction, closeout), architect/contractor of record, projected and actual completion dates. Supports project schedule reporting to the Board of Trustees and state facilities oversight agencies.

attributes.description: Intended use or purpose of the planned gift proceeds as specified by the donor (e.g., scholarship endowment, faculty chair, unrestricted support, capital project).
attributes.references: CASE Gift Acceptance and Counting Standards; Institutional Gift Policy

attributes.name: documentation_date
attributes.description: Date when legal documentation was executed or verified. Distinct from commitment date, which may precede formal documentation.

attributes.name: estate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the donor's estate designated for the institution in bequest commitments. Null for fixed-amount or non-bequest vehicles.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Standards; Estate Planning Documentation Standards

attributes.name: estimated_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated present or future value of the planned gift at maturity, used for pipeline reporting and stewardship tier assignment. Subject to periodic revaluation.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Valuation Guidelines; IRS Publication 561 - Determining the Value of Donated Property

attributes.name: expected_maturity_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the planned gift will be realized and transferred to the institution. May be estimated based on actuarial tables for life-contingent gifts.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Pipeline Management Standards

attributes.name: fixed_amount
attributes.description: Specific dollar amount designated in the planned gift commitment. Used for fixed bequests and annuity contracts. Null for percentage-based commitments.

attributes.name: gift_vehicle_type
attributes.description: The legal instrument or vehicle through which the planned gift will be realized. Determines tax treatment, timing, and stewardship approach.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 526 - Charitable Contributions; Council for Advancement and Support of Education (CASE) Planned Giving Standards

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of most recent stewardship contact or engagement activity with the donor regarding this planned gift commitment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planned gift record was most recently updated in the data platform. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: legal_documentation_status
attributes.description: Level of legal formalization of the planned gift commitment. Tracks progression from verbal intention through executed legal instruments to institutional verification.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Documentation Standards; Institutional Legal Compliance

attributes.name: next_contact_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next stewardship contact or follow-up activity. Used for relationship management and stewardship workflow.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, donor preferences, or stewardship considerations for this planned gift commitment.

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary beneficiary organization as documented in the legal instrument. Typically the institution's legal name or a specific college/school within it.

attributes.name: prospect_rating
attributes.description: Prospect research rating indicating the donor's overall giving capacity and engagement level. Used for portfolio assignment and cultivation strategy.
attributes.references: Prospect Research Standards; Advancement Services Portfolio Management

attributes.name: recognition_name
attributes.description: Name(s) to be used for donor recognition purposes in planned giving society materials, honor rolls, and stewardship communications. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: recognition_published_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor has consented to public recognition of their planned gift commitment in institutional publications and honor rolls.
attributes.references: Donor Privacy and Recognition Policy; CASE Standards

attributes.name: revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the estimated value was last reviewed and updated. Planned gifts should be periodically revalued based on market conditions and actuarial updates.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Valuation Standards; Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: revocable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor retains the legal right to revoke or modify the planned gift commitment. True for most bequests; false for irrevocable trusts and executed annuities.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Standards; IRS Publication 526

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the donor formally revoked or withdrew the planned gift commitment. Populated when commitment status changes to revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason provided for revocation of the planned gift commitment. Used for relationship management and program improvement analysis.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this planned gift record originated (e.g., Blackbaud Raisers Edge, custom planned giving database).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this planned gift record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: stewardship_tier
attributes.description: Recognition and stewardship tier assigned based on estimated gift value, donor relationship, and institutional priorities. Determines engagement strategy and benefits.
attributes.references: Advancement Services Stewardship Framework; Donor Relations Standards

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the institution verified the existence and terms of the planned gift commitment.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Verification Standards; Advancement Services Best Practices

products.name: prospect_rating

Supports prospect research workflows and major gifts officer portfolio management. Sourced from third-party wealth screening vendors (e.g., DonorSearch, iWave) integrated into Blackbaud Raiser's Edge.

attributes.name: prospect_rating_id

attributes.name: primary_prospect_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member (major gifts officer or prospect manager) assigned to manage this prospect based on the rating.

attributes.name: assigned_rating_tier

attributes.name: board_memberships

attributes.name: business_interests_value

attributes.name: capacity_currency_code

attributes.name: capacity_rating
attributes.description: Overall giving capacity tier assigned to the prospect: major (100K-999K), principal (1M+), planned (estate gift potential), annual (under 100K), or unrated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prospect rating record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) representing the completeness and reliability of the underlying data used to generate the rating, often provided by wealth screening vendors.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_income
attributes.description: Estimated annual income from all sources including salary, bonuses, investment income, and business income, derived from compensation disclosures and wealth screening data.

attributes.name: estimated_capacity_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total giving capacity in dollars based on wealth indicators, typically representing a lifetime giving potential or single major gift capacity.

attributes.name: estimated_capacity_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of the estimated giving capacity range in dollars.

attributes.name: estimated_capacity_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of the estimated giving capacity range in dollars.

attributes.name: estimated_net_worth
attributes.description: Total estimated net worth calculated as sum of all assets (real estate, stocks, business interests, other investments) minus estimated liabilities.

attributes.name: foundation_affiliations
attributes.description: Names of private foundations where the prospect serves as trustee, officer, or donor, sourced from IRS Form 990 filings.

attributes.name: inclination_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the prospect's likelihood to give based on past giving behavior, philanthropic interests, and engagement patterns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prospect rating record was last updated, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the rating was last reviewed and validated by prospect research staff, ensuring currency and accuracy.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next rating review and refresh, typically 12-24 months from last review per CASE best practices.

attributes.name: philanthropic_interests
attributes.description: Known philanthropic interests and giving priorities of the prospect based on past giving history, foundation grants, board memberships, and public statements.

attributes.name: political_contributions_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect has made political contributions disclosed in Federal Election Commission (FEC) records, signaling capacity and civic engagement.

attributes.name: portfolio_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the prospect was assigned to a major gifts officer portfolio based on this rating.

attributes.name: propensity_score
attributes.description: Predictive score (0-100) indicating likelihood of making a gift, often generated by statistical modeling or machine learning algorithms based on historical donor behavior.

attributes.name: rating_date
attributes.description: Date when the prospect rating was assigned or last updated. Principal business event timestamp for the rating lifecycle.

attributes.name: rating_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the rating becomes effective for prospect management and major gifts officer portfolio assignment.

attributes.name: rating_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the rating expires and should be refreshed. Typically 12-24 months from rating date per CASE best practices.

attributes.name: rating_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from prospect researchers providing context, qualitative insights, and recommendations for cultivation strategy based on the rating.

attributes.name: rating_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the prospect rating record, typically assigned by the wealth screening vendor or prospect research office.

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the prospect rating: active (current and valid), expired (outdated), under review (being reassessed), pending (awaiting approval), or archived (historical record).

attributes.name: rating_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rating methodology used: wealth screening from third-party vendor, manual prospect research, peer screening, electronic screening, or combined approach.

attributes.name: real_estate_holdings_value
attributes.description: Estimated total value of real estate holdings owned by the prospect, sourced from public property records and wealth screening vendors.

attributes.name: research_confidence_level
attributes.description: Confidence level in the accuracy and completeness of the wealth indicators and capacity estimate: high (multiple verified sources), medium (limited sources), low (estimated or inferred).

attributes.name: research_source
attributes.description: Name of the third-party wealth screening vendor or research source that provided the rating data (e.g., DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine, RelSci).

attributes.name: research_vendor_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the wealth screening vendor to this rating record, used for data reconciliation and vendor support.

attributes.name: stock_ownership_value
attributes.description: Estimated value of publicly traded stock holdings, including insider holdings reported to SEC and beneficial ownership disclosed in proxy statements.

attributes.name: wealth_indicator_source
attributes.description: Primary source of wealth indicators used in the rating: public records, SEC filings, proxy statements, Forbes/Fortune lists, foundation 990s, or third-party wealth screening vendor.

Supports stewardship plan fulfillment, acknowledgment compliance within IRS-required timeframes, and moves management contact reporting.

attributes.description: The chart of accounts segment or cost center code to which spending distributions from this endowment are posted in the general ledger.

attributes.name: annual_distribution_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount authorized for spending distribution from this endowment for the current fiscal year. Calculated based on spending policy rate and market value.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endowment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_principal_amount
attributes.description: The current corpus or principal balance of the endowment, including all subsequent gifts added to principal. Represents the donor-restricted amount that must be maintained in perpetuity for true endowments.

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: The date when the endowment fund was officially established and began accepting gifts. Marks the beginning of the fund's operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The official name of the endowed fund, typically reflecting the donor's naming preference or the fund's purpose.

attributes.name: fund_number
attributes.description: The externally-known fund accounting number assigned to this endowment in the institutional chart of accounts. Used for financial reporting and donor communication.

attributes.name: fund_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the donor-specified purpose and restrictions for spending distributions from this endowment. Defines how funds may be used (e.g., scholarships, faculty support, program funding).

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the endowment fund. Active: fund is operational and distributing. Inactive: temporarily not distributing. Closed: fund has been terminated. Suspended: distributions paused pending review. Pending establishment: fund committed but not yet operational.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the endowment based on donor restrictions and institutional policy. True endowment: donor-restricted principal in perpetuity. Quasi-endowment: board-designated funds functioning as endowment. Term endowment: donor-restricted for a specified period.
attributes.references: UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act)

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this endowment is included in the institution's annual IPEDS Finance Survey endowment reporting. True if reportable, False if excluded.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endowment record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_stewardship_report_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent annual stewardship report was sent to the donor or their designee. Used to track stewardship compliance.

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: The current fair market value of the endowment fund, including principal, accumulated gains, and reinvested income. This is the total investable asset value used for spending distribution calculations.

attributes.name: market_value_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the market value was calculated. Typically the last business day of the fiscal quarter or year.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required
attributes.description: The minimum endowment balance required by institutional policy before spending distributions can begin. Typically $25,000 to $50,000 for most institutions.

attributes.name: nacubo_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of College and University Business Officers (NACUBO) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this endowment is included in the institution's annual NACUBO-Commonfund Study of Endowments participation. True if reportable, False if excluded.

attributes.name: named_honoree
attributes.description: The individual or entity honored or memorialized by this endowment, as specified by the donor. Used in fund naming and stewardship communications.

attributes.name: next_stewardship_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next annual stewardship report is due to be sent to the donor. Typically aligned with fiscal year-end reporting cycles.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or historical context about this endowment that does not fit in structured fields.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: original_gift_date
attributes.description: The date when the initial gift that established this endowment was received. May differ from establishment date if there was a delay in fund setup.

attributes.name: original_principal_amount
attributes.description: The initial gift amount that established the endowment. This is the historic dollar value of the original contribution and serves as the baseline for UPMIFA spending policy calculations.

attributes.name: purpose_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the endowment's spending purpose for reporting and analysis. Aligns with NACUBO and IPEDS endowment reporting categories.

attributes.name: spending_policy_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate annual spending distributions. Total return: percentage of smoothed market value. Income only: actual income earned. Hybrid: combination approach.

attributes.name: spending_policy_rate
attributes.description: The annual spending distribution rate applied to this endowment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.5%). Determines the amount available for spending each year under the institution's UPMIFA-compliant spending policy.

attributes.name: stewardship_report_status
attributes.description: Status of the annual endowment stewardship report to the donor. Required: report must be sent. Completed: report has been delivered. Waived: donor declined reporting. Pending: report in preparation.

attributes.name: underwater_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount by which the current market value is below the original principal, if the endowment is underwater. Null or zero if not underwater.

attributes.name: underwater_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the endowment's current market value has fallen below the original principal amount (underwater status). True if underwater, False if not. Affects spending policy decisions under UPMIFA.

attributes.name: unit_market_value
attributes.description: The current market value per unit in the investment pool. Used to calculate the endowment's total market value from units held.

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: The number of units this endowment holds in the investment pool. Market value equals units held multiplied by unit market value.

attributes.name: ytd_distribution_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount distributed from this endowment during the current fiscal year to date. Used to track spending against the annual authorization.

products.name: regulatory_requirement

Captures requirement source (e.g., Title IV, FERPA, Clery Act, ADA, Title IX, IPEDS, NCAA), regulatory body, effective dates, applicability scope (institution-wide, program-specific, department-specific), compliance obligation type, citation reference, and enforcement mechanism. Serves as the authoritative reference for all compliance obligations tracked across the institution.

attributes.description: Expected time in minutes required to complete the training program, including all modules, assessments, and required activities. Used for scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this training program version is no longer effective or available for new assignments. Null for programs with no planned end date. Used to manage training content lifecycle and version transitions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this training program version became or will become effective and available for assignment. Used to manage training content transitions and regulatory compliance effective dates.

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion data for this training program must be included in IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) reporting to the U.S. Department of Education. True if IPEDS reporting is required; false otherwise.
attributes.references: IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country code) indicating the primary language in which the training content is delivered (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish, en-US for US English).

attributes.name: learning_objectives
attributes.description: Specific, measurable learning outcomes that participants are expected to achieve upon completion of the training. Aligned with regulatory requirements and institutional policy goals.

attributes.name: mobile_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training content is optimized for and accessible on mobile devices (smartphones, tablets). True if mobile-compatible; false if desktop-only.
attributes.references: Learning Management System Standards; User Experience Policy

attributes.name: passing_score_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score required on the training assessment to achieve completion status. Null if the training does not include a graded assessment. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 80.00 represents 80%).

attributes.name: recertification_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months after completion before the training must be retaken to maintain compliance. Common values include 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), or 36 (triennial). Null if the training is one-time only and does not require recertification.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the population required to complete this training program. Examples include all employees, faculty only, student-athletes, new students, researchers with human subjects protocols, department chairs, Title IX coordinators, or other role-based or attribute-based cohorts.
attributes.references: Institutional Human Resources Policy; Student Affairs Policy

attributes.name: training_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code for the training program used in communications, reporting, and system integrations. Typically follows institutional coding standards.

attributes.name: training_name
attributes.description: Official name of the compliance training program as displayed to users and in institutional documentation.

attributes.name: training_program_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the training program content, learning objectives, and compliance purpose. Provides context for administrators and participants about what the training covers and why it is required.

attributes.name: training_program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training program. Active programs are available for assignment and completion; inactive programs are temporarily unavailable; under_review programs are being evaluated for content or policy updates; archived programs are retained for historical record but no longer assigned; draft programs are in development and not yet published.

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training program based on institutional requirement level. Mandatory training is required by law or policy; recommended training is strongly encouraged; optional training is available but not required; conditional training is required for specific roles or circumstances.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training program record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or content provider that developed or supplies the training program, if applicable. Null for internally-developed training. Used for vendor management and contract tracking.

products.name: risk_assessment
products.description: Institutional compliance risk register tracking identified compliance risks, risk categories (regulatory, financial, reputational, operational), likelihood and impact ratings, risk owners, mitigation strategies, residual risk scores, review frequency, and risk trend over time. Used by the Chief Compliance Officer to prioritize compliance monitoring activities, allocate resources, and report to the Board Audit Committee on institutional risk posture. Feeds enterprise risk management reporting and accreditation self-studies.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance risk assessment record. Primary key for the risk assessment entity.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Compliance risk assessments are frequently triggered by or associated with audit findings. An audit may identify a compliance gap that generates a risk assessment entry, or a risk assessment may be co

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Risk assessments are conducted for specific buildings (seismic risk, fire risk, deferred maintenance risk, environmental hazards). Linking risk_assessment to the assessed building supports facilities

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the institutional policy that governs or addresses this compliance risk area.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific regulatory requirement or compliance obligation that this risk relates to, if applicable.

attributes.name: responsible_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Risk assessments in higher-ed compliance are owned by specific org units (e.g., Office of Research Compliance, Export Control Office). The responsible_org_unit_id FK replaces the denormalized responsi

attributes.name: risk_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Enterprise risk management requires designated risk owner with accountability for mitigation. Links owner for escalation workflows, enables risk portfolio analysis by personnel, and provides governanc

attributes.name: student_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.student_org. Business justification: Higher-ed compliance offices conduct formal risk assessments of high-risk student organizations (Greek life, club sports). student_org.risk_tier is a denormalized field; a FK to risk_assessment enable

attributes.name: superseded_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk_assessment (superseded_risk_assessment_id)

attributes.name: accreditation_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this compliance risk could affect institutional or programmatic accreditation status if not properly managed.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this risk assessment is currently active and relevant for compliance monitoring, or has been archived/closed.

attributes.name: affected_population
attributes.description: Description of the institutional stakeholder groups impacted by this risk, such as students, faculty, staff, alumni, research participants, or external partners.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal risk assessment analysis was completed, including likelihood and impact evaluation.

attributes.name: board_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this risk assessment must be reported to the Board of Trustees Audit Committee based on severity and institutional governance requirements.

attributes.name: control_effectiveness
attributes.description: Assessment of how well the current mitigation controls are functioning to reduce the risk to acceptable levels.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this risk assessment record was first created in the compliance management system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated financial impact, typically USD for U.S. higher education institutions.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact
attributes.description: Projected monetary cost to the institution if the risk materializes, including potential fines, penalties, legal costs, remediation expenses, and lost revenue.

attributes.name: external_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this risk must be disclosed to external regulatory bodies, accreditors, or government agencies.

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance risk was first identified and entered into the institutional risk register.

attributes.name: inherent_impact_rating
attributes.description: Severity assessment of the consequences if the risk materializes without any mitigation controls, rated on a five-point scale from insignificant to catastrophic.

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Probability assessment of the risk occurring without any mitigation controls in place, rated on a five-point scale from rare to almost certain.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated numerical score representing the inherent risk level before mitigation, typically derived from likelihood multiplied by impact (scale 1-25).

attributes.name: last_board_report_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk was most recently presented to the Board of Trustees or Audit Committee for review and oversight.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this risk assessment record was most recently updated, used for audit trail and data currency tracking.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this risk assessment, used to track currency of risk evaluation.

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the controls, processes, policies, and actions implemented or planned to reduce the likelihood or impact of the risk.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this risk assessment, based on review frequency and risk level.

attributes.name: residual_impact_rating
attributes.description: Severity assessment of the consequences if the risk materializes after considering existing mitigation controls, rated on a five-point scale.

attributes.name: residual_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Probability assessment of the risk occurring after considering existing mitigation controls and strategies, rated on a five-point scale.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated numerical score representing the residual risk level after mitigation controls are applied, used to prioritize compliance monitoring activities (scale 1-25).

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled reviews of this risk assessment, typically ranging from 3 to 12 months based on risk severity.

attributes.name: risk_appetite_threshold
attributes.description: Institutional tolerance level for this risk category, expressed as a numerical score. Residual risk scores above this threshold require escalation and additional mitigation.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the risk type: regulatory (compliance with laws/regulations), financial (monetary impact), reputational (institutional image), operational (process/system failures), strategic (mission alignment), or legal (litigation exposure).

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the compliance risk, including the nature of the risk, potential triggers, and context within institutional operations.

attributes.name: risk_notes
attributes.description: Additional contextual information, observations, or commentary about the risk assessment, mitigation progress, or special considerations.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the risk assessment, formatted as RISK-XXXXXX for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk assessment: identified (newly discovered), assessed (analysis complete), active (requires ongoing attention), mitigated (controls implemented), closed (resolved), or monitoring (under surveillance).

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular detail within the primary risk category, such as Title IX, FERPA, Clery Act, NCAA, accreditation, financial aid, research compliance, or data privacy.

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Concise title or name of the identified compliance risk for quick reference and reporting.

attributes.name: risk_trend
attributes.description: Directional indicator of how the risk profile is changing over time based on comparison of current and historical assessments.

products.name: accrediting_body

attributes.name: accrediting_body_id
attributes.description: Primary key for accrediting_body

attributes.name: parent_accrediting_body_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on accrediting_body (parent_accrediting_body_id)

attributes.name: accreditation_cycle_years
attributes.description: Standard number of years in the accreditation cycle used by this accrediting body (e.g., 5, 7, 10 years).

attributes.name: accreditation_type

attributes.name: accrediting_body_name

attributes.name: acronym

attributes.name: annual_report_required

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: complaint_process_url

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: discipline_focus

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the accrediting body's jurisdiction: regional (specific U.S. region), national (entire U.S.), or international.

attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2

attributes.name: member_institution_count

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next recognition review by the recognizing authority.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this accrediting body.

attributes.name: peer_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrediting body requires peer review as part of its accreditation process.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the accrediting body headquarters.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when the accrediting body was first recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or CHEA.

attributes.name: recognition_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current recognition period expires and renewal is required.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current recognition status of the accrediting body by the U.S. Department of Education or CHEA.

attributes.name: recognizing_authority
attributes.description: The authority that recognizes this accrediting body: USDE (U.S. Department of Education), CHEA (Council for Higher Education Accreditation), both, other, or none.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Specific geographic region served by the accrediting body if it is a regional accreditor (e.g., Middle States, New England, North Central, Northwest, Southern, Western).

attributes.name: self_study_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrediting body requires institutions to complete a comprehensive self-study as part of the accreditation process.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used short name for the accrediting body.

attributes.name: site_visit_required

attributes.name: standards_effective_date

attributes.name: standards_version
attributes.description: Current version or edition of the accreditation standards used by this accrediting body.

attributes.name: state_province
