attributes.name: substantive_change_policy_url
attributes.description: URL to the accrediting body's substantive change policy documentation.

attributes.name: title_iv_eligibility_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether accreditation by this body is required for institutions to participate in federal Title IV student financial aid programs.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the accrediting body.

products.name: audit
products.description: Master reference table for audit. Referenced by audit_id.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Primary key for audit

attributes.name: audited_building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Facilities audits (fire safety, ADA, environmental, deferred maintenance) are conducted against specific buildings. Linking audit to the audited building supports facilities compliance reporting, audi

attributes.name: audited_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Internal audits in higher-ed are scoped to specific org units (colleges, departments, administrative offices). The audited_org_unit_id FK replaces the denormalized department_audited text field, enabl

attributes.name: followup_audit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on audit (followup_audit_id)

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Compliance audits are conducted against specific institutional policies (e.g., an audit of FERPA compliance is conducted against the FERPA policy; a financial aid audit is conducted against the financ

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: audit currently has regulatory_framework as a STRING field (e.g., 'Title IV', 'FERPA', 'NCAA'). Adding regulatory_requirement_id FK provides structured linkage to the regulatory_requirement master tab

attributes.name: residence_hall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.residence_hall. Business justification: Residence halls are subject to named regulatory compliance audits: fire safety inspections, ADA accessibility audits, housing regulation compliance reviews. A FK from audit to residence_hall enables s

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The name of the accrediting agency or regulatory body for which this audit was conducted, such as HLC, SACSCOC, ABET, or U.S. Department of Education.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The date when audit fieldwork was actually completed, which may differ from the scheduled end date.

attributes.name: actual_remediation_date
attributes.description: The date when corrective actions were verified as fully implemented and audit findings were closed.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The date when audit fieldwork actually commenced, which may differ from the scheduled start date due to operational factors.

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the audit, typically formatted as AUD-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: The breadth and boundaries of the audit engagement, defining what organizational units, processes, or systems are included in the examination.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audit. Planned audits are scheduled but not started, in-progress audits are actively being conducted, fieldwork indicates data collection phase, reporting indicates draft preparation, issued means final report delivered, and closed indicates all follow-up completed.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on its purpose and scope. Internal audits are conducted by institutional staff, external audits by third parties, compliance audits verify regulatory adherence, financial audits examine fiscal controls, operational audits assess process efficiency, and academic audits review program quality.

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: The name of the organization or department conducting the audit, such as Internal Audit, external audit firm name, or regulatory agency.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: The determination of whether the audited area meets applicable regulatory, policy, or accreditation requirements.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: The data classification level assigned to the audit report and working papers, determining who may access the audit documentation.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_received_date
attributes.description: The date when management's corrective action plan was received by the audit function.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: The total cost incurred for the audit engagement, including internal staff time and external fees, expressed in U.S. dollars.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this audit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_finding_count
attributes.description: The number of critical-severity findings identified that require immediate management attention and remediation.

attributes.name: estimated_remediation_date
attributes.description: The target date by which management commits to fully implement corrective actions to address audit findings.

attributes.name: external_auditor_fee
attributes.description: The fee paid to external audit firms or consultants for conducting the audit, expressed in U.S. dollars. Null for internal audits.

attributes.name: finding_count
attributes.description: The total number of audit findings identified during the engagement, including all severity levels.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which management must submit corrective action plans or follow-up responses to audit findings.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether management is required to provide follow-up responses or corrective action plans for audit findings.

attributes.name: high_finding_count
attributes.description: The number of high-severity findings identified that represent significant control weaknesses.

attributes.name: hours
attributes.description: The total number of staff hours invested in conducting the audit engagement, including planning, fieldwork, and reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this audit record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_name
attributes.description: The full name of the principal auditor responsible for conducting and overseeing the audit engagement.

attributes.name: low_finding_count
attributes.description: The number of low-severity findings identified that represent minor control weaknesses or opportunities for improvement.

attributes.name: medium_finding_count
attributes.description: The number of medium-severity findings identified that represent moderate control weaknesses.

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: The audit approach and techniques used, such as risk-based audit, compliance audit, process audit, or systems audit.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional context, observations, or special circumstances related to the audit engagement.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: The primary purpose and goals of the audit engagement, describing what the audit seeks to accomplish or verify.

attributes.name: overall_opinion
attributes.description: The auditor's overall conclusion regarding the adequacy and effectiveness of controls in the audited area. Satisfactory indicates effective controls, needs improvement indicates control gaps requiring attention, unsatisfactory indicates significant control deficiencies, and adverse indicates pervasive control failures.

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: The total number of items or transactions in the population from which the audit sample was drawn.

attributes.name: report_distribution_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of roles or individuals who received the final audit report, such as Board of Trustees, President, CFO, Audit Committee.

attributes.name: report_issued_date
attributes.description: The date when the final audit report was formally issued to stakeholders.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The overall risk assessment assigned to the audit area based on potential impact and likelihood of control failures. Critical indicates severe institutional risk, high indicates significant risk, moderate indicates manageable risk, and low indicates minimal risk.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of items or transactions selected for detailed testing during the audit.

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: The technique used to select items for testing during the audit. Statistical sampling uses probability theory, judgmental sampling relies on auditor expertise, random sampling selects items by chance, stratified sampling divides population into subgroups, and census examines all items.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: The planned date when the audit engagement is scheduled to be completed.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: The planned date when the audit engagement is scheduled to begin.

domains.name: hr
domains.description: Manages the full non-faculty employee lifecycle including recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, payroll, performance management, and offboarding. Tracks position control, job classifications, salary administration, leave accruals, FTE workforce data, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Supports Workday HCM operations and institutional workforce planning.

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for all non-faculty staff employees at the institution. Captures full identity, demographic, employment classification, job title, department assignment, FTE status, FLSA classification, EEO category, hire date, termination date, and employment type (full-time, part-time, temporary, contract). Serves as the SSOT for non-faculty workforce identity sourced from Workday HCM. Excludes faculty, who are owned by the faculty domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the non-faculty staff employee record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the employee master data product sourced from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.job_profile. Business justification: The employee table stores job_profile_code as a denormalized string, but job_profile is the authoritative catalog of job classifications in the hr domain. Adding a FK employee.job_profile_id → hr.job_

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.position. Business justification: The employee table stores position_number as a denormalized string referencing the authorized position control record. position is the authoritative budgeted role record in the hr domain. Adding emplo

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee_id of the direct supervisor or manager for this employee. Supports org hierarchy traversal, performance management workflows, and approval routing in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: annual_salary
attributes.description: The employee's annualized base salary in USD. For part-time employees, this reflects the annualized equivalent of their scheduled hours. Used for budget planning, CUPA-HR benchmarking, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR; NACUBO; IRS W-2

attributes.name: benefits_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible to enroll in institutional benefit plans (health, dental, vision, retirement). Determined by employment type, FTE percentage, and ACA eligibility rules.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA); ERISA; Workday HCM Benefits Eligibility

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: The employee's citizenship or immigration status relevant to employment eligibility verification. Used for I-9 compliance, visa sponsorship tracking, and export control compliance.
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA); I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification; U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code to which the employee's compensation is charged. Used for budget allocation, financial reporting, and Oracle PeopleSoft Financials integration.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The institutional department or organizational unit code to which the employee is primarily assigned. Used for cost allocation, org hierarchy reporting, and IPEDS submissions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Cost Center; IPEDS

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported disability status per Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Required for federal contractor affirmative action reporting and ADA accommodation tracking.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA); Section 503 Rehabilitation Act; OFCCP Regulations

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: The EEO-6 job category assigned to the employee for federal equal employment opportunity reporting. Categories include Executive/Administrative, Professional, Technical, Clerical, Skilled Crafts, and Service/Maintenance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executive_administrative|professional|technical_paraprofessional|clerical_secretarial|skilled_crafts|service_maintenance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEO-6 Higher Education Staff Information Report; U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee's employment relationship with the institution. Drives access provisioning, payroll processing, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Status; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's engagement basis with the institution. Determines benefit eligibility, FTE calculation, and IPEDS workforce reporting categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR Benchmarking; Workday HCM Employment Type

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: The employee's FLSA overtime exemption status. Exempt employees are salaried and not eligible for overtime pay; non-exempt employees are hourly and eligible for overtime. Drives payroll processing rules.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); U.S. Department of Labor; Workday HCM FLSA Status

attributes.name: fte_percent
attributes.description: The employee's FTE percentage expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = full-time, 0.5000 = half-time). Used for IPEDS HR Survey reporting, benefit eligibility determination, and workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR; Workday HCM FTE

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported gender identity. Required for IPEDS HR Survey federal reporting and EEO-6 compliance. Collected and stored in accordance with FERPA and institutional privacy policies.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; EEO-6; U.S. Department of Education; FERPA

attributes.name: highest_degree_earned
attributes.description: The highest academic degree attained by the employee. Used for IPEDS HR Survey reporting, minimum qualification verification, and workforce education analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The official date the employee began employment at the institution. Used for benefits eligibility determination, service anniversary calculations, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Hire Date; IPEDS HR Survey; ERISA

attributes.name: institution_employee_number
attributes.description: The institution-assigned employee badge or personnel number used across campus systems (ERP, badge access, payroll). Serves as the human-readable cross-system identifier for the employee.

attributes.name: institutional_email
attributes.description: The official institution-issued email address for the employee. Primary contact channel for HR communications, SSO authentication, and directory services.
attributes.references: FERPA; Workday HCM Contact Information; SAML/SSO Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official institutional job title for the employee's current position as defined in the position control system. Used in directories, org charts, and CUPA-HR salary benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Position Classification

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal given (first) name as recorded on official government-issued identification. Used for payroll, tax reporting, and FERPA-compliant records.
attributes.references: FERPA; IRS W-2 Reporting; Workday HCM Legal Name

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal surname (family name) as recorded on official government-issued identification. Used for payroll, tax reporting, and FERPA-compliant records.
attributes.references: FERPA; IRS W-2 Reporting; Workday HCM Legal Name

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal middle name or initial as recorded on official identification. Used for disambiguation and formal legal documents.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Legal Name; IRS W-2 Reporting

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: The employee's personal mobile phone number. Used for emergency notifications, two-factor authentication, and urgent HR communications.

attributes.name: original_hire_date
attributes.description: The employee's first-ever hire date at the institution, preserved across rehires and position changes. Used for continuous service calculations, retirement vesting, and long-service recognition.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Continuous Service Date; ERISA Vesting Rules

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid. Drives payroll processing schedules and period-to-date compensation calculations in Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA; IRS Payroll Regulations

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation grade or band assigned to the employee's position, defining the salary range minimum, midpoint, and maximum. Used for salary administration and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; CUPA-HR Salary Benchmarking; NACUBO

attributes.name: personal_email
attributes.description: The employee's personal (non-institutional) email address. Used for emergency contact, offboarding communications, and benefit enrollment notifications.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the employee prefers to be addressed by in day-to-day institutional communications, directories, and LMS systems. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: race_ethnicity_code
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported race and ethnicity classification per OMB standards. Required for IPEDS HR Survey and EEO-6 federal reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hispanic_latino|american_indian_alaska_native|asian|black_african_american|native_hawaiian_pacific_islander|white|two_or_more_races — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; EEO-6; OMB Statistical Policy Directive 15; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the employee record was first created in the Workday HCM system of record. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and onboarding workflow tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the employee record in the Workday HCM system of record. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for rehire at the institution following separation. Set during offboarding review and used to screen future applications in Slate CRM and Workday Recruiting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rehire Eligibility; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: remote_work_type
attributes.description: The employee's approved work arrangement classification indicating whether they work on-site, in a hybrid arrangement, or fully remote. Used for space planning, tax nexus compliance, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Work Space; Institutional Remote Work Policy; State Tax Nexus Regulations

attributes.name: retirement_plan_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the retirement plan in which the employee participates (e.g., TIAA-CREF 403(b), state pension plan). Used for retirement contribution processing and ERISA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS 403(b) Regulations; Workday HCM Benefits; NACUBO

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the employee's employment with the institution ended. Null for active employees. Used for offboarding workflows, final pay processing, and workforce attrition analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination; COBRA Notification Requirements; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The coded reason for the employee's separation from the institution (e.g., voluntary resignation, retirement, involuntary termination, end of contract). Used for turnover analysis and IPEDS reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|retirement|involuntary_termination|end_of_contract|death|transfer_out — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the collective bargaining unit or union to which the employee belongs, if applicable. Drives contract-specific pay rules, leave accruals, and grievance tracking.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM Union Membership; Institutional Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported protected veteran status per VEVRAA requirements. Required for VETS-4212 federal contractor reporting and affirmative action planning.
attributes.references: Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA); VETS-4212 Report; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: visa_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the employee's work authorization visa. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous employment eligibility compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services; I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: The type of work authorization visa held by the employee if applicable (e.g., H-1B, J-1, O-1, TN). Null for U.S. citizens and permanent residents. Used for visa expiration tracking and compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services; I-9 Compliance; Export Control Regulations

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the primary physical work location or campus building assigned to the employee. Links to the Archibus facilities management system for space planning and emergency management.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management; Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: The employee's primary institutional work telephone number including area code. Used for directory listings and HR communications.

attributes.name: workday_worker_reference
attributes.description: The native worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM. Used as the operational system-of-record key for cross-system integration and ETL reconciliation with Workday HCM.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Workday HCM worker classification distinguishing regular employees from contingent workers, interns, and graduate assistants. Governs payroll processing rules and benefit eligibility.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; FLSA; IRS Worker Classification

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized position control record representing a budgeted staff role within the institution. Tracks position number, title, department, FTE allocation, funding source, FLSA classification, pay grade, position type (regular, temporary, grant-funded), and open/filled/frozen status. Supports institutional workforce planning and IPEDS FTE reporting. Sourced from Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the authorized position control record within the institution. Primary key for the position data product in the HR domain. Sourced from Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical work location (building, campus, or site) assigned to this position. Used in Archibus space planning, facilities management, and geographic workforce distribution reporting.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management; Workday HCM Location Management

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.job_profile. Business justification: Position control records must reference the institutional job classification catalog. Position has job_code (STRING) as a denormalized business key, but lacks the formal FK to job_profile. This FK est

attributes.name: position_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center to which this position is assigned. Used for workforce planning, budget allocation, and IPEDS FTE reporting by organizational unit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: position_supervisory_org_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM supervisory organization to which this position belongs. Defines the management hierarchy, reporting structure, and span of control for workforce analytics.

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the position to which this position directly reports in the organizational hierarchy. Enables org chart construction and management chain analysis without requiring an active incumbent.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Organizational Standards

attributes.name: authorized_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position was formally authorized and approved by institutional leadership or the budget office. Marks the effective start of the position's existence in the position control system.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: available_for_overlap
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position allows an overlap period where both an outgoing and incoming incumbent can be simultaneously active. Used in transition planning and headcount management within Workday HCM.

attributes.name: budgeted_annual_salary
attributes.description: The annual salary amount budgeted for this position in the institutional operating budget. Used in position control, budget encumbrance calculations, and financial planning. Expressed in USD. Distinct from the incumbent's actual salary.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Budgeting; NACUBO Budget Standards; Workday HCM Position Budgeting

attributes.name: chartfield_string
attributes.description: The Oracle PeopleSoft Financials chartfield string (combination of fund, department, program, project, and account codes) used to budget and encumber salary costs for this position. Enables financial reconciliation between HR and Finance systems.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards

attributes.name: compensation_grade_profile
attributes.description: The specific compensation grade profile within Workday HCM that defines the salary range steps and progression rules applicable to this position. Supports structured merit and equity review processes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade Profiles; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the position record was first created in Workday HCM Position Management. Provides audit trail for position control governance and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA; NACUBO Records Retention Standards

attributes.name: cupa_hr_benchmark_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) Benchmark Code
attributes.description: The CUPA-HR survey benchmark code assigned to this position for participation in the annual CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey. Enables peer institution salary comparisons and market pricing for compensation administration.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; CUPA-HR Administrative Compensation Survey

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 job category assigned to the position as required by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) for federal reporting. Categories include Executive/Senior Level Officials, First/Mid-Level Officials, Professionals, Technicians, Sales Workers, Administrative Support, Craft Workers, Operatives, Laborers/Helpers, and Service Workers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exec_senior|first_mid_officials|professionals|technicians|sales|admin_support|craft|operatives|laborers|service — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEO-1 Component 1 Report; Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC); Title VII of the Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the current position attributes (title, grade, FTE, department) are effective. Supports position history tracking and point-in-time workforce reporting in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: employee_category
attributes.description: Broad institutional classification of the position's workforce category for IPEDS reporting and HR analytics. Distinguishes staff, administrators, executives, technical/paraprofessional, and service/maintenance roles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: staff|administrator|executive|technical|service|professional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position is scheduled to end or was eliminated. Applicable to temporary, grant-funded, and seasonal positions with defined terms. Null for permanent positions with no planned end.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Designation of the position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether the role is exempt from overtime pay requirements (exempt) or entitled to overtime compensation (non_exempt). Critical for payroll compliance and labor law adherence.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) 29 U.S.C. § 201; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: frozen_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position was placed in frozen status, suspending active recruitment. Used in budget freeze tracking and workforce planning analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: The authorized Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value for this position, expressed as a decimal fraction of a full-time workload (e.g., 1.0000 for full-time, 0.5000 for half-time). Used in IPEDS FTE workforce reporting and institutional workforce planning.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO FTE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary funding source supporting this position's salary and benefits costs. General fund positions are supported by institutional operating budget; grant positions are funded by sponsored research awards; auxiliary positions are funded by self-supporting units; restricted and designated funds have specific use constraints.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards; GASB Statement No. 34

attributes.name: headcount_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is designated as full-time or part-time based on the authorized FTE allocation and institutional policy thresholds. Used in IPEDS headcount reporting and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: ipeds_occupation_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Occupation Category
attributes.description: The IPEDS occupation category code assigned to this position for federal human resources reporting to the U.S. Department of Education. Classifies positions into IPEDS-defined staff categories for annual HR survey submission.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education; National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)

attributes.name: is_benefits_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for institutional employee benefits (health insurance, retirement, tuition remission, etc.) based on FTE allocation and position type. Drives benefits enrollment eligibility in Workday HCM Benefits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits; ACA Employer Shared Responsibility; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: is_critical_position
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position has been designated as critical to institutional operations or strategic mission. Critical positions receive priority in succession planning and budget protection during financial constraints.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: is_remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements per institutional telework policy. Supports workforce planning, facilities space planning, and Archibus space utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; Archibus Space Planning

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job code from the institution's job catalog in Workday HCM that classifies the position's duties and responsibilities. Used in CUPA-HR benchmarking, IPEDS reporting, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the position record was most recently updated in Workday HCM. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; NACUBO Records Retention Standards

attributes.name: max_incumbents
attributes.description: The maximum number of employees authorized to hold this position simultaneously. Typically 1 for standard positions; greater than 1 for pooled positions supporting multiple incumbents (e.g., graduate assistant pools).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the incumbent of this position is paid (e.g., biweekly, semimonthly, monthly). Drives payroll processing cycles in Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; NACUBO Payroll Standards

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation pay grade or salary band assigned to the position within the institution's salary administration structure (e.g., Grade 7, Band E). Determines the minimum, midpoint, and maximum salary range applicable to the position.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the position's primary duties, responsibilities, required qualifications, and scope of work. Used in recruitment postings, performance management, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the authorized position in Workday HCM (e.g., P-00012345). Used in workforce planning, IPEDS reporting, and budget reconciliation across institutional systems.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the authorized position. Open indicates the position is vacant and available for recruitment; filled indicates an active incumbent; frozen indicates the position is budgeted but hiring is suspended; eliminated indicates the position has been abolished; pending_approval indicates the position is awaiting authorization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the position's funding and employment nature. Regular positions are permanently budgeted; temporary positions are time-limited; grant-funded positions are supported by sponsored research awards; seasonal positions are cyclical; pooled positions support variable staffing needs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: requires_background_check
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires a pre-employment background check as a condition of hire per institutional policy or regulatory requirement (e.g., positions working with minors, financial fiduciary roles, law enforcement).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; FERPA; Title IX; Clery Act

attributes.name: salary_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum annual salary defined for the position's pay grade or compensation band. Used in salary administration, offer approvals, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: salary_midpoint
attributes.description: The midpoint annual salary for the position's pay grade or compensation band, representing the market reference point. Used in compa-ratio analysis, equity reviews, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: salary_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum annual salary defined for the position's pay grade or compensation band. Used in salary administration, equity analysis, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code assigned to this position. Used in IPEDS reporting, labor market analysis, and H-1B visa sponsorship documentation for international hires.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics SOC System; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: The standard number of scheduled work hours per week for this position as defined in Workday HCM. Used to calculate FTE allocation, benefits eligibility thresholds under the ACA, and overtime liability under FLSA.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; ACA Employer Shared Responsibility 26 U.S.C. § 4980H; FLSA 29 U.S.C. § 207

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official working title of the position as defined in Workday HCM and used in institutional communications, org charts, and CUPA-HR benchmarking submissions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the collective bargaining unit or union affiliation applicable to this position, if any. Determines applicable labor contract terms, grievance procedures, and wage scales. Null for non-unionized positions.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM Labor Relations

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Institutional catalog of standardized job classifications defining role families, job codes, FLSA exemption status, EEO-1 category, pay grade range, minimum qualifications, and CIP-aligned functional area. Used for compensation benchmarking against CUPA-HR survey data and for position control alignment. Sourced from Workday HCM Job Profile.
products.reference: CUPA-HR Job Classification / Workday Job Profile

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the job profile record in the institutional catalog. Primary key for the hr.job_profile data product.

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.cip_code. Business justification: Faculty and instructional staff job profiles are classified by CIP code for IPEDS human resources survey reporting (HR component) and Title IV compliance. The existing cip_code is a denormalized text

attributes.name: ada_essential_functions_documented
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Essential Functions Documented Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the essential physical and cognitive functions of this job profile have been formally documented in compliance with ADA requirements, supporting reasonable accommodation determinations and interactive process management.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) 42 U.S.C. § 12101; EEOC ADA Guidance

attributes.name: background_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-employment background check is required for all incumbents hired into this job profile. Supports compliance with institutional policy, Title IX, and Clery Act obligations for positions with student contact.
attributes.references: Clery Act (20 U.S.C. § 1092(f)); Title IX; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific collective bargaining unit or union contract applicable to this job profile when union_eligible is true (e.g., 'AFSCME', 'AAUP', 'SEIU'). Used for contract administration and labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Institutional Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: benefits_eligibility_class
attributes.description: Benefits eligibility classification assigned to this job profile determining which institutional benefit plans (health, dental, retirement, tuition waiver) are available to incumbents. Drives ACA compliance tracking and benefits cost modeling.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Eligibility Rules; ACA Employer Mandate (IRC § 4980H)

attributes.name: certifications_required
attributes.description: Free-text description of mandatory professional licenses or certifications required for this job profile (e.g., 'CPA', 'PMP', 'PE License', 'RN License'). Used in applicant screening and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Qualifications; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the institutional data catalog. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; FERPA Audit Requirements

attributes.name: critical_job
attributes.description: Flags this job profile as mission-critical to institutional operations, triggering enhanced succession planning, targeted retention strategies, and priority position-fill timelines in workforce planning.
attributes.references: Institutional Workforce Planning Framework; Workday HCM Succession Planning

attributes.name: cupa_hr_survey_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) Survey Code
attributes.description: CUPA-HR benchmark survey position code mapped to this job profile, enabling direct salary benchmarking against national higher-education compensation survey data. Critical for compensation equity analysis and market pricing.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Administrators in Higher Education Survey; CUPA-HR Professionals in Higher Education Survey

attributes.name: driving_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether incumbents in this job profile are required to operate institutional or personal vehicles as part of their duties, triggering MVR (Motor Vehicle Record) check requirements and institutional auto liability coverage.
attributes.references: Institutional Risk Management Policy; Workday HCM Job Profile

attributes.name: eeo1_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 occupational category assigned to this job profile as required by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission for annual EEO-1 Component 1 workforce demographic reporting. Drives federal compliance reporting and diversity analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Executive/Senior Officials|First/Mid Officials|Professionals|Technicians|Sales Workers|Administrative Support|Craft Workers|Operatives|Laborers|Service Workers — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1 Survey; 29 CFR Part 1602

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile version became effective and available for use in position creation and hiring actions. Supports point-in-time compensation analysis and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: employee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement associated with this job profile indicating whether positions are regular (continuing), temporary, seasonal, or casual. Affects benefits eligibility, position control, and FTE workforce reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Classification of the job profile under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether incumbents are exempt from overtime pay requirements. Critical for payroll compliance, overtime liability management, and U.S. Department of Labor regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) 29 U.S.C. § 201; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fte_capacity
attributes.description: Standard FTE value associated with this job profile (typically 1.00 for full-time, 0.50 for half-time). Used in position control, workforce planning, and IPEDS FTE headcount calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO FTE Methodology

attributes.name: inactive_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile was deactivated or deprecated in the institutional catalog. Null for currently active profiles. Used for historical workforce reporting and position control audits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: ipeds_occupational_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Occupational Category
attributes.description: IPEDS staff occupational category assigned to this job profile for annual IPEDS Human Resources (HR) survey submission to the U.S. Department of Education. Categories include Instructional Staff, Research Staff, Public Service Staff, Management, Business/Financial Operations, etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Instructional|Research|Public Service|Management|Business/Financial|Computer/Mathematical|Architecture/Engineering|Life/Physical/Social Science|Community Service|Legal|Arts/Design|Healthcare|Service|Sales|Office/Admin|Natural Resources|Construction|Maintenance|Production|Transportation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education NCES

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the job profile within Workday HCM and is referenced in position control, offer letters, and CUPA-HR survey submissions. Serves as the business-facing identifier across HR systems.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Survey Methodology

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Full detailed narrative of duties, responsibilities, and essential functions for this job profile. Serves as the authoritative document for ADA essential functions determination, FLSA classification justification, and accreditation staff qualification documentation.
attributes.references: ADA (42 U.S.C. § 12101); FLSA; EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection

attributes.name: job_family_group
attributes.description: Higher-level cluster that aggregates multiple job families into a strategic workforce segment (e.g., 'Administrative and Professional', 'Technical and Skilled Trades', 'Executive Leadership'). Supports institutional workforce analytics and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family Group; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Granular career level designation within a job family indicating seniority and scope (e.g., 'Level 1', 'Level 2', 'Senior', 'Principal', 'Lead'). Drives pay grade assignment and career progression frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Entry|Associate|Mid|Senior|Principal|Lead|Expert|Fellow — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Level; CUPA-HR Compensation Survey

attributes.name: job_summary
attributes.description: Concise narrative description of the primary purpose and scope of the job profile, typically 2-4 sentences. Used in job postings, offer letters, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Description; EEOC Uniform Guidelines

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official human-readable title of the job profile as it appears on offer letters, organizational charts, and institutional directories (e.g., 'Senior Financial Analyst', 'Director of Admissions').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Survey Methodology

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile was last formally reviewed and validated by HR Compensation or the Classification and Compensation team. Supports cyclical job evaluation programs and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Institutional HR Classification and Compensation Policy; CUPA-HR Best Practices

attributes.name: management_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical management tier assigned to the job profile indicating span of control and organizational authority. Used for succession planning, compensation banding, and organizational design analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Management Level; CUPA-HR Administrative Compensation Survey

attributes.name: min_education_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum academic credential required for appointment to this job profile. Used in applicant screening, position posting compliance, and accreditation documentation for staff qualification standards.
attributes.value_regex: High School Diploma/GED|Associate Degree|Bachelor Degree|Master Degree|Doctoral Degree|Professional Degree
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Qualifications; Regional Accreditation Standards (HLC; SACSCOC)

attributes.name: min_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for appointment to this job profile. Used in applicant screening, job posting, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Qualifications; CUPA-HR Survey

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Institutional pay grade or salary band code assigned to this job profile (e.g., 'P3', 'M5', 'E2'). Determines the applicable salary range minimum, midpoint, and maximum for compensation administration and NACUBO benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; NACUBO; CUPA-HR Salary Survey

attributes.name: pay_grade_max_usd
attributes.description: Maximum annual base salary in US dollars defined for this pay grade and job profile. Caps compensation for incumbents and triggers reclassification review when employees approach or exceed this threshold.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey; NACUBO; Equal Pay Act

attributes.name: pay_grade_midpoint_usd
attributes.description: Midpoint annual base salary in US dollars for this pay grade, representing the market reference point for a fully competent incumbent. Used in compa-ratio calculations and compensation equity reviews.

attributes.name: pay_grade_min_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual base salary in US dollars defined for this pay grade and job profile. Used in offer generation, equity analysis, and CUPA-HR compensation benchmarking to ensure pay equity compliance.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey; NACUBO; Equal Pay Act

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile in the institutional catalog. Active profiles are available for position creation and hiring. Inactive or Deprecated profiles are retained for historical position and compensation records but cannot be used for new positions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Status; Institutional Position Control Policy

attributes.name: retirement_plan_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether incumbents in this job profile are eligible to participate in institutional retirement plans (e.g., TIAA, state pension). Supports benefits administration and ERISA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Retirement Plan Rules; Workday HCM Benefits

attributes.name: sox_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is designated as a SOX-sensitive role with access to financial systems or controls, requiring enhanced internal audit oversight and segregation of duties controls. Applicable to institutions subject to SOX or analogous GASB/FASB internal control frameworks.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 302/404; GASB Statement No. 34; NACUBO

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Technology Engineering Mathematics (STEM) Designation Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is classified as a STEM-designated role, relevant for OPT STEM extension eligibility for international employees and for institutional STEM workforce diversity reporting.
attributes.references: DHS STEM OPT Extension Rule (8 CFR 214.2(f)); U.S. Department of Homeland Security

attributes.name: union_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions filled under this job profile are eligible for collective bargaining unit membership. Drives labor relations tracking, union dues processing, and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM Union Configuration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was most recently modified in the institutional data catalog. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; Workday HCM Audit Trail

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Designated work arrangement type for this job profile indicating whether the role is performed on-site at an institutional facility, fully remote, or in a hybrid arrangement. Supports workforce planning and facilities space utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Work Space; Institutional Remote Work Policy

attributes.name: work_shift
attributes.description: Standard work shift designation associated with this job profile indicating the expected hours of operation. Relevant for facilities, public safety, and healthcare-adjacent roles within the institution.

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Institutional organizational hierarchy entity representing departments, divisions, colleges, schools, and administrative units in a parent-child tree structure. Tracks unit name, unit code, parent unit, cost center reference, unit type (academic, administrative, auxiliary, research center), effective dates, responsible manager, and active/inactive status. Supports workforce reporting rollups by organizational level, budget alignment, supervisory hierarchy navigation, and IPEDS organizational structure reporting. Sourced from Workday HCM Supervisory Organization.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the organizational unit record in the institutional hierarchy. Primary key for the org_unit data product sourced from Workday HCM Supervisory Organization.

attributes.name: campus_id

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.cip_code. Business justification: Academic org units (departments, colleges) are classified by CIP code for IPEDS completions and institutional characteristics reporting, and for accreditation alignment. The existing cip_code is a den

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center associated with this organizational unit. Supports budget alignment, financial reporting rollups, and cross-system reconciliation between Workday HCM and Oracle PeopleSoft Financials.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent organizational unit in the institutional hierarchy tree. Null for the root-level institution node. Enables recursive parent-child traversal for workforce rollup reporting and supervisory hierarchy navigation.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the primary specialized or programmatic accreditation body governing this organizational unit's academic programs. Examples: 'ABET', 'AACSB', 'LCME', 'ABA', 'HLC'. Null for non-academic or non-accredited units. Used for accreditation compliance tracking and self-study documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ABET|AACSB|LCME|ABA|HLC|SACSCOC|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC|ACEN|CCNE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABET; AACSB International; LCME; ABA; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the organizational unit with its primary accreditation body. Accredited units are in good standing; candidate units are pursuing initial accreditation; probation units have conditions to resolve; not_accredited units are unaccredited; exempt units are not subject to specialized accreditation requirements.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Accreditation Standards; AACSB International; ABET

attributes.name: banner_org_code
attributes.description: Ellucian Banner SIS organization code mapped to this Workday HCM supervisory organization. Used for cross-system reconciliation between HR and student information systems, particularly for academic department alignment in course scheduling and faculty assignment.
