attributes.name: employer_social_security_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employer Social Security Tax (FICA - OASDI Employer Share)
attributes.description: Employer's matching share of Social Security (OASDI) tax under FICA for this employee and pay period. Required for payroll tax liability reporting and NACUBO financial reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period. Required for IRS W-2 Box 2 reporting and federal tax remittance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Employer's Tax Guide); IRS Form W-2 Instructions

attributes.name: fica_taxable_wages
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Taxable Wages
attributes.description: The portion of gross pay subject to FICA (Social Security and Medicare) taxes. May differ from federal taxable wages due to different pre-tax exclusions. Required for W-2 Boxes 3 and 5.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); IRS Form W-2 Boxes 3 and 5

attributes.name: fte_percent
attributes.description: The employee's Full-Time Equivalent percentage for this pay period (e.g., 1.0000 = full-time, 0.5000 = half-time). Used for IPEDS FTE reporting, NACUBO workforce analytics, and ACA full-time employee determination.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards; ACA Employer Shared Responsibility

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount withheld from the employee's pay this period for court-ordered garnishments, including child support, tax levies, and creditor garnishments. Subject to Consumer Credit Protection Act limits.
attributes.references: Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) Title III; IRS Tax Levy Procedures

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total earnings before any deductions or withholdings for the pay period. Includes base salary/wages, overtime, shift differentials, stipends, and other earnings components. Core field for W-2 preparation and NACUBO financial reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FASB/GASB Financial Reporting Standards; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total regular hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used for hourly pay calculations, Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) reporting, and IPEDS workforce data submissions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: is_fica_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Exemption Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is exempt from FICA taxes for this pay period (e.g., certain student employees, non-resident alien employees on specific visa types, or employees covered by alternative retirement systems).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); IRS Section 3121(b)

attributes.name: is_supplemental_wage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll result includes supplemental wages (e.g., bonuses, awards, retroactive pay) subject to the IRS flat supplemental withholding rate rather than the standard withholding method.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Supplemental Wages); Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: local_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of local or municipal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period, applicable in jurisdictions with local income taxes.
attributes.references: Local Tax Authority Regulations; IRS Form W-2 Instructions

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld under the Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA). Required for IRS W-2 Box 6 reporting. Includes Additional Medicare Tax for high earners.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); IRS Form W-2 Box 6

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total take-home pay after all deductions, withholdings, and garnishments have been subtracted from gross pay. Represents the actual amount disbursed to the employee.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period, subject to FLSA overtime premium pay requirements. Applicable to non-exempt staff employees.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Workday HCM Time Tracking

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid (e.g., biweekly, semimonthly). Determines the number of pay periods per year and affects annualized compensation calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: pay_group
attributes.description: The Workday HCM pay group to which the employee belongs, grouping employees with the same pay frequency, currency, and payroll processing rules (e.g., Faculty-Monthly, Staff-Biweekly).

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll result. Together with pay_period_start_date defines the exact earnings window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB/GASB Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll result. Used for period-based payroll reconciliation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB/GASB Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The employee's base pay rate for this pay period — hourly rate for non-exempt employees or annualized salary for exempt employees. Used for CUPA-HR benchmarking and compensation administration.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Module; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking Standards; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is compensated on an hourly, salaried, stipend, or per diem basis. Determines how pay is calculated and which FLSA exemption rules apply.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Workday HCM Compensation Module; CUPA-HR Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay was disbursed to the employee (e.g., direct deposit via ACH, paper check, wire transfer, or pay card). Drives disbursement processing and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; NACHA Operating Rules (ACH)

attributes.name: retirement_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-tax employee contribution to retirement plans (e.g., 403(b), 457(b)) deducted from gross pay this period. Required for IRS W-2 Box 12 reporting and retirement plan compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 571 (403(b) Plans); IRS Form W-2 Box 12; ERISA

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this payroll result record within the payroll run lifecycle. Drives reconciliation and exception management workflows.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run that produced this result. Distinguishes regular scheduled payrolls from off-cycle, supplemental, bonus, correction, or final termination runs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld under the Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA). Required for IRS W-2 Box 4 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); IRS Form W-2 Box 4

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for this pay period. Required for state W-2 equivalent reporting and state tax remittance.
attributes.references: State Tax Authority Regulations; IRS Form W-2 Instructions

attributes.name: tax_withholding_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the state in which income tax was withheld for this payroll result. Supports multi-state tax compliance for employees working across state lines.
attributes.references: State Tax Authority Regulations; IRS Publication 15; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: taxable_wages
attributes.description: The portion of gross pay subject to federal income tax withholding after pre-tax deductions (retirement, FSA, health premiums). Required for W-2 Box 1 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-2 Box 1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payroll result record was most recently modified in the data platform, such as after a payroll correction or reversal. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); FASB/GASB Audit Standards

attributes.name: w2_box12_code
attributes.description: IRS-defined code(s) for special compensation items reported in W-2 Box 12 (e.g., Code D for 401(k)/403(b) deferrals, Code DD for employer-sponsored health coverage cost). Required for annual W-2 preparation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: D|E|G|DD|W|AA|BB|EE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: workday_payroll_result_reference
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identifier assigned by Workday HCM to this payroll result record. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: ytd_federal_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative federal income tax withheld from the employee from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Required for W-2 Box 2 year-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 2; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the employee from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Essential for W-2 preparation, Social Security wage base tracking, and annual compensation reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: ytd_retirement_deduction
attributes.description: Cumulative employee retirement plan contributions from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Used to monitor IRS annual contribution limits (e.g., 403(b) elective deferral limit).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 571; IRS Form W-2 Box 12; ERISA

products.name: absence_event
products.description: Comprehensive absence management record tracking employee leave requests, approvals, and accrual balances. Captures leave type (FMLA, vacation, sick, personal, medical, military, parental, bereavement, sabbatical), requested and approved dates, intermittent leave flag, approval status, approving manager, return-to-work date, accrued hours, used hours, carried-over hours, forfeited hours, and current balance by leave type. Sourced from Workday HCM Absence Management. Supports FMLA compliance tracking, leave liability reporting, and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: absence_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for absence_event

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center associated with the employee's position. Used for leave liability financial reporting and integration with Oracle PeopleSoft Financials for accrual accounting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department of the employee at the time of the leave request. Used for departmental leave utilization reporting and workforce scheduling impact analysis.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position held by the employee at the time of the leave request, supporting workforce scheduling and Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) impact analysis.

attributes.name: primary_absence_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who submitted the leave request. Links to the HR employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year during which the leave event occurs (e.g., 2024-2025). Used for institutional workforce planning, accreditation reporting, and IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) workforce data submissions.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: accrued_hours_balance
attributes.description: Total leave hours accrued by the employee for the applicable leave type as of the request date. Used for eligibility validation and leave liability reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; NACUBO Leave Liability Reporting

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: The date the employee actually returned to work, which may differ from the anticipated return-to-work date. Used to reconcile leave duration and update accrual balances.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request within the Workday HCM approval process. Drives downstream scheduling, payroll processing, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the approving manager formally approved the leave request in Workday HCM. Used for approval turnaround time reporting and audit compliance.

attributes.name: approved_hours
attributes.description: Total number of leave hours formally approved by the manager. May differ from requested hours if partial approval was granted. Used for payroll processing and accrual deduction.

attributes.name: carried_over_hours
attributes.description: Leave hours carried forward from the prior accrual period into the current period for this leave type. Subject to institutional policy caps and collective bargaining agreement terms.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the absence event record was first created in the Workday HCM system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and FERPA compliance record-keeping.

attributes.name: current_balance_hours
attributes.description: Remaining leave hours available to the employee for this leave type after accounting for accruals, usage, carryover, and forfeitures. Drives leave eligibility checks and leave liability financial reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; NACUBO Leave Liability Reporting

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation provided by the approving manager when a leave request is denied. Required for grievance and appeal processes and HR audit documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the employee when submitting the leave request. May contain health-related or personal information protected under HIPAA and FERPA. Stored in restricted access tier.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); FERPA; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: fmla_designation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Designation Date
attributes.description: The date on which HR formally designated this leave as FMLA-qualifying. Required for FMLA compliance; the employer must provide designation notice within five business days of having sufficient information.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.300); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fmla_hours_remaining
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Remaining
attributes.description: Remaining FMLA-eligible hours available to the employee in the current 12-month entitlement period (maximum 480 hours). Used for FMLA compliance reporting and employee communications.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.200); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used_ytd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Used Year-to-Date
attributes.description: Cumulative FMLA-designated leave hours consumed by the employee in the current 12-month FMLA entitlement period. The FMLA entitlement is capped at 480 hours (12 weeks) per year; this field supports entitlement exhaustion monitoring.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.200); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: forfeited_hours
attributes.description: Leave hours forfeited at the end of the accrual period due to exceeding the maximum carryover cap. Used for leave liability reconciliation and policy compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: fte_impact
attributes.description: The fractional Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) workforce capacity lost due to this absence event, calculated based on the employee's scheduled FTE and leave duration. Used for workforce planning, IPEDS FTE reporting, and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: is_fmla_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Designated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave event has been formally designated as qualifying under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA). Drives FMLA entitlement tracking and regulatory compliance reporting to the U.S. Department of Labor.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: is_intermittent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently (non-consecutive days or partial days) rather than as a continuous block. Critical for FMLA intermittent leave tracking and scheduling impact analysis.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.202); Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the absence event record was most recently modified in Workday HCM. Used for incremental ETL (Extract Transform Load) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and change data capture auditing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; Databricks Lakehouse ETL

attributes.name: leave_duration_days
attributes.description: Total calendar days spanned by the leave event from leave_start_date to leave_end_date. Stored as a business field from Workday HCM to support scheduling and FMLA week-equivalent calculations without requiring runtime computation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: leave_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the approved or requested leave period. Nullable for open-ended leaves such as extended medical or military leave.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: leave_pay_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is compensated as fully paid, unpaid, or partial pay. Drives payroll processing rules in Workday HCM and affects leave liability calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason or sub-classification for the leave request (e.g., own serious health condition, care for family member, childbirth, military deployment). Contains health-related information protected under FERPA and HIPAA where applicable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: own_health|family_care|childbirth|adoption|military_deployment|bereavement|personal|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); FERPA

attributes.name: leave_request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the leave request as assigned by Workday HCM. Used in employee communications, HR correspondence, and audit trails.

attributes.name: leave_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the approved or requested leave period. Used for scheduling, payroll cutoff, and FMLA entitlement period calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave category as defined in Workday HCM absence plans. Drives eligibility rules, accrual policies, and regulatory compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FMLA|vacation|sick|personal|medical|military|parental|bereavement|sabbatical|jury_duty|administrative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FMLA Regulations (29 CFR Part 825); Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the approving manager during the review and approval workflow. Used for HR audit trails and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: medical_certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical certification documentation was received by HR. Used to verify compliance with the 15-calendar-day FMLA certification submission deadline.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.305); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: medical_certification_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certification has been received from the employee. Used to track outstanding documentation and enforce FMLA certification deadlines.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.305); Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certification form (e.g., WH-380-E or WH-380-F for FMLA) is required for this leave request. Drives HR follow-up workflows and compliance documentation tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.305); U.S. Department of Labor WH-380

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the employee submitted the leave request in Workday HCM. Used to measure request lead time and compliance with advance notice requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: requested_hours
attributes.description: Total number of leave hours requested by the employee for this absence event. Used for accrual balance validation and scheduling impact assessment.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The actual or anticipated date the employee is expected to return to active duty. Used for workforce scheduling, position backfill planning, and FMLA reinstatement tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: used_hours
attributes.description: Total leave hours consumed by the employee for this leave type in the current accrual period, including this event. Supports leave liability reporting and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) monitoring for staff.

attributes.name: workday_absence_reference
attributes.description: The native system identifier assigned by Workday HCM to this absence event. Used for source system traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the operational Workday HCM system.

products.name: recruitment_requisition
products.description: Formal staff position requisition record initiating the hiring process for a new or backfill position. Captures requisition number, position title, department, hiring manager, requisition type (new headcount, backfill, temporary), approved FTE, salary range, posting date, target fill date, and requisition status (draft, approved, posted, filled, cancelled). Sourced from Workday HCM Recruiting. Supports time-to-fill reporting and workforce planning.

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the recruitment requisition record in Workday HCM Recruiting. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical campus or facility location where the position will be based, as defined in the Archibus Facilities Management system. Used for space planning, commuter benefit administration, and multi-campus workforce reporting.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management Module; IPEDS Institutional Characteristics Survey

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Higher-ed position control requires budget availability verification against a cost center before a requisition is approved. budget_account_code is a denormalized cost center reference. This FK enable

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized job profile in Workday HCM that defines the job family, job level, competencies, and compensation grade associated with this requisition. Enables CUPA-HR benchmarking and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Architecture; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center that owns this requisition. Used for workforce planning, budget allocation, and IPEDS reporting on staff headcount by organizational unit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authorized position in the institutional position control system (Workday HCM Position Management). Links the requisition to the funded, budgeted position slot. Supports headcount reconciliation and FTE tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management Module; NACUBO Position Control Standards

attributes.name: primary_recruitment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the hiring manager responsible for this requisition. The hiring manager initiates the requisition, participates in interviews, and makes the final selection recommendation.

attributes.name: tertiary_recruitment_recruiter_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the talent acquisition staff member (recruiter) in Workday HCM assigned to manage the sourcing, screening, and coordination activities for this requisition.

attributes.name: application_close_date
attributes.description: The date after which the institution will no longer accept applications for this requisition. Used to manage applicant pools, communicate deadlines to candidates, and comply with equal opportunity posting requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OFCCP Equal Opportunity Posting Requirements

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the requisition received final authorization from the appropriate approving authority (e.g., VP, Provost, Budget Office). Marks the transition from draft to approved status and initiates the posting workflow.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; NACUBO Position Control Standards

attributes.name: approved_fte
attributes.description: The authorized Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value for this position as approved through the position control process. A value of 1.00 represents a full-time position; 0.50 represents half-time. Used for workforce planning, IPEDS FTE reporting, and budget modeling.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO FTE Reporting Standards; Workday HCM Position Management

attributes.name: cancelled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the requisition was cancelled, if applicable. Captures the point at which the institution decided not to proceed with filling the position. Used for workforce planning analysis and budget release tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; NACUBO Position Control Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recruitment requisition record was first created in Workday HCM. Serves as the audit trail anchor for the requisition lifecycle and is used in time-to-fill calculations from initiation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; FERPA Audit Trail Requirements; OFCCP Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: eeo_job_category
attributes.description: The EEO-6 (Higher Education Staff Information) job category assigned to this position for federal equal employment opportunity reporting. Categories include Executive/Administrative/Managerial, Faculty, Professional Non-Faculty, Secretarial/Clerical, Technical/Paraprofessional, Skilled Crafts, and Service/Maintenance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executive_admin_managerial|faculty|professional_non_faculty|secretarial_clerical|technical_paraprofessional|skilled_crafts|service_maintenance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-6 Higher Education Staff Information Survey; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement for the position being recruited. Determines benefits eligibility, payroll processing rules, and IPEDS reporting category.
attributes.references: Workday HCM HCM Module; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; FLSA Regulations

attributes.name: filled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the requisition was closed as filled, typically corresponding to the accepted offer date or the new hire start date. Used as the end-point for time-to-fill calculations and workforce planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Time-to-Fill Benchmarking

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). Exempt positions are salaried and not eligible for overtime; non-exempt positions are hourly and eligible for overtime pay. Critical for payroll compliance.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); U.S. Department of Labor Regulations; Workday HCM Compensation Module

attributes.name: ipeds_occupation_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Occupation Category
attributes.description: The IPEDS Human Resources Survey occupation category code assigned to this position for federal reporting to the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES). Enables institutional benchmarking and compliance with Title IV reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; National Center for Education Statistics (NCES); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: is_confidential_search
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a confidential executive or sensitive search where the position details and incumbent identity are restricted from general staff visibility. When True, the requisition is masked in standard reporting and accessible only to authorized HR personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; FERPA; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: job_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or pay band assigned to this position within the institutional salary structure. Used for salary range determination, equity analysis, and CUPA-HR benchmarking comparisons.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking; Workday HCM Compensation Module; NACUBO Compensation Standards

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the hiring manager explaining the business need for this position. For backfill requisitions, includes the name and departure date of the prior incumbent. Required for budget approval workflows and position control authorization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; NACUBO Position Control Standards; Institutional Budget Policy

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recruitment requisition record was most recently modified in Workday HCM. Supports data lineage tracking, change auditing, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OFCCP Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: minimum_qualifications
attributes.description: Structured text describing the minimum education, experience, and credential requirements that candidates must meet to be considered for the position. Used in job postings and applicant screening in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OFCCP Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: number_of_openings
attributes.description: The total number of positions to be filled under this single requisition. Most requisitions have one opening, but pooled or cohort hires (e.g., multiple graduate assistants, seasonal staff) may have multiple openings under one requisition number.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: position_description_url
attributes.description: URL or document reference pointing to the full position description stored in the institutional document management system or Workday HCM. The position description details duties, qualifications, and performance expectations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: positions_filled_count
attributes.description: The number of openings under this requisition that have been successfully filled with an accepted offer. Compared against number_of_openings to determine requisition completion status and track partial fills.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Time-to-Fill Benchmarking

attributes.name: posting_channel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is posted for internal candidates only, external candidates only, or both. Drives routing in Workday HCM and determines which job boards and internal portals receive the posting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OFCCP Equal Opportunity Posting Requirements

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the job requisition was officially posted to external and/or internal job boards. Marks the start of the active recruiting period and is the anchor date for time-to-fill calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Time-to-Fill Benchmarking

attributes.name: preferred_qualifications
attributes.description: Structured text describing the preferred (but not required) education, experience, skills, and credentials that would distinguish a stronger candidate. Used in job postings and candidate evaluation rubrics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; OFCCP Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: requires_background_check
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires a pre-employment background check as a condition of hire. Driven by position type, access to sensitive populations (e.g., minors, financial systems), or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Clery Act; Title IX; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: requires_degree_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires formal verification of the candidate's educational credentials as part of the pre-employment screening process. Common for positions requiring specific academic qualifications.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Institutional HR Policy; Regional Accreditation Standards (HLC; SACSCOC)

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the requisition as displayed in Workday HCM and communicated to hiring managers and HR business partners (e.g., REQ-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reference and candidate communications.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Workforce Data Standards

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recruitment requisition within the Workday HCM recruiting workflow. Drives time-to-fill reporting and workforce planning dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|posted|filled|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the hiring need. New headcount indicates a net-new position; backfill replaces a departing employee; temporary covers a fixed-term or seasonal need; reclassification reflects a job grade change; transfer is an internal move requiring a formal requisition. Drives position control and budget authorization workflows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; NACUBO Position Control Standards

attributes.name: salary_range_max
attributes.description: The maximum annual salary (in USD) approved for this position as defined by the institutional compensation structure and job grade. Caps the offer amount and is used for budget forecasting and pay equity analysis.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking; NACUBO Compensation Standards; Equal Pay Act; Workday HCM Compensation Module

attributes.name: salary_range_midpoint
attributes.description: The midpoint of the approved salary range for this position, representing the market reference point for a fully qualified incumbent. Used in CUPA-HR benchmarking, compa-ratio analysis, and compensation equity reporting.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking; Workday HCM Compensation Module

attributes.name: salary_range_min
attributes.description: The minimum annual salary (in USD) approved for this position as defined by the institutional compensation structure and job grade. Used for offer letter generation, budget planning, and pay equity compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking; NACUBO Compensation Standards; Equal Pay Act; Workday HCM Compensation Module

attributes.name: search_committee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal search committee is required for this requisition per institutional policy. Typically required for senior administrative, faculty-adjacent, or director-level and above positions to ensure shared governance and equitable selection.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; Institutional Shared Governance Policy; Regional Accreditation Standards (HLC; SACSCOC)

attributes.name: target_fill_date
attributes.description: The desired date by which the hiring manager expects the position to be filled and the new employee to start. Used for time-to-fill reporting, workforce planning, and recruiter performance metrics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; CUPA-HR Time-to-Fill Benchmarking

attributes.name: visa_sponsorship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is willing to sponsor an H-1B or other work visa for the selected candidate. Affects international candidate sourcing strategy and legal/immigration compliance workflows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Module; U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) H-1B Regulations; Institutional International HR Policy

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires on-campus presence, is fully remote, or follows a hybrid schedule. Affects facilities space planning, IT provisioning, and candidate sourcing strategy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM HCM Module; Archibus Space Planning Module

products.name: hr_applicant
products.description: Master record for individuals who have applied for non-faculty staff positions at the institution. Captures applicant identity, contact information, source channel (job board, employee referral, direct), EEO self-identification data, veteran status, disability status, and application history per requisition including application status (applied, screening, interview, offer, hired, rejected, withdrawn), disposition reason, offer details, and final hiring decision. Distinct from the admissions domain applicant (prospective students). Sourced from Workday HCM Recruiting. Supports OFCCP compliance reporting, diversity hiring analytics, and time-to-fill metrics.

attributes.name: hr_applicant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each applicant record in the HR recruiting system. Primary key for the hr_applicant data product. Sourced from Workday HCM Recruiting module.

attributes.name: primary_hr_referral_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the current employee who referred this applicant, when source_channel is 'employee_referral'. Supports employee referral program tracking and incentive administration.

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position requisition for which this applicant has applied. Links the applicant to a specific open staff position in the institution's position control system.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; CUPA-HR Position Classification Standards

attributes.name: tertiary_hr_recruiter_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR recruiter assigned to manage this applicant's candidacy. Used for recruiter workload analysis, time-to-fill accountability, and sourcing effectiveness reporting.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the applicant. Used for background check initiation, offer letter mailing, and OFCCP geographic compliance analysis.

attributes.name: application_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the applicant record was first created in the Workday HCM Recruiting system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp and the anchor for time-to-fill calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; OFCCP Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicant submitted their application for the position. Used as the start point for time-to-fill and time-to-hire calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current stage of the applicant's progression through the recruiting workflow for the associated requisition. Drives pipeline reporting and time-to-fill analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: applied|screening|interview|offer|hired|rejected|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pre-employment background check for the applicant. Required for compliance with institutional hiring policy and federal contractor obligations.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of residence for the applicant. Used in geographic sourcing analytics and OFCCP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the applicant's country of residence. Supports international applicant tracking and work authorization screening.

attributes.name: current_employer
attributes.description: Name of the applicant's current or most recent employer. Used for background screening, reference checks, and competitive sourcing intelligence.

attributes.name: current_job_title
attributes.description: The applicant's current or most recent job title. Used for qualification assessment, salary benchmarking, and CUPA-HR position classification alignment.

attributes.name: desired_salary
attributes.description: The annual salary expectation stated by the applicant during the application process. Used for early-stage compensation fit screening and offer negotiation planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; CUPA-HR Salary Benchmarking

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Applicant's self-identified disability status per Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Required for federal contractor OFCCP compliance reporting and disability inclusion benchmarking (7% utilization goal).
attributes.references: Section 503 Rehabilitation Act; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741

attributes.name: disposition_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason for the final disposition of the applicant (e.g., 'Not Qualified', 'Position Filled', 'Candidate Withdrew', 'Failed Background Check'). Required for OFCCP Internet Applicant recordkeeping and adverse impact analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_qualified|position_filled|candidate_withdrew|failed_background_check|better_qualified_candidate|salary_mismatch|no_show — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1.3 Internet Applicant Rule

attributes.name: eeo_gender
attributes.description: Applicant's self-identified gender as collected on the voluntary EEO self-identification form. Required for OFCCP and EEOC compliance reporting and diversity hiring analytics. Collected separately from the application and stored with restricted access.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1

attributes.name: eeo_race_ethnicity
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Race and Ethnicity Self-Identification
attributes.description: Applicant's self-identified race and ethnicity category per EEOC EEO-1 classification (e.g., Hispanic or Latino, White, Black or African American, Asian, etc.). Required for OFCCP compliance and institutional diversity reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hispanic_latino|white|black_african_american|asian|native_hawaiian_pacific_islander|american_indian_alaska_native|two_or_more_races|decline_to_state — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the applicant used for all recruiting communications, interview scheduling, and offer delivery. Sourced from Workday HCM candidate profile.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60; Workday HCM Recruiting

attributes.name: expected_start_date
attributes.description: The anticipated first day of employment for the applicant upon offer acceptance. Used for onboarding planning, position vacancy tracking, and FTE workforce forecasting.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the applicant as provided during the application process. Used for identity verification, correspondence, and OFCCP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: highest_education_level
attributes.description: The highest academic degree or credential attained by the applicant as self-reported on the application. Used for minimum qualification screening and workforce education analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high_school|associate|bachelor|master|doctoral|professional|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: interview_stage
attributes.description: The most recent or current interview stage reached by the applicant in the selection process. Supports pipeline funnel analysis and interview-to-offer conversion rate reporting.

attributes.name: is_internal_applicant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is a current employee of the institution applying for a different position (internal transfer or promotion). Distinguishes internal mobility from external hiring for workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: is_rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is a former employee who has been designated as eligible for rehire by the institution. Sourced from Workday HCM separation records. Prevents inadvertent rehire of ineligible former employees.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name (surname) of the applicant as provided during the application process. Used for identity verification, correspondence, and OFCCP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the applicant record was most recently modified in the Workday HCM Recruiting system. Used for incremental data extraction (ETL) and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the applicant. Supports full legal name construction for background check and onboarding documentation.

attributes.name: offer_accepted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicant formally accepted the employment offer. Used to calculate offer acceptance rate and time-to-fill KPIs.

attributes.name: offer_amount
attributes.description: The annual base salary amount included in the formal offer extended to the applicant. Populated when application_status reaches 'offer'. Used for compensation equity analysis and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; CUPA-HR Compensation Survey

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal employment offer was extended to the applicant. Used to calculate offer-to-acceptance cycle time and time-to-fill metrics.

attributes.name: offer_response
attributes.description: The applicant's response to the formal employment offer. Supports offer acceptance rate analytics and compensation negotiation pattern analysis.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the applicant. Used for interview scheduling and recruiter outreach. Stored in E.164 international format.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the applicant's residence. Supports geographic labor market analysis and commute-distance sourcing metrics.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the applicant prefers to be addressed by, which may differ from their legal name. Supports inclusive hiring practices and respectful candidate communication.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The recruitment channel through which the applicant was sourced (e.g., job board, employee referral, direct application, staffing agency). Critical for sourcing effectiveness analytics and cost-per-hire reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: job_board|employee_referral|direct|agency|career_fair|social_media|internal_transfer — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_detail
attributes.description: Specific source name within the source channel (e.g., 'Indeed', 'LinkedIn', 'HigherEdJobs', 'Chronicle of Higher Education', employee name for referrals). Enables granular sourcing ROI analysis.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of residence for the applicant. Used in geographic sourcing analytics, relocation eligibility assessment, and OFCCP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: Applicant's self-identified veteran status per VEVRAA (Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act) categories. Required for federal contractor OFCCP compliance reporting and veteran hiring benchmarks.

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is legally authorized to work in the country of the position without employer sponsorship. Used for I-9 eligibility screening and visa sponsorship decision tracking.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification; Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA)

attributes.name: workday_candidate_reference
attributes.description: The native candidate identifier assigned by Workday HCM Recruiting. Used to cross-reference records back to the system of record for reconciliation and integration purposes.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of relevant professional work experience as self-reported by the applicant. Used for minimum qualification screening and compensation band placement during offer stage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Annual or mid-cycle performance evaluation and professional development record for a staff employee. Captures review period, review type (annual, probationary, mid-year), overall rating, goal achievement rating, competency ratings, reviewer identity, employee self-assessment flag, calibration status, and final approval date. Also tracks training and professional development completions including training type (mandatory compliance, professional development, safety, DEI), delivery method, completion date, credit hours, pass/fail status, certificate issued flag, and expiration date for recurring compliance trainings (Title IX, FERPA, HIPAA, cybersecurity). Sourced from Workday HCM Talent and Performance. Supports merit increase decisions, talent development planning, and compliance training verification.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each performance review record in the Workday HCM Talent and Performance module. Primary key for the performance_review data product.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department to which the employee belongs at the time of the review, used for departmental performance reporting.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position held by the employee at the time of the review, supporting position control and workforce planning analysis.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff employee who is the subject of this performance review. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who authored and submitted the performance review. Typically the direct supervisor in the Workday HCM reporting hierarchy.

attributes.name: calibrated_overall_rating
attributes.description: The overall performance rating after calibration review, which may differ from the manager's initial rating. Represents the final agreed-upon rating used for merit decisions and talent planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of the rating calibration process for this review. Calibration sessions ensure consistency and fairness of ratings across departments and divisions before final approval.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: competency_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate rating reflecting the employee's demonstration of institutional core competencies (e.g., collaboration, communication, service excellence, DEI commitment) as evaluated during the review period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Competency Frameworks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the Workday HCM system and ingested into the Silver Layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: development_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal individual development plan (IDP) is required as an outcome of this performance review, typically triggered by a needs_improvement or unsatisfactory rating.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Professional Development Standards

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The institutional deadline by which the performance review must be completed and submitted in Workday HCM. Used for compliance tracking and HR reporting on timely completion rates.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledged_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee electronically acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation in Workday HCM. Required for FERPA-adjacent employee record integrity and HR audit trails.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the employee in their self-assessment, capturing their own perspective on accomplishments, challenges, and development goals. Confidential HR record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: final_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance review received final HR or senior leadership approval, marking the review as officially closed and eligible to inform merit increase decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: fte_at_review
attributes.description: The employee's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value at the time of the performance review. Supports workforce planning analytics and ensures part-time employees are evaluated proportionally.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) FTE Reporting

attributes.name: goal_achievement_rating
attributes.description: Rating reflecting the degree to which the employee achieved their individual performance goals set at the beginning of the review period. Distinct from competency ratings; focuses on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: goals_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual performance goals formally documented and evaluated in this review cycle. Supports workforce analytics on goal-setting practices and alignment with institutional KPIs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: goals_met_count
attributes.description: The number of individual performance goals that the employee fully achieved during the review period. Used in conjunction with goals_count to assess goal attainment rates.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating specific to leadership behaviors and people management competencies, applicable to employees in supervisory or managerial roles. Marked not_applicable for individual contributors.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Leadership Competency Standards

attributes.name: merit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for a merit-based salary increase based on their performance review outcome. Eligibility may be restricted by budget, employment type, or rating threshold policies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: merit_increase_pct
attributes.description: The percentage salary increase recommended or approved based on the performance review outcome. Confidential compensation data used in salary administration and CUPA-HR benchmarking analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking; NACUBO Compensation Standards

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The summary performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period, drawn from the institution's standardized rating scale in Workday HCM. Directly informs merit increase eligibility and talent development planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: overall_rating_numeric
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the overall performance rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00) as configured in Workday HCM. Enables quantitative analytics, benchmarking, and merit matrix calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: pip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) has been initiated as a result of this review. A PIP is a structured corrective action document for employees rated unsatisfactory.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Employee Relations Standards

attributes.name: review_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the reviewing manager summarizing the employee's performance, accomplishments, and areas for development during the review period. Confidential HR record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the performance evaluation period covered by this review. Together with review_period_start_date, defines the full evaluation window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the performance evaluation period covered by this review. Defines the beginning of the window during which the employee's performance is assessed.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the performance review in Workday HCM. Tracks progression from initial draft through employee acknowledgment, manager submission, HR approval, and final completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|employee_acknowledged|manager_submitted|hr_approved|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review cycle. Annual reviews support merit decisions; probationary reviews assess new hires within their introductory period; mid-year reviews provide interim feedback; project and off-cycle reviews address specific circumstances.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: self_assessment_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee completed a self-assessment as part of the performance review process in Workday HCM. Self-assessments are a standard component of annual and mid-year review cycles.

attributes.name: self_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee submitted their self-assessment in Workday HCM. Used to track employee engagement in the review process and measure timeliness.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manager formally submitted the completed performance review in Workday HCM. Used to measure on-time submission compliance against the due date.

attributes.name: talent_segment

attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Talent Development Frameworks

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the performance review record in the source system or the Silver Layer. Used for incremental ETL processing and change data capture.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Data Pipeline Standards

attributes.name: workday_review_reference
attributes.description: The native business identifier assigned by Workday HCM to this performance review event. Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Transactional record of employee time worked including clock-in/clock-out timestamps, hours worked by earning code (regular, overtime, shift differential, on-call), work location, cost center allocation, supervisor approval status, and pay period assignment. Critical for non-exempt/hourly staff FLSA compliance, overtime calculation, and payroll input. Sourced from Workday HCM Time Tracking.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Federal grant effort reporting (2 CFR 200) requires time charged to specific funds for salary cost allocation and grant closeout reporting. fund_code is a denormalized plain-text field. This FK enable

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research grant or sponsored project funding this time entry. Required for grant-funded employee time tracking and effort reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department where the work was performed. Used for departmental labor reporting and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position under which the time was worked. Links to the position master record.

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who recorded this time entry. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_time_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this time entry. Provides audit trail for approval authority.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the time entry. Tracks whether the supervisor has reviewed and approved the time for payroll processing.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the supervisor approved the time entry. Indicates readiness for payroll processing.

attributes.name: chartfield_string
attributes.description: Complete financial accounting string combining fund, department, account, program, and project codes. Used for detailed labor cost allocation in the general ledger.

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the employee clocked in or started work. Critical for FLSA compliance and overtime calculation.

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the employee clocked out or ended work. Used to calculate total hours worked.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: earning_code
attributes.description: Classification code indicating the type of time worked. Examples include regular hours, overtime, shift differential, on-call, holiday pay, or compensatory time. Drives pay rate calculation in payroll.

attributes.name: earning_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the earning code. Provides context for the type of time worked.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes or explanations provided by the employee regarding this time entry. May include justification for unusual hours or work circumstances.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the time entry in the approval and payroll workflow. Tracks progression from draft through approval to payment.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Method by which the time entry was created. Distinguishes between clock-in/out, manual entry, system import, or adjustment/correction entries.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification of the employee position as exempt or non-exempt from FLSA overtime requirements. Determines overtime eligibility and timekeeping requirements.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked during this time entry period. Calculated from clock-in/out timestamps or manually entered. Used for payroll calculation.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Hours Worked Definition

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this time entry is eligible for overtime compensation. Typically true for non-exempt employees working over 40 hours per week.

attributes.name: on_call_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the employee was on-call and available for work. May be compensated at a different rate than active work hours.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard workweek threshold (typically 40 hours). Subject to overtime premium pay under FLSA for non-exempt employees.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator showing whether this time entry has been processed through payroll and included in a paycheck. Prevents duplicate payment processing.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at the standard pay rate. Typically up to 40 hours per week for non-exempt employees under FLSA.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Regular Rate Definition

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the supervisor when rejecting a time entry. Helps employee understand what corrections are needed.

attributes.name: shift_differential_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked during shifts that qualify for differential pay (e.g., evening, night, weekend shifts). Eligible for additional compensation per institutional policy.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the time entry for supervisor approval. Used to track timeliness of time entry submission.

attributes.name: supervisor_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes or feedback provided by the supervisor during the approval process. May include approval rationale or correction instructions.

attributes.name: time_entry_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the time entry. May be used for employee and supervisor reference.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for pay period assignment and labor distribution reporting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Timekeeping Requirements

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location where the work was performed. Used for labor distribution, facilities management, and multi-campus reporting.

attributes.name: work_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the work location. Provides context for where the employee performed work.

attributes.name: workday_time_entry_reference
attributes.description: External unique identifier from Workday HCM Time Tracking system. Used for source system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.description: Dollar value of flex dollars (also called dining dollars or declining balance) included with the plan per term. Used at retail dining locations, convenience stores, and cafes. Zero for meal-only plans.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan expires and is no longer available for new enrollments or usage. Typically aligns with the end of the academic term or year.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan becomes available for student selection and use. Typically aligns with the start of the academic term or year.

attributes.name: eligible_dining_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of dining hall names and retail locations where this plan can be used (e.g., Main Dining Hall, North Commons, Campus Cafe, Student Union Food Court). May reference all-access or restricted location sets.

attributes.name: eligible_student_types
attributes.description: Description of student classifications eligible to purchase this plan (e.g., Residential students only, Commuters, Graduate students, All students). Used to control plan availability during registration.

attributes.name: guest_swipes_included
attributes.description: Number of guest meal passes included with the plan per term, allowing the plan holder to bring guests to dining halls. Zero if no guest privileges are included.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan catalog record was most recently updated. Tracks changes to pricing, structure, or availability.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dining plan is required for certain student populations (e.g., first-year students living on campus). True if mandatory, false if optional.

attributes.name: meal_equivalency_value
attributes.description: Dollar value assigned to one meal swipe when used at retail dining locations instead of all-you-care-to-eat dining halls. Allows students to use meal swipes as credit at cafes and food courts. Null if meal equivalency is not offered.

attributes.name: meals_per_week
attributes.description: Number of meal swipes available per week for weekly-based plans. Null for block plans and declining balance plans.

attributes.name: online_ordering_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dining plan supports mobile app or web-based ordering for pickup or delivery at participating dining locations. True if online ordering is enabled, false otherwise.

attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the dining plan in the catalog (e.g., UNL19, COM10, BLK150). Used for registration and billing system integration.

attributes.name: plan_description

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dining plan structure: unlimited (unlimited swipes per week), block (fixed number of meals per term), declining_balance (dollar-based account), commuter (limited access for non-residents), hybrid (combination of meals and dollars), flex (flexible allocation).

attributes.name: price_per_year

attributes.name: enrollment_date

attributes.name: enrollment_number

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Channel or system through which the dining enrollment was created. Used for process analysis and system integration tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dining enrollment. Indicates whether the enrollment is active, has been cancelled, is suspended, pending activation, completed for the term, or has been changed to a different plan.

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for meal plan exemption request. Used for policy compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: exemption_status

attributes.name: guest_meal_allowance
attributes.description: Total number of guest meals permitted under this meal plan for the enrollment period. Null if guest meals are not included in the plan.

attributes.name: guest_meals_used

attributes.name: housing_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meal plan enrollment is mandatory due to on-campus housing requirements. Used for policy enforcement and exemption tracking.

attributes.name: initial_dining_dollar_amount

attributes.name: initial_meal_count

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dining enrollment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date

attributes.name: meals_remaining
attributes.description: Number of meals remaining in the current enrollment period for block meal plans. Decrements with each meal swipe. Null for unlimited or declining balance plans.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the dining enrollment. Used by dining services staff for special circumstances or administrative annotations.

attributes.name: plan_change_date
attributes.description: Date when the student changed from one meal plan to another during the term. Null if no plan change occurred.

attributes.name: plan_change_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why the student changed meal plans. Used for operational analysis and policy evaluation.

attributes.name: plan_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of the meal plan for the enrollment period. Amount charged to the student account.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of meal plan structure. Unlimited allows unrestricted dining hall access; block provides a fixed number of meals per term; declining balance uses a dollar amount; commuter is designed for non-resident students; hybrid combines features; flex offers maximum flexibility.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount refunded to the student upon cancellation or plan change. Calculated based on refund policy and usage.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: refund_processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed and posted to the student account. Null if no refund was issued.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: rollover_balance_amount
attributes.description: Dining dollar balance carried over from the previous term, if permitted by plan rules. Null if no rollover is allowed or applicable.

attributes.name: weekly_meal_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of meals allowed per week for plans with weekly caps. Null for unlimited or term-block plans.

products.name: health_visit

Captures visit date and time, visit type (primary care, urgent care, immunization, counseling intake, follow-up, telehealth), presenting complaint or reason for visit, provider name and credential type, visit status (scheduled, completed, no-show, cancelled), SOAP note reference, referral flag, referral destination, follow-up required flag, and HIPAA-compliant data handling indicators. Serves as the encounter record for campus health services.

attributes.name: presenting_complaint

attributes.name: visit_notes
